```go
package shadow

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/ClickHouse/ch-go/proto"
	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/lthash"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/chexec"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/nativepayload"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/sources"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

const (
	testNetwork         = "testnet"
	testRevision        = 54460
	testSchemaSnapshot  = "schema-snapshot-1"
	testExecutorProfile = "executor-profile-1"
	testNodeID          = "member-test"
	testBootNonce       = "0a1b2c3d"

	ownerA        = uint64(0) // a configured peer owner
	hostIndexer   = uint64(1) // the member's host
	ownerB        = uint64(2) // a second configured peer owner
	unconfigured  = uint64(5) // enrolled, outside the group scope
	verifierCount = 3
)

func testSchema() payloadexec.TableSchema {
	return payloadexec.TableSchema{
		TableID:     "db.t",
		PartitionBy: "p",
		Columns: []lthash.Column{
			{Name: "p", Type: "String"},
			{Name: "v", Type: "UInt64"},
		},
	}
}

// fixture is a replayable chain: a genesis base and one single-statement
// block per call of block, each with the receipt every honest network
// verifier records and the candidate part an honest owner claims.
type fixture struct {
	t         *testing.T
	snapshots *payloadexec.MemSnapshotStore
	payloads  *payloadexec.MemPayloadStore
	genesis   replay.SafeSnapshotManifest
}

// testBlock is one sealed, dispatched block with honest evidence from three
// verifiers and a latched quorum.
type testBlock struct {
	BV      wire.BlockVerification
	Part    arbiter.CandidatePart // the honest candidate part
	Receipt string                // the honest receipt hash
}

func newFixture(t *testing.T) *fixture {
	t.Helper()
	executor := payloadexec.NewDynamic(testNetwork, nativepayload.Materializer{NetworkID: testNetwork, Revision: testRevision}, testSchema())
	genesis, err := executor.GenesisSnapshot(0, testSchemaSnapshot, testExecutorProfile)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("genesis snapshot: %v", err)
	}
	fx := &fixture{t: t, snapshots: payloadexec.NewMemSnapshotStore(), payloads: payloadexec.NewMemPayloadStore(), genesis: genesis}
	fx.snapshots.Put(genesis)
	return fx
}

// replayCore is an in-process replay core over the fixture's stores: the
// network verifiers' executor with the native in-process materializer in
// place of the ClickHouse one (receipts are replica-independent, K34).
func (fx *fixture) replayCore(replicaID string) *replay.Verifier {
	fx.t.Helper()
	signer, err := payloadexec.NewEd25519Signer(replicaID, make([]byte, 32))
	if err != nil {
		fx.t.Fatalf("signer: %v", err)
	}
	return &replay.Verifier{
		Snapshots:    fx.snapshots,
		Payloads:     fx.payloads,
		Executor:     payloadexec.NewDynamic(testNetwork, nativepayload.Materializer{NetworkID: testNetwork, Revision: testRevision}, testSchema()),
		Signer:       signer,
		SchemaHashes: payloadexec.SchemaHashes{NetworkID: testNetwork, Tables: []payloadexec.TableSchema{testSchema()}},
	}
}

func nativeRow(t *testing.T, p string, v uint64) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	pc, vc := proto.ColStr{}, proto.ColUInt64{}
	pc.Append(p)
	vc.Append(v)
	b, err := nativepayload.EncodeClientDataPacket(testRevision, []proto.InputColumn{{Name: "p", Data: &pc}, {Name: "v", Data: &vc}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("encode native payload: %v", err)
	}
	return b
}

// statement is block seq's one statement inserting (p, v) into db.t.
func (fx *fixture) statement(seq uint64, p string, v uint64) replay.Statement {
	fx.t.Helper()
	payload := nativeRow(fx.t, p, v)
	ref := "payload-" + strconv.FormatUint(seq, 10) + ".native"
	fx.payloads.Put(ref, payload)
	sql := "INSERT INTO db.t FORMAT Native"
	return replay.Statement{
		StatementID:    arbiter.StatementIDString("0xacct", seq, "n"),
		StatementSeq:   seq,
		SQL:            sql,
		SQLHash:        replay.DigestString(sql),
		SettingsHash:   replay.DigestString("settings"),
		PayloadRef:     ref,
		PayloadHash:    replay.DigestBytes(payload),
		PayloadLength:  uint64(len(payload)),
		TargetTableID:  "db.t",
		UserJWS:        "x.y.z",
		PayloadFormat:  replay.PayloadFormatClickHouseNativeData,
		ClientRevision: testRevision,
		SchemaHash:     payloadexec.TableSchemaHash(testNetwork, testSchema()),
	}
}

// block builds block seq of owner on the genesis base: one statement
// inserting (p, v), its honest candidate part, three verifiers' honest
// attestations and scans, all evaluated, and a latched quorum.
func (fx *fixture) block(seq, owner uint64, p string, v uint64) testBlock {
	fx.t.Helper()
	st := fx.statement(seq, p, v)
	job := replay.ReplayJob{
		BlockSeq:           seq,
		PrevSafeSnapshotID: fx.genesis.SnapshotID,
		PrevStateRoot:      fx.genesis.StateRoot,
		SchemaSnapshotID:   testSchemaSnapshot,
		ExecutorProfileID:  testExecutorProfile,
		SourceClaimRoot:    replay.DigestString("source-claim-" + strconv.FormatUint(seq, 10)),
		Statements:         []replay.Statement{st},
	}
	ref, err := fx.replayCore("verifier-ref").Verify(context.Background(), job)
	if err != nil {
		fx.t.Fatalf("reference replay of block %d: %v", seq, err)
	}
	if len(ref.Receipt.AffectedParts) != 1 {
		fx.t.Fatalf("reference replay of block %d affected %d parts, want 1", seq, len(ref.Receipt.AffectedParts))
	}
	affected := ref.Receipt.AffectedParts[0]
	part := arbiter.CandidatePart{
		TableID:       "db.t",
		PartitionID:   affected.PartitionID,
		PartName:      fmt.Sprintf("%s_%d_%d_0", p, seq, seq),
		PartRowLtHash: affected.PartRowLtHash,
		PartPhysHash:  replay.DigestString("phys-" + strconv.FormatUint(seq, 10)),
		RowCount:      1,
	}
	track := owner
	bv := wire.BlockVerification{
		Header: wire.BlockHeaderView{
			L3BlockSeq:         seq,
			StatementSeqStart:  seq,
			StatementCount:     1,
			PrevSafeSnapshotID: job.PrevSafeSnapshotID,
			PrevStateRoot:      job.PrevStateRoot,
			TrackIndexerID:     &track,
		},
		ChainHash: replay.DigestString("chain-" + strconv.FormatUint(seq, 10)),
		ReplayJob: job,
		Statements: []wire.StatementCandidates{{
			StatementSeq:         seq,
			StatementID:          st.StatementID,
			Status:               "QuorumVerified",
			SourceNode:           "snode-" + strconv.FormatUint(owner+1, 10),
			RCBound:              true,
			SourceClaimRoot:      job.SourceClaimRoot,
			CandidateParts:       []arbiter.CandidatePart{part},
			PartitionNewPartSums: []arbiter.PartitionLtHashSum{{TableID: "db.t", PartitionID: part.PartitionID, NewPartsLtHashSum: part.PartRowLtHash}},
		}},
		ScanParts:        []arbiter.PartRef{{TableID: "db.t", PartitionID: part.PartitionID, PartRowLtHash: part.PartRowLtHash, PartName: part.PartName}},
		SourceNodes:      []string{"snode-" + strconv.FormatUint(owner+1, 10)},
		VerdictEvaluated: true,
		Quorum:           true,
	}
	for i := 1; i <= verifierCount; i++ {
		rid := "verifier-" + strconv.Itoa(i)
		att := ref
		att.ReplicaID = rid
		bv.VerifierSet = append(bv.VerifierSet, rid)
		bv.Evidence = append(bv.Evidence, wire.VerifierEvidence{
			ReplicaID:   rid,
			Attestation: &att,
			ByteSideScan: &arbiter.ByteSideScanMsg{ReplicaID: rid, BlockSeq: seq, Parts: []arbiter.PartScan{{
				TableID: "db.t", PartitionID: part.PartitionID, ClaimedPartRowLtHash: part.PartRowLtHash,
				ScannedPartRowLtHash: part.PartRowLtHash, LivePartName: part.PartName,
			}}},
			Evaluated: true, Check1RootMatch: true, Check2PartitionMatch: true, Check3ByteSideMatch: true, Pass: true,
		})
	}
	return testBlock{BV: bv, Part: part, Receipt: ref.ReceiptHash}
}

// evilHash is a well-formed row LtHash accumulator no honest part has.
func evilHash(label string) string {
	h := lthash.New()
	h.Add([]byte(label))
	return "0x" + hex.EncodeToString(h.Bytes())
}

// fakeArbiter is the only arbiter the shadow sees: a block reader and a
// watermark reader, nothing else. A block answers its queued reads in order
// and repeats the last one; a block without answers is not sealed.
type fakeArbiter struct {
	mu        sync.Mutex
	watermark uint64
	answers   map[uint64][]wire.BlockVerification
	errs      map[uint64]error
	reads     []uint64
	readAt    []time.Time
}

func newFakeArbiter(watermark uint64, blocks ...wire.BlockVerification) *fakeArbiter {
	a := &fakeArbiter{watermark: watermark, answers: map[uint64][]wire.BlockVerification{}, errs: map[uint64]error{}}
	for _, bv := range blocks {
		a.put(bv.Header.L3BlockSeq, bv)
	}
	return a
}

func (a *fakeArbiter) put(seq uint64, answers ...wire.BlockVerification) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	a.answers[seq] = append(a.answers[seq], answers...)
}

func (a *fakeArbiter) fail(seq uint64, err error) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	a.errs[seq] = err
}

func (a *fakeArbiter) GetBlockVerification(_ context.Context, seq uint64) (wire.BlockVerification, error) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	a.reads = append(a.reads, seq)
	a.readAt = append(a.readAt, time.Now())
	if err := a.errs[seq]; err != nil {
		return wire.BlockVerification{}, err
	}
	queue := a.answers[seq]
	if len(queue) == 0 {
		return wire.BlockVerification{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %d", dataplane.ErrBlockNotSealed, seq)
	}
	if len(queue) > 1 {
		a.answers[seq] = queue[1:]
	}
	return queue[0], nil
}

func (a *fakeArbiter) GetSafeWatermark(context.Context) (arbiter.SafeWatermark, error) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	return arbiter.SafeWatermark{SnapshotID: "watermark", SafeBlockSeq: a.watermark, ManifestRoot: "watermark"}, nil
}

func (a *fakeArbiter) readLog() ([]uint64, []time.Time) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]uint64(nil), a.reads...), append([]time.Time(nil), a.readAt...)
}

// fakePull stands in for sources.NewOwnerUnsafePull: a part it knows is
// "pulled" into the scratch with the row LtHash it maps to; a part it does
// not know was cleaned from the owner's hg_unsafe (missed); an empty part
// arrives with no rows. scan reads back what Fetch wrote.
type fakePull struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	parts   map[string]string
	empty   map[string]bool
	scratch map[string]string
	needs   []sources.Need
}

func newFakePull(parts ...arbiter.CandidatePart) *fakePull {
	p := &fakePull{parts: map[string]string{}, empty: map[string]bool{}, scratch: map[string]string{}}
	for _, cp := range parts {
		p.parts[cp.PartName] = cp.PartRowLtHash
	}
	return p
}

func (p *fakePull) Name() string { return "owner_unsafe_pull" }

func (p *fakePull) Fetch(_ context.Context, need sources.Need, _ payloadexec.TableSchema, scratch sources.Scratch) sources.Result {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	p.needs = append(p.needs, need)
	if p.empty[need.PartName] {
		return sources.Result{Source: p.Name(), Outcome: sources.OutcomeFetched}
	}
	h, ok := p.parts[need.PartName]
	if !ok {
		return sources.Result{Source: p.Name(), Outcome: sources.OutcomeMissed}
	}
	p.scratch[scratch.Database+"."+scratch.Table] = h
	return sources.Result{Source: p.Name(), Outcome: sources.OutcomeFetched, Parts: []string{"all_1_1_0"}}
}

func (p *fakePull) scan(_ context.Context, _ clickhouse.Conn, qualified string, _ payloadexec.TableSchema) ([]chexec.PartScanResult, error) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	h, ok := p.scratch[qualified]
	if !ok {
		return []chexec.PartScanResult{}, nil
	}
	return []chexec.PartScanResult{{PartName: "all_1_1_0", RowLtHash: h, RowCount: 1}}, nil
}

func (p *fakePull) fetched() []sources.Need {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]sources.Need(nil), p.needs...)
}

// fakeConn records every statement; any method but Exec panics (the
// embedded nil Conn), so a unit test proves the shadow issues nothing else.
type fakeConn struct {
	clickhouse.Conn
	mu    sync.Mutex
	execs []string
}

func (c *fakeConn) Exec(_ context.Context, query string, _ ...any) error {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.execs = append(c.execs, query)
	return nil
}

func (c *fakeConn) statements() []string {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]string(nil), c.execs...)
}

func (c *fakeConn) count(prefix string) int {
	n := 0
	for _, s := range c.statements() {
		if strings.HasPrefix(s, prefix) {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}

func testConfig(stateDir string) Config {
	return Config{
		NodeID:        testNodeID,
		BootNonce:     testBootNonce,
		NetworkID:     testNetwork,
		StateDir:      stateDir,
		Pinned:        ddl.DefaultMemberPinned(testNodeID, 0, "default"),
		Genesis:       []payloadexec.TableSchema{testSchema()},
		Owners:        []uint64{ownerA, ownerB},
		HostIndexerID: hostIndexer,
		VerdictWait:   time.Minute,
	}
}

// newTestShadow builds a shadow over the fakes with the fixture's
// in-process replay core and the fake pull's scan in place of the
// ClickHouse ones (both are package seams; New wires the real ones).
func newTestShadow(t *testing.T, fx *fixture, arb *fakeArbiter, pull *fakePull, cfg Config) (*Verifier, *fakeConn) {
	t.Helper()
	conn := &fakeConn{}
	v, err := New(cfg, Deps{
		Blocks:     arb,
		Watermark:  arb,
		Snapshots:  fx.snapshots,
		Payloads:   fx.payloads,
		Conn:       conn,
		UnsafePull: func(uint64) sources.Source { return pull },
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("New: %v", err)
	}
	v.replay = fx.replayCore(testNodeID + "-shadow")
	v.scan = pull.scan
	return v, conn
}

// stepAll runs n Steps that must each advance the cursor.
func stepAll(t *testing.T, v *Verifier, n int) {
	t.Helper()
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		advanced, err := v.Step(context.Background())
		if err != nil || !advanced {
			t.Fatalf("step %d: advanced=%v err=%v", i+1, advanced, err)
		}
	}
}

// wantCounts compares one owner's counters.
func wantCounts(t *testing.T, st Stats, owner, blocks, missed, unverdicted, receipt, scan, claim uint64) {
	t.Helper()
	got := [6]uint64{st.Blocks[owner], st.MissedScans[owner], st.Unverdicted[owner],
		st.Mismatches[owner][MismatchReceipt], st.Mismatches[owner][MismatchScan], st.Mismatches[owner][MismatchClaim]}
	want := [6]uint64{blocks, missed, unverdicted, receipt, scan, claim}
	if got != want {
		t.Fatalf("owner %d counters (blocks, missed, unverdicted, receipt, scan, claim) = %v, want %v", owner, got, want)
	}
}
```

```go
package shadow

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"

)

// TestShadowComparesItsReceiptWithEveryRecordedAttestation: the shadow's own
// receipt hash is compared with every recorded attestation; one verifier
// that recorded another receipt is one receipt mismatch.
func TestShadowComparesItsReceiptWithEveryRecordedAttestation(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newFixture(t)
	honest := fx.block(7, ownerA, "p0", 101)
	lying := fx.block(8, ownerA, "p0", 102)
	lying.BV.Evidence[2].Attestation.ReceiptHash = replay.DigestString("another receipt")
	arb := newFakeArbiter(6, honest.BV, lying.BV)
	pull := newFakePull(honest.Part, lying.Part)
	v, _ := newTestShadow(t, fx, arb, pull, testConfig(t.TempDir()))

	stepAll(t, v, 2)

	st := v.Stats()
	wantCounts(t, st, ownerA, 2, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0)
	wantCounts(t, st, ownerB, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	if st.NextBlockSeq != 9 {
		t.Fatalf("NextBlockSeq = %d, want 9", st.NextBlockSeq)
	}
	needs := pull.fetched()
	if len(needs) != 2 || needs[0].PartName != honest.Part.PartName || needs[1].PartName != lying.Part.PartName {
		t.Fatalf("pulled %+v, want the two candidate parts in block order", needs)
	}
	for _, n := range needs {
		if n.TableKey != "db.t" || n.Table != "db__t" || n.RowCount != 1 || n.PartPhysHash == "" {
			t.Fatalf("need %+v does not carry the candidate part", n)
		}
	}
}

// TestShadowComparesItsScansWithEveryRecordedByteSideScan: every recorded
// byte-side scan is compared with the shadow's own scan of each candidate
// part, keyed by the claimed row LtHash; another scanned hash and a part the
// scan does not report are each one scan mismatch.
func TestShadowComparesItsScansWithEveryRecordedByteSideScan(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newFixture(t)
	b := fx.block(7, ownerA, "p0", 101)
	b.BV.Evidence[1].ByteSideScan.Parts[0].ScannedPartRowLtHash = evilHash("another scan")
	b.BV.Evidence[2].ByteSideScan.Parts = nil
	upper := fx.block(8, ownerA, "p0", 102)
	// Hex case is not a disagreement (check 3 compares with EqualFold).
	upper.BV.Evidence[0].ByteSideScan.Parts[0].ScannedPartRowLtHash = "0x" + strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimPrefix(upper.Part.PartRowLtHash, "0x"))
	arb := newFakeArbiter(6, b.BV, upper.BV)
	v, _ := newTestShadow(t, fx, arb, newFakePull(b.Part, upper.Part), testConfig(t.TempDir()))

	stepAll(t, v, 2)

	wantCounts(t, v.Stats(), ownerA, 2, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0)
}

// TestShadowComparesEvidenceRecordedAfterTheLatchAsRecorded: evidence the
// verdict did not evaluate (recorded after the quorum latched) is compared
// by its recorded body, exactly like evaluated evidence.
func TestShadowComparesEvidenceRecordedAfterTheLatchAsRecorded(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newFixture(t)
	late := fx.block(7, ownerA, "p0", 101)
	late.BV.Evidence[2].Evaluated, late.BV.Evidence[2].Pass = false, false
	late.BV.Evidence[2].Attestation.ReceiptHash = replay.DigestString("late receipt")
	late.BV.Evidence[2].ByteSideScan.Parts[0].ScannedPartRowLtHash = evilHash("late scan")
	honestLate := fx.block(8, ownerA, "p0", 102)
	honestLate.BV.Evidence[2].Evaluated, honestLate.BV.Evidence[2].Pass = false, false
	arb := newFakeArbiter(6, late.BV, honestLate.BV)
	v, _ := newTestShadow(t, fx, arb, newFakePull(late.Part, honestLate.Part), testConfig(t.TempDir()))

	stepAll(t, v, 2)

	wantCounts(t, v.Stats(), ownerA, 2, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0)
}

// TestShadowReproducesARejectedBlocksReceipts: the two fraud classes of
// arbiter chpipeline's fraud tests. A lying candidate part hash and a lying
// partition sum both end Rejected over complete evidence; the shadow
// reproduces every honest verifier's receipt and scan and counts no
// mismatch, because a claim is judged only after a passed quorum.
func TestShadowReproducesARejectedBlocksReceipts(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newFixture(t)
	lyingPart := fx.block(7, ownerA, "p0", 301)
	honestPart := lyingPart.Part
	evil := evilHash("evil-part")
	lyingPart.BV.Statements[0].CandidateParts[0].PartRowLtHash = evil
	lyingPart.BV.ScanParts[0].PartRowLtHash = evil
	lyingPart.BV.Statements[0].Status = "Rejected"
	lyingPart.BV.Quorum = false
	for i := range lyingPart.BV.Evidence {
		ev := &lyingPart.BV.Evidence[i]
		ev.ByteSideScan.Parts[0].ClaimedPartRowLtHash = evil // verifiers scan the true part by name
		ev.Check3ByteSideMatch, ev.Pass = false, false
	}

	lyingSum := fx.block(8, ownerA, "p0", 401)
	lyingSum.BV.Statements[0].PartitionNewPartSums[0].NewPartsLtHashSum = evilHash("evil-sum")
	lyingSum.BV.Statements[0].Status = "Rejected"
	lyingSum.BV.Quorum = false
	for i := range lyingSum.BV.Evidence {
		ev := &lyingSum.BV.Evidence[i]
		ev.Check1RootMatch, ev.Check2PartitionMatch, ev.Pass = false, false, false
	}

	arb := newFakeArbiter(6, lyingPart.BV, lyingSum.BV)
	pull := newFakePull(honestPart, lyingSum.Part) // the owner's hg_unsafe holds the true bytes
	v, _ := newTestShadow(t, fx, arb, pull, testConfig(t.TempDir()))

	stepAll(t, v, 2)

	wantCounts(t, v.Stats(), ownerA, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	if needs := pull.fetched(); len(needs) != 2 || needs[0].PartRowLtHash != evil {
		t.Fatalf("pulled %+v, want the lying candidate as claimed first", needs)
	}
}

// TestShadowClaimMismatchOnlyForAQuorumPassBlock: the shadow scans a
// candidate part to another row LtHash than claimed while every verifier
// reported the claim. That is a claim mismatch only when the quorum passed;
// the scan disagreement with each recorded scan counts either way.
func TestShadowClaimMismatchOnlyForAQuorumPassBlock(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newFixture(t)
	passed := fx.block(7, ownerA, "p0", 101)
	failed := fx.block(8, ownerA, "p0", 102)
	failed.BV.Quorum = false
	for i := range failed.BV.Evidence {
		failed.BV.Evidence[i].Pass = false
	}
	pull := newFakePull(passed.Part, failed.Part)
	pull.parts[passed.Part.PartName] = evilHash("other bytes 7")
	pull.parts[failed.Part.PartName] = evilHash("other bytes 8")
	arb := newFakeArbiter(6, passed.BV, failed.BV)
	v, _ := newTestShadow(t, fx, arb, pull, testConfig(t.TempDir()))

	stepAll(t, v, 1)
	wantCounts(t, v.Stats(), ownerA, 1, 0, 0, 0, 3, 1)
	stepAll(t, v, 1)
	wantCounts(t, v.Stats(), ownerA, 2, 0, 0, 0, 6, 1)
}

// TestShadowCountsACleanedCandidateAsAMissedScan: a candidate part the owner
// already cleaned from its hg_unsafe (the pull misses it), or one that
// arrives without rows, is a missed scan, never a mismatch; the receipt is
// still compared and every scratch is dropped.
func TestShadowCountsACleanedCandidateAsAMissedScan(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newFixture(t)
	cleaned := fx.block(7, ownerA, "p0", 101)
	empty := fx.block(8, ownerA, "p0", 102)
	pull := newFakePull(empty.Part) // block 7's part is gone
	pull.empty[empty.Part.PartName] = true
	arb := newFakeArbiter(6, cleaned.BV, empty.BV)
	v, conn := newTestShadow(t, fx, arb, pull, testConfig(t.TempDir()))

	stepAll(t, v, 2)

	wantCounts(t, v.Stats(), ownerA, 2, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	if created, dropped := conn.count("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `hg_rstage`.`member-test_0a1b2c3d_rscan_"), conn.count("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hg_rstage`.`member-test_0a1b2c3d_rscan_"); created != 2 || dropped != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("scratch created %d, dropped %d, want 2 and 2: %q", created, dropped, conn.statements())
	}
}

// TestShadowSkipsBlocksOfItsHostOtherOwnersAndTransitions: a block without a
// track, of the host's own track, of an owner outside the group scope, or a
// table-set transition is skipped and the cursor moves on.
func TestShadowSkipsBlocksOfItsHostOtherOwnersAndTransitions(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newFixture(t)
	preTracks := fx.block(7, ownerA, "p0", 1)
	preTracks.BV.Header.TrackIndexerID = nil
	host := fx.block(8, hostIndexer, "p0", 2)
	stranger := fx.block(9, unconfigured, "p0", 3)
	transition := fx.block(10, ownerA, "p0", 4)
	transition.BV.Header.IsTableSetTransition = true
	peer := fx.block(11, ownerB, "p0", 5)
	arb := newFakeArbiter(6, preTracks.BV, host.BV, stranger.BV, transition.BV, peer.BV)
	pull := newFakePull(preTracks.Part, host.Part, stranger.Part, transition.Part, peer.Part)
	v, conn := newTestShadow(t, fx, arb, pull, testConfig(t.TempDir()))
	var logs bytes.Buffer
	v.d.Logger = slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(&logs, &slog.HandlerOptions{Level: slog.LevelDebug}))

	stepAll(t, v, 5)

	var reasons []string
	for _, line := range strings.Split(logs.String(), "\n") {
		if strings.Contains(line, `msg="shadow: skipping a block"`) {
			reasons = append(reasons, line[strings.Index(line, "reason=")+len("reason="):])
		}
	}
	if want := []string{"no_track", "host", "other_owner", "table_set_transition"}; !slices.Equal(reasons, want) {
		t.Fatalf("skip reasons %q, want %q", reasons, want)
	}

	st := v.Stats()
	wantCounts(t, st, ownerA, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	wantCounts(t, st, ownerB, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	if _, ok := st.Blocks[hostIndexer]; ok {
		t.Fatalf("the host has counters: %+v", st.Blocks)
	}
	if needs := pull.fetched(); len(needs) != 1 || needs[0].PartName != peer.Part.PartName {
		t.Fatalf("pulled %+v, want only block 11's part", needs)
	}
	if n := conn.count("CREATE TABLE"); n != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("created %d scratch tables, want 1", n)
	}
	if st.NextBlockSeq != 12 {
		t.Fatalf("NextBlockSeq = %d, want 12", st.NextBlockSeq)
	}
}

// TestShadowCountsAnUnverdictedBlockAfterVerdictWait: a block without a final
// verdict after VerdictWait (here: evaluated over one of three bundles, no
// quorum) is compared against the evidence recorded so far and counted
// unverdicted; a verdict that arrives in time is waited for.
func TestShadowCountsAnUnverdictedBlockAfterVerdictWait(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		fx := newFixture(t)
		// Block 7: one verifier's bundle evaluated, no quorum yet, two
		// bundles missing: evaluated, but not final.
		pending := fx.block(7, ownerA, "p0", 101)
		pending.BV.Quorum = false
		for i := 1; i < verifierCount; i++ {
			pending.BV.Evidence[i] = wire.VerifierEvidence{ReplicaID: pending.BV.Evidence[i].ReplicaID}
		}
		later := fx.block(8, ownerA, "p0", 102)
		early := later.BV
		early.VerdictEvaluated, early.Quorum = false, false
		arb := newFakeArbiter(6, pending.BV)
		arb.put(8, early, early, later.BV)
		cfg := testConfig(t.TempDir())
		cfg.VerdictWait = time.Minute
		v, _ := newTestShadow(t, fx, arb, newFakePull(pending.Part, later.Part), cfg)

		start := time.Now()
		stepAll(t, v, 1)
		if waited := time.Since(start); waited != time.Minute {
			t.Fatalf("block 7 waited %s, want exactly the 1m verdict wait", waited)
		}
		wantCounts(t, v.Stats(), ownerA, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0)

		start = time.Now()
		stepAll(t, v, 1)
		if waited := time.Since(start); waited != 2*time.Second {
			t.Fatalf("block 8 waited %s, want 2s (its verdict arrived at the third read)", waited)
		}
		wantCounts(t, v.Stats(), ownerA, 2, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0)
		reads, _ := arb.readLog()
		if n := countOf(reads, 7); n != 61 {
			t.Fatalf("block 7 was read %d times, want 61 (one read, then one per second for a minute)", n)
		}
	})
}

func countOf(seqs []uint64, seq uint64) int {
	n := 0
	for _, s := range seqs {
		if s == seq {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}

// TestShadowCursorSurvivesARestart: the cursor is persisted after every
// block, and a new shadow on the same state directory resumes from it, not
// from the watermark.
func TestShadowCursorSurvivesARestart(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newFixture(t)
	dir := t.TempDir()
	b7, b8, b9 := fx.block(7, ownerA, "p0", 1), fx.block(8, ownerA, "p0", 2), fx.block(9, ownerA, "p0", 3)
	first, _ := newTestShadow(t, fx, newFakeArbiter(6, b7.BV, b8.BV), newFakePull(b7.Part, b8.Part), testConfig(dir))
	stepAll(t, first, 2)
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, CursorFile))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read cursor: %v", err)
	}
	if string(raw) != `{"version":1,"next_block_seq":9}` {
		t.Fatalf("cursor file = %s", raw)
	}

	arb := newFakeArbiter(100, b9.BV)
	second, _ := newTestShadow(t, fx, arb, newFakePull(b9.Part), testConfig(dir))
	if got := second.Stats().NextBlockSeq; got != 9 {
		t.Fatalf("restarted NextBlockSeq = %d, want 9", got)
	}
	stepAll(t, second, 1)
	if reads, _ := arb.readLog(); !slices.Equal(reads, []uint64{9}) {
		t.Fatalf("restarted shadow read %v, want [9]", reads)
	}
	wantCounts(t, second.Stats(), ownerA, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
}

// TestShadowBacksOffOnAnUnsealedBlock: Run backs off from PollMin, doubling
// to PollMax, while the next block is not sealed, and resets the back-off
// once a block advanced.
func TestShadowBacksOffOnAnUnsealedBlock(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		fx := newFixture(t)
		arb := newFakeArbiter(41)
		b42 := fx.block(42, ownerA, "p0", 1)
		v, _ := newTestShadow(t, fx, arb, newFakePull(b42.Part), testConfig(t.TempDir()))
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		done := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { done <- v.Run(ctx) }()

		time.Sleep(2 * time.Minute)
		synctest.Wait()
		arb.put(42, b42.BV)
		time.Sleep(5 * time.Second)
		synctest.Wait()
		cancel()
		if err := <-done; !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
			t.Fatalf("Run returned %v, want context.Canceled", err)
		}

		reads, at := arb.readLog()
		var got []string
		for i := range reads {
			got = append(got, strconv.FormatUint(reads[i], 10)+"@"+at[i].Sub(at[0]).String())
		}
		want := []string{"42@0s", "42@1s", "42@3s", "42@7s", "42@15s", "42@31s", "42@1m1s", "42@1m31s", "42@2m1s", "43@2m1s", "43@2m2s", "43@2m4s"}
		if !slices.Equal(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("reads %v, want %v", got, want)
		}
		wantCounts(t, v.Stats(), ownerA, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	})
}

// TestShadowNeverSubmitsAnything: the package has no way to submit (it
// imports nothing outside its list, so no gRPC client, no arbiter-proto, no
// network verifier or SNode package and no net; of dataplane it uses only the
// not-sealed sentinel and of install only the scratch prefix), and a run over
// an honest, a fraud and an unverdicted block issues nothing but scratch DDL
// in the stage database.
func TestShadowNeverSubmitsAnything(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("sources", func(t *testing.T) {
		allowed := map[string]bool{
			"context": true, "crypto/ed25519": true, "crypto/rand": true, "encoding/json": true, "errors": true,
			"fmt": true, "io/fs": true, "log/slog": true, "os": true, "path/filepath": true, "strconv": true,
			"strings": true, "sync": true, "time": true,
			"github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2":                  true,
			"google.golang.org/grpc/codes":                            true,
			"google.golang.org/grpc/status":                           true,
			"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay":               true,
			"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/chexec":        true,
			"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec":   true,
			"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/snapshotquery": true,
			"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core":                       true,
			"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane":             true,
			"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl":         true,
			"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/install":        true,
			"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/sources":        true,
			"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire":                  true,
		}
		onlyUses := map[string]string{"dataplane": "ErrBlockNotSealed", "install": "ScratchPrefix"}
		files, err := filepath.Glob("*.go")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		checked := 0
		for _, name := range files {
			if strings.HasSuffix(name, "_test.go") {
				continue
			}
			f, err := parser.ParseFile(token.NewFileSet(), name, nil, 0)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("parse %s: %v", name, err)
			}
			checked++
			for _, imp := range f.Imports {
				path, _ := strconv.Unquote(imp.Path.Value)
				if !allowed[path] {
					t.Errorf("%s imports %s, which is not on the shadow's import list", name, path)
				}
			}
			ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
				sel, ok := n.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
				if !ok {
					return true
				}
				if x, ok := sel.X.(*ast.Ident); ok {
					if want, ok := onlyUses[x.Name]; ok && sel.Sel.Name != want {
						t.Errorf("%s uses %s.%s", name, x.Name, sel.Sel.Name)
					}
				}
				return true
			})
		}
		if checked != 3 {
			t.Fatalf("checked %d source files, want 3 (compare.go, cursor.go, shadow.go): run from the package directory", checked)
		}
	})
	t.Run("statements", func(t *testing.T) {
		synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
			fx := newFixture(t)
			honest := fx.block(7, ownerA, "p0", 1)
			fraud := fx.block(8, ownerA, "p0", 2)
			fraud.BV.Quorum = false
			fraud.BV.Statements[0].Status = "Rejected"
			pending := fx.block(9, ownerA, "p0", 3)
			pending.BV.VerdictEvaluated, pending.BV.Quorum = false, false
			arb := newFakeArbiter(6, honest.BV, fraud.BV, pending.BV)
			v, conn := newTestShadow(t, fx, arb, newFakePull(honest.Part, fraud.Part, pending.Part), testConfig(t.TempDir()))
			stepAll(t, v, 3)
			stmts := conn.statements()
			if len(stmts) != 6 {
				t.Fatalf("issued %d statements, want 3 scratch creates and 3 drops: %q", len(stmts), stmts)
			}
			for _, s := range stmts {
				if !strings.HasPrefix(s, "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `hg_rstage`.`member-test_0a1b2c3d_r") &&
					!strings.HasPrefix(s, "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hg_rstage`.`member-test_0a1b2c3d_r") {
					t.Fatalf("statement outside the shadow's stage tables: %q", s)
				}
			}
		})
	})
}
```

```go
// TestShadowNeverCountsABlockTwiceWhenTheCursorCannotBePersisted: a block
// whose cursor write fails is counted once, the cursor moves past it in
// memory and Run goes on with the next block after the back-off; the file
// keeps the last cursor that was written, so only a restart repeats the
// blocks after it.
func TestShadowNeverCountsABlockTwiceWhenTheCursorCannotBePersisted(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {

		dir := t.TempDir()

			t.Fatal(err)
		}

		v, _ := newTestShadow(t, fx, arb, newFakePull(b7.Part, b8.Part), testConfig(dir))
		var logs bytes.Buffer
		v.d.Logger = slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(&logs, nil))
		v.cfg.StateDir = filepath.Join(dir, "gone") // every cursor write from now on fails
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		done := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { done <- v.Run(ctx) }()

		time.Sleep(10 * time.Second)

		cancel()
		if err := <-done; err != context.Canceled {
			t.Fatalf("Run returned %v, want context.Canceled", err)

		{"poll max below poll min", func(c *Config, _ *Deps) { c.PollMin, c.PollMax = time.Minute, time.Second }, "shadow: PollMax 1s is below PollMin 1m0s"},
		{"bad stage database", func(c *Config, _ *Deps) { c.Pinned.StageDB = "hg-rstage" }, `shadow: chexec: materializer database "hg-rstage" must match [a-z_][a-z0-9_]*`},
		{"no storage policy", func(c *Config, _ *Deps) { c.Pinned.StoragePolicy = "" }, `shadow: chexec: materializer storage policy "" must match`},
		{"invalid storage policy", func(c *Config, _ *Deps) { c.Pinned.StoragePolicy = "member's" }, `shadow: chexec: materializer storage policy`},
		{"bad cursor", func(c *Config, _ *Deps) { c.StateDir = badCursor }, "has version 2, want 1"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg, d := testConfig(t.TempDir()), deps
			tc.mutate(&cfg, &d)
			if _, err := New(cfg, d); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), tc.want) {
				t.Fatalf("New = %v, want %q", err, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestNewBuildsTheReplayCoreWithAThrowawaySigner: New wires the network
// verifier's replay core over the feed's store and the DA client, with a
// signer named <node id>-shadow whose key is drawn per boot.
func TestNewBuildsTheReplayCoreWithAThrowawaySigner(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newFixture(t)
	arb := newFakeArbiter(0)
	keys := make([]ed25519.PublicKey, 0, 2)
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		v, err := New(testConfig(t.TempDir()), Deps{Blocks: arb, Watermark: arb, Snapshots: fx.snapshots, Payloads: fx.payloads,
			Conn: &fakeConn{}, UnsafePull: func(uint64) sources.Source { return newFakePull() }})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("New: %v", err)
		}
		core, ok := v.replay.(*replay.Verifier)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatalf("replay core is %T, want *replay.Verifier", v.replay)
		}
		if core.Snapshots != replay.SnapshotStore(fx.snapshots) || core.Payloads != replay.PayloadStore(fx.payloads) {
			t.Fatal("the replay core does not read the given manifest store and payload store")
		}
		if _, ok := core.Executor.(*snapshotquery.CompositeExecutor); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("executor is %T, want the network verifier's *snapshotquery.CompositeExecutor", core.Executor)
		}
		if want := (payloadexec.SchemaHashes{NetworkID: testNetwork, Tables: []payloadexec.TableSchema{testSchema()}}); !reflect.DeepEqual(core.SchemaHashes, want) {
			t.Fatalf("schema hashes %+v, want %+v", core.SchemaHashes, want)
		}
		signer, ok := core.Signer.(*payloadexec.Ed25519Signer)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatalf("signer is %T", core.Signer)
		}
		if replica, _, err := signer.SignReplayReceipt(context.Background(), "0xabc"); err != nil || replica != "member-test-shadow" {
			t.Fatalf("signer replica %q (%v), want member-test-shadow", replica, err)
		}
		keys = append(keys, signer.PublicKey())
	}
	if keys[0].Equal(keys[1]) {
		t.Fatal("two boots drew the same signer key")
	}
}

// TestReplayPrefixNeverCollidesWithInstallScratch: the shadow's tables sit
// under the node prefix (so the startup drop removes them) and never under
// an install scratch name.
func TestReplayPrefixNeverCollidesWithInstallScratch(t *testing.T) {
	prefix := ReplayPrefix("member-a", "0a1b2c3d")
	if prefix != "member-a_0a1b2c3d_r" {
		t.Fatalf("ReplayPrefix = %q", prefix)
	}
	if got := scanScratchName("member-a", "0a1b2c3d", 3); got != "member-a_0a1b2c3d_rscan_3" {
		t.Fatalf("scanScratchName = %q", got)
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(prefix, install.NodePrefix("member-a")) || !strings.HasPrefix(prefix, install.ScratchPrefix("member-a", "0a1b2c3d")) {
		t.Fatalf("%q is not under the node's scratch prefix", prefix)
	}
	for n := uint64(0); n < 1000; n++ {
		if name := install.ScratchName("member-a", "0a1b2c3d", n); strings.HasPrefix(name, prefix) {
			t.Fatalf("install scratch %q starts with the replay prefix", name)
		}
	}
}

	for _, k := range MismatchKinds() {
		names = append(names, string(k))
	}
	if got := strings.Join(names, ","); got != "receipt,scan,claim" {
		t.Fatalf("MismatchKinds = %s", got)
	}
}
```

```go
// requireCH is the dataplane/ddl opt-in: ARBITER_CH_INTEGRATION=1 and a
// ClickHouse on CH_ADDR (default 127.0.0.1:9000), opened through chtest.
func requireCH(t *testing.T) clickhouse.Conn {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("ARBITER_CH_INTEGRATION") != "1" {
		t.Skip("set ARBITER_CH_INTEGRATION=1 (and run ClickHouse on CH_ADDR or localhost:9000) to run")
	}
	addr := os.Getenv("CH_ADDR")
	if addr == "" {
		addr = "127.0.0.1:9000"
	}
	return chtest.Open(t, addr)
}

// recordingConn records every statement the shadow sends.
type recordingConn struct {
	clickhouse.Conn
	mu   sync.Mutex
	sent []string
}

func (c *recordingConn) record(q string) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.sent = append(c.sent, q)
}

func (c *recordingConn) statements() []string {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]string(nil), c.sent...)
}

func (c *recordingConn) Exec(ctx context.Context, q string, args ...any) error {
	c.record(q)
	return c.Conn.Exec(ctx, q, args...)
}

func (c *recordingConn) Query(ctx context.Context, q string, args ...any) (driver.Rows, error) {
	c.record(q)
	return c.Conn.Query(ctx, q, args...)
}

func (c *recordingConn) QueryRow(ctx context.Context, q string, args ...any) driver.Row {
	c.record(q)
	return c.Conn.QueryRow(ctx, q, args...)
}

func (c *recordingConn) PrepareBatch(ctx context.Context, q string, opts ...driver.PrepareBatchOption) (driver.Batch, error) {
	c.record(q)
	return c.Conn.PrepareBatch(ctx, q, opts...)
}

// localPull stands in for the owner unsafe pull on one server: it copies the
// named part from a local owner table with the pull's statement shape
// (INSERT … SELECT * … WHERE _part = …), not through remote().
type localPull struct {
	conn clickhouse.Conn
	db   string
}

func (p localPull) Name() string { return "owner_unsafe_pull" }

func (p localPull) Fetch(ctx context.Context, need sources.Need, _ payloadexec.TableSchema, scratch sources.Scratch) sources.Result {
	q := fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s.%s SELECT * FROM %s.%s WHERE _part = '%s'",
		quoteIdent(scratch.Database), quoteIdent(scratch.Table), quoteIdent(p.db), quoteIdent(need.Table), need.PartName)
	if err := p.conn.Exec(ctx, q); err != nil {
		return sources.Result{Source: p.Name(), Outcome: sources.OutcomeRefused, Err: err}
	}
	return sources.Result{Source: p.Name(), Outcome: sources.OutcomeFetched}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Implement the cursor**

Create `member/shadow/cursor.go`:

```go
package shadow

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

// CursorFile is the shadow's durable cursor in the state directory:
// {"version":1,"next_block_seq":<n>}.
const CursorFile = "shadow-cursor.json"

const cursorVersion = 1

type cursorState struct {
	Version      int    `json:"version"`
	NextBlockSeq uint64 `json:"next_block_seq"`
}

// loadCursor returns the persisted next block, or 0 when there is no cursor
// file yet.
func loadCursor(stateDir string) (uint64, error) {
	path := filepath.Join(stateDir, CursorFile)
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
		return 0, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("shadow: read cursor %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	var c cursorState
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &c); err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("shadow: cursor %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	if c.Version != cursorVersion {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("shadow: cursor %s has version %d, want %d", path, c.Version, cursorVersion)
	}
	if c.NextBlockSeq == 0 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("shadow: cursor %s has next_block_seq 0", path)
	}
	return c.NextBlockSeq, nil
}

// storeCursor writes the cursor atomically: a temp file in the same
// directory, fsync, rename, directory fsync (the snode state-file pattern).
func storeCursor(stateDir string, next uint64) error {
	path := filepath.Join(stateDir, CursorFile)
	b, err := json.Marshal(cursorState{Version: cursorVersion, NextBlockSeq: next})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("shadow: encode cursor: %w", err)
	}
	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(stateDir, ".shadow-cursor-*")
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("shadow: write cursor %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = os.Remove(tmp.Name()) }()
	if _, err := tmp.Write(b); err != nil {
		_ = tmp.Close()
		return fmt.Errorf("shadow: write cursor %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
		_ = tmp.Close()
		return fmt.Errorf("shadow: write cursor %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("shadow: write cursor %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	if err := os.Rename(tmp.Name(), path); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("shadow: write cursor %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	dir, err := os.Open(stateDir)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("shadow: write cursor %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	defer dir.Close()
	if err := dir.Sync(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("shadow: write cursor %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	return nil
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Implement the comparison**

Create `member/shadow/compare.go`:

```go
package shadow

import (
	"strings"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// ownScan is the shadow's scan of one candidate part: the sum of the row
// LtHashes of every part its scratch holds (one part after a no-split pull).
type ownScan struct {
	Part    arbiter.CandidatePart
	Scanned string
}

// mismatch is one recorded body that disagrees with the shadow.
type mismatch struct {
	Kind                           MismatchKind
	ReplicaID                      string // "" for a claim mismatch
	TableID, PartitionID, PartName string
	Own, Recorded                  string
}

// compareBlock is clarification K34 over one block. It compares bodies only:
//   - receipt: every recorded attestation's receipt_hash against the shadow's
//     own receipt hash, one mismatch per disagreeing attestation;
//   - scan: for every candidate part the shadow scanned, the scanned row
//     LtHash every recorded byte-side scan reports for it (keyed, as the
//     FSM's check 3 keys it, by the claimed row LtHash), one mismatch per
//     disagreeing or missing report;
//   - claim: only when the block's quorum passed, every scanned candidate
//     whose row LtHash differs from the claimed one.
//
// Evidence evaluated by the verdict and evidence recorded after the quorum
// latched are compared alike. Hex comparisons ignore case, as check 3 does.
func compareBlock(ownReceipt string, scans []ownScan, bv wire.BlockVerification) []mismatch {
	var out []mismatch
	for _, ev := range bv.Evidence {
		if ev.Attestation != nil && ev.Attestation.ReceiptHash != ownReceipt {
			out = append(out, mismatch{Kind: MismatchReceipt, ReplicaID: ev.ReplicaID, Own: ownReceipt, Recorded: ev.Attestation.ReceiptHash})
		}
	}
	for _, ev := range bv.Evidence {
		if ev.ByteSideScan == nil {
			continue
		}
		reported := make(map[string]string, len(ev.ByteSideScan.Parts))
		for _, p := range ev.ByteSideScan.Parts {
			reported[strings.ToLower(p.ClaimedPartRowLtHash)] = p.ScannedPartRowLtHash
		}
		for _, s := range scans {
			recorded, ok := reported[strings.ToLower(s.Part.PartRowLtHash)]
			if !ok || !strings.EqualFold(recorded, s.Scanned) {
				out = append(out, mismatch{Kind: MismatchScan, ReplicaID: ev.ReplicaID, TableID: s.Part.TableID,
					PartitionID: s.Part.PartitionID, PartName: s.Part.PartName, Own: s.Scanned, Recorded: recorded})
			}
		}
	}
	if bv.VerdictEvaluated && bv.Quorum {
		for _, s := range scans {
			if !strings.EqualFold(s.Scanned, s.Part.PartRowLtHash) {
				out = append(out, mismatch{Kind: MismatchClaim, TableID: s.Part.TableID, PartitionID: s.Part.PartitionID,
					PartName: s.Part.PartName, Own: s.Scanned, Recorded: s.Part.PartRowLtHash})
			}
		}
	}
	return out
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Implement the verifier**

Create `member/shadow/shadow.go`:

```go
// Package shadow is the si-member's off-consensus shadow verifier (housegate
// spec 2026-10-14 §16 row P2; Plan S3-C2 clarification K34). For every sealed
// block of a peer owner it pulls each candidate part from the owner's
// hg_unsafe into its own scratch table of the member's stage database and
// scans it, replays the block's ReplayJob from DA in the stage database under
// ReplayPrefix with a throwaway signer, waits for the block's verdict, and
// compares its receipt and its scans with the evidence the arbiter recorded.
//
// It never re-derives a check flag or the verdict (they stay the FSM's): it
// compares bodies. Its only arbiter reads are GetBlockVerification and
// GetSafeWatermark, and it submits nothing anywhere.
package shadow

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/rand"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/chexec"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/snapshotquery"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/install"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/sources"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// MismatchKind names what a shadow mismatch disagrees on (clarification K34).
// It is the metric label kind.
type MismatchKind string

const (
	// MismatchReceipt: a recorded attestation's receipt_hash differs from the
	// shadow's own receipt hash.
	MismatchReceipt MismatchKind = "receipt"
	// MismatchScan: a recorded byte-side scan reports another scanned row
	// LtHash for a candidate part than the shadow's own scan, or does not
	// report the part at all.
	MismatchScan MismatchKind = "scan"
	// MismatchClaim: the block's quorum passed while the shadow scanned one of
	// its candidate parts to a row LtHash other than the claimed one.
	MismatchClaim MismatchKind = "claim"
)

// MismatchKinds returns every kind, in export order, so a caller can export
// each one with zeros.
func MismatchKinds() []MismatchKind {
	return []MismatchKind{MismatchReceipt, MismatchScan, MismatchClaim}
}

// BlockReader reads one sealed block's verification; *dataplane.Client
// satisfies it.
type BlockReader interface {
	GetBlockVerification(ctx context.Context, blockSeq uint64) (wire.BlockVerification, error)
}

// WatermarkReader reads the arbiter's safe watermark; *dataplane.Client
// satisfies it.
type WatermarkReader interface {
	GetSafeWatermark(ctx context.Context) (arbiter.SafeWatermark, error)
}

const (
	// DefaultPollMin is the first back-off after an unsealed block or a failed
	// step, and the re-read interval while a block waits for its dispatch or
	// its verdict.
	DefaultPollMin = time.Second
	// DefaultPollMax caps the doubling back-off.
	DefaultPollMax = 30 * time.Second
	// DefaultVerdictWait bounds how long one block waits for its dispatch and
	// its final verdict before it is compared as it stands and counted
	// unverdicted.
	DefaultVerdictWait = 10 * time.Minute
)

// ReplayPrefix is the prefix of every table the shadow creates in the stage
// database: the replay materializer's `<prefix>replay_<n>` and the candidate
// scratch `<prefix>scan_<n>`. It ends in "r", never a digit, so it never
// collides with install.ScratchName, and it starts with
// install.NodePrefix(nodeID), so the startup drop of the node's stage tables
// removes whatever a crashed boot left.
func ReplayPrefix(nodeID, bootNonce string) string {
	return install.ScratchPrefix(nodeID, bootNonce) + "r"
}

// scanScratchName names the scratch of the n-th candidate part this boot pulls.
func scanScratchName(nodeID, bootNonce string, n uint64) string {
	return ReplayPrefix(nodeID, bootNonce) + "scan_" + strconv.FormatUint(n, 10)
}

// Config configures one shadow verifier.
type Config struct {
	NodeID, BootNonce, NetworkID, StateDir string
	// Pinned names the member databases; the shadow writes only StageDB.
	Pinned ddl.MemberPinned
	// Genesis is the configured genesis table set; chain-origin schemas come
	// from each job's TableSchemas, as for a network verifier.
	Genesis []payloadexec.TableSchema
	// Owners is the static group scope of P2 (ascending, unique, never the
	// host); only their blocks are shadow-verified.
	Owners        []uint64
	HostIndexerID uint64
	// PollMin, PollMax and VerdictWait: 0 selects the defaults.
	PollMin, PollMax, VerdictWait time.Duration
}

// Deps are the shadow's collaborators. Every arbiter-facing one is a read.
type Deps struct {
	Blocks    BlockReader
	Watermark WatermarkReader
	// Snapshots is the manifest feed's verifying store (*manifestfeed.Store).
	Snapshots replay.SnapshotStore
	// Payloads is the DA client the network verifiers replay from.
	Payloads replay.PayloadStore
	// Conn is the member's ClickHouse, logged in as si_member.
	Conn clickhouse.Conn
	// UnsafePull returns the pull from owner's hg_unsafe
	// (sources.NewOwnerUnsafePull on the owner's collection).
	UnsafePull func(owner uint64) sources.Source
	Logger     *slog.Logger
	Now        func() time.Time
}

// Stats are the shadow's counters, keyed by owner indexer id. Every
// configured owner and every mismatch kind is present, zeros included.
type Stats struct {
	// Blocks counts the blocks compared, unverdicted ones included.
	Blocks map[uint64]uint64
	// MissedScans counts candidate parts the shadow could not scan.
	MissedScans map[uint64]uint64
	// Unverdicted counts blocks compared without a final verdict.
	Unverdicted map[uint64]uint64
	Mismatches  map[uint64]map[MismatchKind]uint64
	// NextBlockSeq is the block the shadow reads next; 0 before its first
	// cursor is known.
	NextBlockSeq uint64
}

// replayer verifies one replay job; *replay.Verifier satisfies it.
type replayer interface {
	Verify(ctx context.Context, job replay.ReplayJob) (replay.ReplayAttestation, error)
}

// scanFunc scans every part of one table; chexec.ScanAllParts in production.
type scanFunc func(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, qualifiedTable string, schema payloadexec.TableSchema) ([]chexec.PartScanResult, error)

// Verifier is the shadow verifier. Run (or Step) must not be called from two
// goroutines at once; Stats may be called from any goroutine.
type Verifier struct {
	cfg    Config
	d      Deps
	owners map[uint64]bool
	replay replayer
	scan   scanFunc

	scratchSeq uint64 // only the stepping goroutine touches it

	mu    sync.Mutex
	next  uint64
	stats Stats
}

// New validates cfg and d, builds the replay core and loads the cursor.
func New(cfg Config, d Deps) (*Verifier, error) {
	if cfg.NodeID == "" || cfg.BootNonce == "" || cfg.NetworkID == "" || cfg.StateDir == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("shadow: NodeID, BootNonce, NetworkID and StateDir are required")
	}
	if cfg.Pinned.StageDB == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("shadow: Pinned.StageDB is required")
	}
	if d.Blocks == nil || d.Watermark == nil || d.Snapshots == nil || d.Payloads == nil || d.Conn == nil || d.UnsafePull == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("shadow: Blocks, Watermark, Snapshots, Payloads, Conn and UnsafePull are required")
	}
	owners := make(map[uint64]bool, len(cfg.Owners))
	for i, owner := range cfg.Owners {
		if owner == cfg.HostIndexerID {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("shadow: owner %d is the host's own indexer", owner)
		}
		if i > 0 && owner <= cfg.Owners[i-1] {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("shadow: owners %v must be ascending and unique", cfg.Owners)
		}
		owners[owner] = true
	}
	if cfg.PollMin <= 0 {
		cfg.PollMin = DefaultPollMin
	}
	if cfg.PollMax <= 0 {
		cfg.PollMax = DefaultPollMax
	}
	if cfg.VerdictWait <= 0 {
		cfg.VerdictWait = DefaultVerdictWait
	}
	if cfg.PollMax < cfg.PollMin {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("shadow: PollMax %s is below PollMin %s", cfg.PollMax, cfg.PollMin)
	}
	if err := ddl.ValidatePhysicalTableNames(cfg.Genesis); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("shadow: %w", err)
	}
	cfg.Owners = append([]uint64(nil), cfg.Owners...)
	cfg.Genesis = append([]payloadexec.TableSchema(nil), cfg.Genesis...)
	if d.Logger == nil {
		d.Logger = slog.Default()
	}
	if d.Now == nil {
		d.Now = time.Now
	}
	core, err := newReplayCore(cfg, d)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	next, err := loadCursor(cfg.StateDir)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	v := &Verifier{cfg: cfg, d: d, owners: owners, replay: core, scan: chexec.ScanAllParts, next: next}
	v.stats = Stats{
		Blocks:      make(map[uint64]uint64, len(cfg.Owners)),
		MissedScans: make(map[uint64]uint64, len(cfg.Owners)),
		Unverdicted: make(map[uint64]uint64, len(cfg.Owners)),
		Mismatches:  make(map[uint64]map[MismatchKind]uint64, len(cfg.Owners)),
	}
	for _, owner := range cfg.Owners {
		v.stats.Blocks[owner], v.stats.MissedScans[owner], v.stats.Unverdicted[owner] = 0, 0, 0
		v.stats.Mismatches[owner] = make(map[MismatchKind]uint64, 3)
		for _, kind := range MismatchKinds() {
			v.stats.Mismatches[owner][kind] = 0
		}
	}
	return v, nil
}

// newReplayCore is the network verifier's replay core (arbiter-core
// verifier.NewReplayCore) with two differences: the materializer keeps its
// scratch in the stage database under ReplayPrefix, and the signer is a
// throwaway key drawn for this boot, so a shadow receipt can never pass for a
// network verifier's.
func newReplayCore(cfg Config, d Deps) (*replay.Verifier, error) {
	seed := make([]byte, ed25519.SeedSize)
	if _, err := rand.Read(seed); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("shadow: draw the signer seed: %w", err)
	}
	signer, err := payloadexec.NewEd25519Signer(cfg.NodeID+"-shadow", seed)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("shadow: signer: %w", err)
	}
	materializer, err := chexec.NewMaterializerInWithStoragePolicy(cfg.NetworkID, d.Conn, cfg.Pinned.StageDB, ReplayPrefix(cfg.NodeID, cfg.BootNonce), cfg.Pinned.StoragePolicy)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("shadow: %w", err)
	}
	executor, err := snapshotquery.NewCompositeExecutor(payloadexec.NewDynamic(cfg.NetworkID, materializer, cfg.Genesis...), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("shadow: executor: %w", err)
	}
	return &replay.Verifier{
		Snapshots:    d.Snapshots,
		Payloads:     d.Payloads,
		Executor:     executor,
		Signer:       signer,
		SchemaHashes: payloadexec.SchemaHashes{NetworkID: cfg.NetworkID, Tables: cfg.Genesis},
	}, nil
}

// Stats returns a copy of the counters.
func (v *Verifier) Stats() Stats {
	v.mu.Lock()
	defer v.mu.Unlock()
	out := Stats{
		Blocks:       make(map[uint64]uint64, len(v.stats.Blocks)),
		MissedScans:  make(map[uint64]uint64, len(v.stats.MissedScans)),
		Unverdicted:  make(map[uint64]uint64, len(v.stats.Unverdicted)),
		Mismatches:   make(map[uint64]map[MismatchKind]uint64, len(v.stats.Mismatches)),
		NextBlockSeq: v.next,
	}
	for owner, n := range v.stats.Blocks {
		out.Blocks[owner] = n
	}
	for owner, n := range v.stats.MissedScans {
		out.MissedScans[owner] = n
	}
	for owner, n := range v.stats.Unverdicted {
		out.Unverdicted[owner] = n
	}
	for owner, kinds := range v.stats.Mismatches {
		out.Mismatches[owner] = make(map[MismatchKind]uint64, len(kinds))
		for kind, n := range kinds {
			out.Mismatches[owner][kind] = n
		}
	}
	return out
}

// Run shadow-verifies block after block until ctx ends, and returns ctx's
// error. An unsealed next block and a failed step back off from PollMin,
// doubling to PollMax; a block that advanced resets the back-off. A failed
// step keeps the cursor, so the same block is tried again; a block whose
// cursor advanced in memory but could not be persisted is not repeated (a
// restart repeats it), and the next block follows after the back-off.
func (v *Verifier) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
	wait := v.cfg.PollMin
	for {
		advanced, err := v.Step(ctx)
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return ctx.Err()
		}
		if err == nil && advanced {
			wait = v.cfg.PollMin
			continue
		}
		switch {
		case err != nil && advanced:
			v.d.Logger.Error("shadow: the cursor could not be persisted; a restart repeats the block",
				"next_block_seq", v.nextSeq(), "pause", wait, "err", err)
		case err != nil:
			v.d.Logger.Error("shadow verification of a block failed; it is retried after the back-off",
				"block", v.nextSeq(), "retry_in", wait, "err", err)
		}
		if err := sleep(ctx, wait); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		wait = min(2*wait, v.cfg.PollMax)
	}
}

// Step handles the next block. It returns false when that block is not sealed
// yet, true when the cursor advanced past it (shadow-verified or skipped), and
// false with an error, leaving the cursor where it was, when the block could
// not be read, pulled into a scratch, scanned or replayed. A cursor that
// advanced in memory but could not be persisted is true with that error: the
// block is not repeated in this process, and a restart repeats it.
func (v *Verifier) Step(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
	seq, err := v.cursor(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	bv, err := v.d.Blocks.GetBlockVerification(ctx, seq)
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, dataplane.ErrBlockNotSealed):
		return false, nil
	case isSnapshotQueryBlock(err):
		v.d.Logger.Info("shadow: skipping a snapshot-query block, which has no INSERT verification", "block", seq)
		return true, v.advance(seq)
	case err != nil:
		return false, fmt.Errorf("shadow: read block %d: %w", seq, err)
	}
	owner, reason := v.classify(bv)
	if reason != "" {
		v.d.Logger.Debug("shadow: skipping a block", "block", seq, "reason", reason)
		return true, v.advance(seq)
	}
	if err := v.verifyBlock(ctx, owner, seq, bv); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return true, v.advance(seq)
}

// classify returns the block's owner, or why the shadow skips it: a
// table-set transition, a block without a track (before the tracks
// activation), the host's own track, or an owner outside the group scope.
func (v *Verifier) classify(bv wire.BlockVerification) (uint64, string) {
	switch track := bv.Header.TrackIndexerID; {
	case bv.Header.IsTableSetTransition:
		return 0, "table_set_transition"
	case track == nil:
		return 0, "no_track"
	case *track == v.cfg.HostIndexerID:
		return 0, "host"
	case !v.owners[*track]:
		return 0, "other_owner"
	default:
		return *track, ""
	}
}

// isSnapshotQueryBlock recognises GetBlockVerification's refusal of a
// snapshot-query block (arbiter: Internal "l3 block %d: l3 block %d is a
// snapshot-query block and has no INSERT verification").
func isSnapshotQueryBlock(err error) bool {
	if err == nil {
		return false
	}
	s, ok := status.FromError(err)
	return ok && s.Code() == codes.Internal && strings.Contains(s.Message(), "is a snapshot-query block")
}

// verifyBlock is the per-block order of contract §22.4: wait for the
// dispatch, pull and scan every candidate part, replay, wait for the final
// verdict, compare, count, drop the scratch.
func (v *Verifier) verifyBlock(ctx context.Context, owner, seq uint64, bv wire.BlockVerification) (err error) {
	deadline := v.d.Now().Add(v.cfg.VerdictWait)
	if bv, err = v.await(ctx, seq, bv, deadline, dispatched); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var scratches []sources.Scratch
	defer func() { v.dropScratches(scratches) }()
	scans, missed, err := v.scanCandidates(ctx, owner, seq, bv, func(s sources.Scratch) { scratches = append(scratches, s) })
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	own, err := v.replay.Verify(ctx, bv.ReplayJob)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("shadow: replay block %d: %w", seq, err)
	}
	if bv, err = v.await(ctx, seq, bv, deadline, finalVerdict); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	final := finalVerdict(bv)
	found := compareBlock(own.ReceiptHash, scans, bv)
	v.count(owner, final, uint64(missed), found)
	for _, m := range found {
		v.d.Logger.Error("shadow verification mismatch", "block", seq, "owner", owner, "kind", string(m.Kind),
			"replica", m.ReplicaID, "table", m.TableID, "partition", m.PartitionID, "part", m.PartName,
			"own", logValue(m.Own), "recorded", logValue(m.Recorded))
	}
	if !final {
		v.d.Logger.Warn("shadow: block has no final verdict after the verdict wait; compared against the evidence recorded so far",
			"block", seq, "owner", owner, "verdict_wait", v.cfg.VerdictWait)
	}
	v.d.Logger.Info("shadow verified a block", "block", seq, "owner", owner, "quorum", bv.Quorum,
		"final", final, "mismatches", len(found), "missed_scans", missed)
	return nil
}

// dispatched reports whether the arbiter has bound every statement's result
// claim and selected the block's verifiers: from then on the replay job (its
// source_claim_root included) and the candidate parts are the ones the
// verifiers received.
func dispatched(bv wire.BlockVerification) bool {
	if len(bv.VerifierSet) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	for _, st := range bv.Statements {
		if !st.RCBound {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// finalVerdict reports whether the verdict can no longer change: the quorum
// latched, or the verdict was evaluated over every selected verifier's
// attestation and scan (a failed quorum over complete evidence).
func finalVerdict(bv wire.BlockVerification) bool {
	if !bv.VerdictEvaluated {
		return false
	}
	if bv.Quorum {
		return true
	}
	if len(bv.Evidence) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	for _, ev := range bv.Evidence {
		if ev.Attestation == nil || ev.ByteSideScan == nil {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// await re-reads block seq every PollMin until done holds or the deadline
// passes, and returns the last read. A failed re-read keeps the previous one.
func (v *Verifier) await(ctx context.Context, seq uint64, bv wire.BlockVerification, deadline time.Time, done func(wire.BlockVerification) bool) (wire.BlockVerification, error) {
	for !done(bv) && v.d.Now().Before(deadline) {
		if err := sleep(ctx, v.cfg.PollMin); err != nil {
			return bv, err
		}
		next, err := v.d.Blocks.GetBlockVerification(ctx, seq)
		if err != nil {
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				return bv, ctx.Err()
			}
			v.d.Logger.Warn("shadow: re-reading a block failed; keeping the previous read", "block", seq, "err", err)
			continue
		}
		bv = next
	}
	return bv, nil
}

// scanCandidates pulls every candidate part of every statement into its own
// fresh scratch, at once and in statement order, and scans each one. A part
// the pull does not fetch (missed, refused, unreachable) or that arrives
// empty is a missed scan, never a mismatch. created is called for every
// scratch table created, before the pull, so the caller drops it.
func (v *Verifier) scanCandidates(ctx context.Context, owner, seq uint64, bv wire.BlockVerification, created func(sources.Scratch)) ([]ownScan, int, error) {
	schemas, err := payloadexec.ResolveJobSchemas(v.cfg.Genesis, bv.ReplayJob)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("shadow: block %d: %w", seq, err)
	}
	pull := v.d.UnsafePull(owner)
	if pull == nil {
		return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("shadow: no unsafe pull for owner %d", owner)
	}
	var scans []ownScan
	missed := 0
	for _, st := range bv.Statements {
		for _, cp := range st.CandidateParts {
			schema, ok := schemas[cp.TableID]
			if !ok {
				return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("shadow: block %d: no schema for table %s of candidate part %s", seq, cp.TableID, cp.PartName)
			}
			v.scratchSeq++
			scratch := sources.Scratch{Database: v.cfg.Pinned.StageDB, Table: scanScratchName(v.cfg.NodeID, v.cfg.BootNonce, v.scratchSeq)}
			intent, err := ddl.ScratchIntent(v.cfg.Pinned, schema, scratch.Table)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("shadow: block %d: scratch for %s: %w", seq, cp.TableID, err)
			}
			created(scratch)
			if err := v.d.Conn.Exec(ctx, intent.SQL()); err != nil {
				return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("shadow: create scratch %s.%s: %w", scratch.Database, scratch.Table, err)
			}
			res := pull.Fetch(ctx, sources.Need{
				TableKey:      cp.TableID,
				Table:         ddl.CHTableName(cp.TableID),
				PartitionID:   cp.PartitionID,
				PartName:      cp.PartName,
				PartPhysHash:  cp.PartPhysHash,
				PartRowLtHash: cp.PartRowLtHash,
				RowCount:      cp.RowCount,
			}, schema, scratch)
			if res.Outcome != sources.OutcomeFetched {
				missed++
				v.d.Logger.Warn("shadow: candidate part not scanned (missed scan)", "block", seq, "owner", owner,
					"table", cp.TableID, "partition", cp.PartitionID, "part", cp.PartName,
					"source", pull.Name(), "outcome", string(res.Outcome), "err", res.Err)
				continue
			}
			results, err := v.scan(ctx, v.d.Conn, scratch.Database+"."+scratch.Table, schema)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("shadow: scan scratch %s.%s: %w", scratch.Database, scratch.Table, err)
			}
			if len(results) == 0 {
				missed++
				v.d.Logger.Warn("shadow: candidate part arrived empty (missed scan)", "block", seq, "owner", owner,
					"table", cp.TableID, "partition", cp.PartitionID, "part", cp.PartName, "source", pull.Name())
				continue
			}
			hashes := make([]string, 0, len(results))
			for _, r := range results {
				hashes = append(hashes, r.RowLtHash)
			}
			sum, err := payloadexec.SumPartRowLtHashes(hashes)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("shadow: scan scratch %s.%s: %w", scratch.Database, scratch.Table, err)
			}
			scans = append(scans, ownScan{Part: cp, Scanned: sum})
		}
	}
	return scans, missed, nil
}

// dropScratches drops the candidate scratch tables. A failed drop is logged
// and left to the startup drop of the node's stage tables.
func (v *Verifier) dropScratches(scratches []sources.Scratch) {
	for _, s := range scratches {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
		err := v.d.Conn.Exec(ctx, "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "+quoteIdent(s.Database)+"."+quoteIdent(s.Table)+" SYNC")
		cancel()
		if err != nil {
			v.d.Logger.Warn("shadow: dropping a scratch failed; the next startup drops it", "scratch", s.Database+"."+s.Table, "err", err)
		}
	}
}

// count adds one compared block to the owner's counters.
func (v *Verifier) count(owner uint64, final bool, missed uint64, found []mismatch) {
	v.mu.Lock()
	defer v.mu.Unlock()
	v.stats.Blocks[owner]++
	v.stats.MissedScans[owner] += missed
	if !final {
		v.stats.Unverdicted[owner]++
	}
	for _, m := range found {
		v.stats.Mismatches[owner][m.Kind]++
	}
}

// nextSeq is the cursor as it stands (0 before the first one is known).
func (v *Verifier) nextSeq() uint64 {
	v.mu.Lock()
	defer v.mu.Unlock()
	return v.next
}

// logValue keeps a log line short: a receipt hash as it is, a 2048-byte row
// LtHash accumulator (4098 hex characters) as the digest of its hex form.
func logValue(h string) string {
	if len(h) <= 66 {
		return h
	}
	return "digest:" + replay.DigestString(h)
}

// cursor returns the next block, starting one after the safe watermark when
// there is no cursor yet; that first cursor is persisted at once, so a
// restart before the first block keeps it.
func (v *Verifier) cursor(ctx context.Context) (uint64, error) {
	next := v.nextSeq()
	if next != 0 {
		return next, nil
	}
	wm, err := v.d.Watermark.GetSafeWatermark(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("shadow: read the safe watermark: %w", err)
	}
	next = wm.SafeBlockSeq + 1
	if err := storeCursor(v.cfg.StateDir, next); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	v.mu.Lock()
	v.next = next
	v.mu.Unlock()
	v.d.Logger.Info("shadow: starting after the safe watermark", "safe_block_seq", wm.SafeBlockSeq, "next_block_seq", next)
	return next, nil
}

// advance moves the cursor past seq: in memory first, so a block is never
// counted twice in one process, then on disk.
func (v *Verifier) advance(seq uint64) error {
	v.mu.Lock()
	v.next = seq + 1
	v.mu.Unlock()
	return storeCursor(v.cfg.StateDir, seq+1)
}

// sleep waits d or until ctx ends.
func sleep(ctx context.Context, d time.Duration) error {
	timer := time.NewTimer(d)
	defer timer.Stop()
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return ctx.Err()
	case <-timer.C:
		return nil
	}
}

// quoteIdent backquotes a ClickHouse identifier (dataplane/ddl's rule).
func quoteIdent(id string) string {
	id = strings.ReplaceAll(id, `\`, `\\`)
	id = strings.ReplaceAll(id, "`", "``")
	return "`" + id + "`"
}
```

Each image runs as a throwaway local container on a port Docker picks (`-p 127.0.0.1::9000`, read back with `docker port`, so the run never lands on another container's fixed port), started as CI starts its service (`CLICKHOUSE_SKIP_USER_SETUP=1`). `clickhouse/clickhouse-server:25.8` is the `integration-clickhouse` job's image and `clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3.37.3` the member's server version (Task 34's confinement runner pins the same one). ```bash

```bash
for image in clickhouse/clickhouse-server:25.8 clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3.37.3; do

  port="$(docker port arbiter-core-shadow-ch 9000/tcp | head -1 | sed 's/.*://')"
  for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
    docker exec arbiter-core-shadow-ch clickhouse-client --query 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1 && break
    sleep 1
  done
  docker exec arbiter-core-shadow-ch clickhouse-client --query 'SELECT version()'
  (cd "$W" && ARBITER_CH_INTEGRATION=1 CH_ADDR="127.0.0.1:$port" bazel test //member/shadow:shadow_test \

  docker rm -f arbiter-core-shadow-ch >/dev/null
done
```
