Create `scripts/ci/clickhouse-member-confinement.sh` (bash 3.2 compatible, so it also runs under macOS `/bin/bash`):

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run the stage-3 member confinement suite (//member/confinement) and the
# member byte sources' ClickHouse tests (//member/sources) on one image.
#
# Usage:
#   bash scripts/ci/clickhouse-member-confinement.sh <image> <version prefix>
#   bash scripts/ci/clickhouse-member-confinement.sh --cleanup
#
# Starts, on one Docker network, the fenced server si-confined (<image> with
# scripts/ci/clickhouse-member-access-control.xml, an embedded Keeper and an
# admin default user that manages users and named collections), the unfenced
# peer si-peer (<image>, the owner's and the verifiers' ClickHouse) and MinIO
# si-minio with one bucket and a key generated for this run. Runs the suite,
# then the tests of member/sources against the same servers, and removes
# everything it started. Every TestConfinement_ function and every test of
# member/sources/*_ch_test.go must report PASS; a skipped test of either
# target fails the run.
#
# Environment: ARBITER_CH_PLATFORM (for example linux/amd64) is passed to
# docker pull and docker run of <image>. ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_CONFINEMENT_FILTER
# (a Go regexp) limits the suite to the TestConfinement_ functions it matches
# and skips the member/sources run.
set -euo pipefail

repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
cd "${repo_root}"

suffix="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-0}"
network="arbiter-core-member-${suffix}"
confined="arbiter-core-member-confined-${suffix}"
peer="arbiter-core-member-peer-${suffix}"
minio="arbiter-core-member-minio-${suffix}"
minio_image="bitnamilegacy/minio:2024.12.18-debian-12-r1@sha256:c0ede65eb88e47138470202c517bacf55ab3c27df848030b7b46e69d34b7d192"
bucket="si-confinement"

cleanup() {
  docker rm -f "${confined}" "${peer}" "${minio}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  docker network rm "${network}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}

if [ "${1:-}" = "--cleanup" ]; then
  cleanup
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$#" -ne 2 ]; then
  echo "usage: $0 <image> <version prefix> | --cleanup" >&2
  exit 2
fi
image="$1"
version_prefix="$2"
platform_flag=""
if [ -n "${ARBITER_CH_PLATFORM:-}" ]; then
  platform_flag="--platform=${ARBITER_CH_PLATFORM}"
fi

on_exit() {
  status=$?
  if [ "${status}" -ne 0 ]; then
    # ClickHouse and MinIO log to the container's stderr, so both streams go
    # to ours.
    for c in "${confined}" "${peer}" "${minio}"; do
      docker logs --tail 100 "${c}" >&2 2>&1 || true
    done
  fi
  cleanup
  exit "${status}"
}
trap on_exit EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM

# The bucket key exists only in this run's environment: docker and bazel read
# it from there, never from their arguments.
S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID="confinement-$(od -An -N4 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n')"
S3_SECRET="$(od -An -N16 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n')"
export S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID S3_SECRET

cleanup
docker pull ${platform_flag:+"${platform_flag}"} "${image}" >/dev/null
docker pull "${minio_image}" >/dev/null
docker network create "${network}" >/dev/null

docker run -d ${platform_flag:+"${platform_flag}"} \
  --name "${confined}" --hostname si-confined \
  --network "${network}" --network-alias si-confined \
  -p 127.0.0.1::9000 \
  -e CLICKHOUSE_DEFAULT_ACCESS_MANAGEMENT=1 \
  -v "${repo_root}/scripts/ci/clickhouse-member-access-control.xml:/etc/clickhouse-server/config.d/zz-si-access-control.xml:ro" \
  -v "${repo_root}/scripts/ci/clickhouse-keeper.xml:/etc/clickhouse-server/config.d/keeper.xml:ro" \
  -v "${repo_root}/scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics-users.xml:/etc/clickhouse-server/users.d/zz-confinement-admin.xml:ro" \
  "${image}" >/dev/null
docker run -d ${platform_flag:+"${platform_flag}"} \
  --name "${peer}" --hostname si-peer \
  --network "${network}" --network-alias si-peer \
  -p 127.0.0.1::9000 \
  -e CLICKHOUSE_DEFAULT_ACCESS_MANAGEMENT=1 \
  -v "${repo_root}/scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics-users.xml:/etc/clickhouse-server/users.d/zz-confinement-admin.xml:ro" \
  "${image}" >/dev/null
MINIO_ROOT_USER="${S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID}" MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD="${S3_SECRET}" docker run -d \
  --name "${minio}" --network "${network}" --network-alias si-minio \
  -e MINIO_ROOT_USER -e MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD \
  --entrypoint minio "${minio_image}" server /bitnami/minio/data >/dev/null

port_confined="$(docker inspect --format '{{(index (index .NetworkSettings.Ports "9000/tcp") 0).HostPort}}' "${confined}")"
port_peer="$(docker inspect --format '{{(index (index .NetworkSettings.Ports "9000/tcp") 0).HostPort}}' "${peer}")"

ready=false
for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
  if docker exec "${confined}" clickhouse-client --query "SELECT count() FROM system.zookeeper WHERE path = '/'" >/dev/null 2>&1 &&
    docker exec "${peer}" clickhouse-client --query "SELECT 1" >/dev/null 2>&1 &&
    MC_HOST_local="http://${S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID}:${S3_SECRET}@127.0.0.1:9000" \
      docker exec -e MC_HOST_local "${minio}" mc mb --ignore-existing "local/${bucket}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ready=true
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ "${ready}" != true ]; then
  echo "the confinement servers did not become ready" >&2
  exit 1
fi

export CH_USER=default CH_PASSWORD=""
export ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_CONFINEMENT=1 ARBITER_CH_INTEGRATION=1
export CH_ADDR="127.0.0.1:${port_confined}"
export CH_PEER_ADDR="127.0.0.1:${port_peer}"
export CH_PEER_ADDR_FROM_SERVER="si-peer:9000"
export ARBITER_CH_EXPECT_VERSION_PREFIX="${version_prefix}"
export ARBITER_CH_IMAGE="${image}"
export S3_ENDPOINT="http://si-minio:9000"
export S3_BUCKET="${bucket}"
env_flags=(
  --test_env=ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_CONFINEMENT --test_env=ARBITER_CH_INTEGRATION
  --test_env=CH_ADDR --test_env=CH_PEER_ADDR --test_env=CH_PEER_ADDR_FROM_SERVER
  --test_env=CH_USER --test_env=CH_PASSWORD
  --test_env=ARBITER_CH_EXPECT_VERSION_PREFIX --test_env=ARBITER_CH_IMAGE
  --test_env=S3_ENDPOINT --test_env=S3_BUCKET --test_env=S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID --test_env=S3_SECRET
)

required="$(grep -ho '^func TestConfinement_[A-Za-z0-9_]*' member/confinement/*_test.go | sed 's/^func //' | sort -u || true)"
filter_flag=""
if [ -n "${ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_CONFINEMENT_FILTER:-}" ]; then
  required="$(printf '%s\n' "${required}" | grep -E -- "${ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_CONFINEMENT_FILTER}" || true)"
  filter_flag="--test_filter=${ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_CONFINEMENT_FILTER}"
fi
if [ -z "${required}" ]; then
  echo "no TestConfinement_ function to run" >&2
  exit 1
fi

bazel test //member/confinement:confinement_test "${env_flags[@]}" ${filter_flag:+"${filter_flag}"} \
  --test_arg=-test.v --nocache_test_results --test_timeout=900 --test_output=all

log="$(bazel info bazel-testlogs)/member/confinement/confinement_test/test.log"
# A misspelled filter or a skipped test must not turn this gate green.
for name in ${required}; do
  if ! grep -Eq -- "^--- PASS: ${name} \(" "${log}"; then
    echo "confinement test ${name} did not run and pass" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
if grep -q -- "--- SKIP:" "${log}"; then
  echo "a confinement test was skipped:" >&2
  grep -- "--- SKIP:" "${log}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
grep -o 'confinement server .*' "${log}" || true
grep -o 'confinement: .*' "${log}" || true
echo "confinement: $(printf '%s\n' "${required}" | wc -l | tr -d ' ') test(s) passed on ${image}"

if [ -z "${ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_CONFINEMENT_FILTER:-}" ]; then
  # The byte sources' two-server and object-store tests need exactly this
  # topology (Plan S3-C2 contract §22.1), so they run here, after the suite.
  sources_required="$(grep -ho '^func Test[A-Za-z0-9_]*' member/sources/*_ch_test.go | sed 's/^func //' | sort -u || true)"
  if [ -z "${sources_required}" ]; then
    echo "no ClickHouse test in member/sources/*_ch_test.go" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  bazel test //member/sources:sources_test "${env_flags[@]}" \
    --test_arg=-test.v --nocache_test_results --test_timeout=900 --test_output=errors
  sources_log="$(bazel info bazel-testlogs)/member/sources/sources_test/test.log"
  for name in ${sources_required}; do
    if ! grep -Eq -- "^--- PASS: ${name} \(" "${sources_log}"; then
      echo "member/sources test ${name} did not run and pass" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  done
  if grep -q -- "--- SKIP:" "${sources_log}"; then
    echo "a member/sources test was skipped:" >&2
    grep -- "--- SKIP:" "${sources_log}" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "sources: $(printf '%s\n' "${sources_required}" | wc -l | tr -d ' ') ClickHouse test(s) passed on ${image}"
fi
```

- [ ] **Step 15: Document the member role in the README**

In `README.md`'s packages table, add after Plan S3-C1 Task 23's `member/gate` row:

```markdown
| `member/manifestfeed` | The si-member's verifying manifest feed: the safe watermark followed along `ParentSnapshotID`, demultiplexed per owner, with a bounded LRU manifest store. |
| `member/copyset` | The si-member's copy reconciler: one incarnation-scoped `hg_replica` copy of every Pending or Active table of every peer owner. |
| `member/sources` | The install gate's byte sources (owner pull, peer unsafe pull, object-store restore) and the si-member's startup posture probes. |
| `member/install` | The install gate executor around `member/gate`: scratch tables, the per-owner journal, startup audit and self-audit, the member disk budget. |
| `member/shadow` | Off-consensus shadow verification of every sealed block of a peer owner. |
| `member` | The stage-3 si-member role: composes the packages above in its startup order; no consensus identity, read RPCs only (§ Member role (stage 3 P2)). |
| `member/confinement` | Test-only ClickHouse proof that the member users are confined (§ Member role (stage 3 P2)). |
```

Insert before `## Releases` (base `cfd4f42` `:134`; after Plan S3-A Task 6's `### ClickHouse mechanics` subsection and whatever Plan S3-C1 added to it):

````markdown
### Member role (stage 3 P2)

`member.Role` is the stage-3 si-member (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §8): a process separate from the SNode, run by `sentio-node si-member`, that keeps one incarnation-scoped copy in `hg_replica` of every SI table of every peer owner and fills it only with parts a verified manifest lists, through the install gate. It has a node id and no keys: it never registers, and it calls only `SafeState.GetSafeWatermark`, `GetManifest` and `GetBlockVerification`, `TableRegistry.GetTableRegistry`, `WatchTableRegistry` and `GetPurgeNodeSet`, and the DA's `PayloadStore.FetchPayloads`. At startup, in this order, it locks `<state dir>/LOCK`, refuses member databases that meet the host SNode's and a peer that is its host, creates `hg_replica` and `hg_rstage` without `ENGINE`, refuses to start unless ClickHouse refuses it an ungranted table engine (`table_engines_require_grant`) and refuses `INSERT INTO FUNCTION remote` through each of its named collections, refuses a node id an SNode or verifier uses, a peer that is not enrolled in `si_indexers` and genesis tables that differ from the genesis manifest, drops its own stale `hg_rstage` tables, runs the copy reconciler's first pass and audits the copies it made ready. It then runs the copy reconciler (`member/copyset`), the manifest feed (`member/manifestfeed`) into the installer (`member/install`, fed by `member/sources`; while an owner bootstraps, each copy's first part tries the object-store restore first), a copy watch that re-applies the newest update the follower offered when the copies change or an audit found something to repair, an audit after every ClickHouse restart and every self-audit interval and, when configured, the shadow verifier (`member/shadow`). `Role.Ready` is true once the startup audit is clean, every ready copy was audited since the start or the last restart, and every peer's copies reached a manifest; `Role.Stats` carries every series sentio-node exports, with zeros.

The member's ClickHouse users are confined by their grants, not by the role's code. `member/confinement` is a test-only suite that proves it on a real server with `access_control_improvements.table_engines_require_grant` (`scripts/ci/clickhouse-member-access-control.xml`): as `si_member`, every `Replicated*MergeTree` engine, `Buffer`, `Distributed`, `Merge` and `Alias`, a `Replicated` database, `ATTACH PARTITION … FROM`, `MOVE PARTITION … TO TABLE`, a materialized view or an `INSERT` into `hg_member_unsafe`, a write through `remote()` or to S3, a named collection override, `SYSTEM DROP REPLICA`, a dictionary, a view with another definer or with `SQL SECURITY NONE`, `SYSTEM STOP MERGES` and anything on `hg_safe`, `hg_unsafe` or `hg_promote` are refused, while every statement the role issues works; `si_member_ddl`'s settings profile refuses a replica created with merges allowed, and that user can neither write, alter nor optimize. Run it with:

```bash
bash scripts/ci/clickhouse-member-confinement.sh clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3.37.3 26.3.37.3
```

The script starts, on one Docker network, the fenced server (the file above with `scripts/ci/clickhouse-keeper.xml` and `scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics-users.xml`), an unfenced peer of the same image and MinIO with one bucket and a key generated for the run, runs `//member/confinement:confinement_test` and then the ClickHouse tests of `//member/sources:sources_test` against the same servers, fails if any of them is skipped or does not pass, prints what it measured (`confinement: …` lines) and `confinement: <n> test(s) passed on <image>`, and removes everything it started (`--cleanup` removes what an interrupted run left). The suite is opt-in (`ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_CONFINEMENT=1`); once opted in, a missing `CH_ADDR`, `CH_PEER_ADDR`, `CH_PEER_ADDR_FROM_SERVER`, `ARBITER_CH_EXPECT_VERSION_PREFIX`, `ARBITER_CH_IMAGE`, `S3_ENDPOINT`, `S3_BUCKET`, `S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID` or `S3_SECRET` fails it. `ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_CONFINEMENT_FILTER` limits a run to the tests it matches (and skips the `member/sources` run); `ARBITER_CH_PLATFORM` selects the ClickHouse image's platform. CI's `member-confinement` job and Cut Release run it exactly as above; the private storage-integrity build of 26.3 is run by hand with the prefix `26.3.`, like the mechanics suite (§ ClickHouse mechanics), before any si-member runs on it.
````

The `member` packages are new and run only in the si-member process (§ Member role (stage 3 P2)); nothing in an SNode or verifier changes, and the member's ClickHouse users `si_member` and `si_member_ddl` exist only where an operator creates them.

Releases are annotated `vX.Y.Z` tags cut by the **Cut Release** workflow from `main` (`scripts/next-version.sh`); it now also runs the member confinement suite before tagging. Release order (conventions): `CORE_TAG` → `CORE_TAG_P1` → `CORE_TAG_P2` (this step) → `CORE_TAG_P3` …; the tag is never predicted, moved or re-cut. id=""
```bash
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
  runs="$(gh run list --repo sentioxyz/arbiter-core --workflow cut-release.yml --event workflow_dispatch --limit 100 --json databaseId,createdAt,headSha | jq -r --arg since "$since" --arg head "$head" '.[] | select(.createdAt >= $since and .headSha == $head) | .databaseId')" || exit 1
  count="$(printf '%s\n' "$runs" | grep -c '[0-9]' || true)"
  if [ "$count" -gt 1 ]; then echo 'multiple matching release runs; stop and identify this dispatch before continuing'; exit 1; fi
  if [ "$count" -eq 1 ]; then id="$runs"; break; fi
  sleep 2
done

printf '%s\n' "$tags" | tee "$si_evidence/core-release-tag"
```

## Task 35: sentio-node — pin CORE_TAG_P2; `sentio-node si-member` on its own config file with env-only secrets, its metrics and `/readyz`, and `si-member clear-foreign`; the ClickHouse install acceptance; release SN_COMMIT_P2 / SN_DIGEST_P2 (S3-C2)

Contract §24.1–§24.6 (binding; this task's part), §20.1 (the member's reach: read RPCs only, no keys), §20.3–§20.4 (ledger, commands, evidence), §22.2 (the journal the acceptance reads), §23.1 (`member.Role`), §23.2 (`SI_MEMBER_GRANTS`, the collection `si_owner_<indexer_id>`) and §23.4 (`clickhouse-member-access-control.xml`); spec §8.1 (the si-member process, its own user and databases, the free-space stop), §8.2 (the member users and the engine fence), §8.5 (Foreign quarantine), §8.6 (the owner pull and the reader's `system.parts` grants); clarifications K29 (the node id rule), K30 (its own process and its own file, no `PRIVATE_KEY`, no status token in P2), K35 (`disk_budget_bytes`, `stop_installs_ratio`), K36 (`clear-foreign` only offline); decisions D28 (the code default stays 0.8; devnet2's 0.5 is Plan S3-C3's value) and D29 (the token has its own Secret; the P2 binary reads no token). sentio-node pins Task 34's arbiter-core release and gains the process Plan S3-C3's si-member StatefulSet runs. (1) **Pins:** arbiter-core `CORE_TAG_P2` three times (`go.mod`, `bazel_dep`, `git_override` with its `# Resolved …` comment); housegate stays `HG_TAG_P1` and arbiter-proto `PROTO_TAG`, both checked unchanged. (2) **Config:** `config.LoadSIMemberConfig` reads the member's own file: it first walks the YAML nodes for `storage_integrity.member.clickhouse_password` and `restore.access_key_id` / `restore.secret` (any value, null included, through aliases and merge keys) so their refusals win, then decodes the whole file with `yaml.v3` `KnownFields(true)` into `SIMemberConfig`, so the host's sentio-node config is refused; it never calls `NodeConfig.LoadAndValidate`, fills the defaults from arbiter-core's own constants and joins every refusal of contract §24.2; `ClickhouseOptions()` logs in as `clickhouse_username` with the password read from `STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD` at that moment; `MemberConfig()` maps the file onto `member.Config` with the restore key from the two restore variables; nothing renders a secret. (3) **Process:** package `simember`: `Run` opens the one ClickHouse connection, a `dataplane.Client` and a `RegistryFollower` on `arbiter_peers`, a `dastore` client on `payload_store_data_addr`, `member.New`, and on `metrics_listen` its own Prometheus registry and `GET /readyz` (200 once `Role.Ready()`, else 503); it runs the follower and the role until its context ends, and returns the first part's error otherwise. (4) **Metrics:** the 27 series of contract §24.4 from `member.Stats`, every configured owner, outcome, source, trigger and kind exported from zero, and a label value only a later arbiter-core knows exported too. (5) **Commands:** `sentio-node si-member` (signal-cancelled `simember.Run`) and `si-member clear-foreign --table <database>.<table>` (`install.ClearForeign` on the configured `state_dir`, refused while a member holds its `LOCK`). (6) **Acceptance:** `TestSIMemberInstallsACopyFromTheOwnerPull` runs `simember`'s own `run` with `CORE_TAG_P2`'s role against two ClickHouse 26.3.37.3 servers and a fake arbiter, and CI's new step `si-member install acceptance` runs it before every image push. Then the release `SN_COMMIT_P2` / `SN_DIGEST_P2`, which Plan S3-C3 pins as `siMember.image`.

No host changes behaviour: `standalone.Run`, `LoadConfig`, `decodeConfigYAML` and `StorageIntegrityConfig.Validate` are untouched, so a host config is read exactly as at `SN_COMMIT_P1`; the new code runs only when `sentio-node si-member` is invoked, which no chart does before Plan S3-C3. Merging runs CI's `docker-push` only (`latest` and `sha-<SN_COMMIT_P2>`); this task never dispatches `Release Devnet` or `Release Testnet`, and neither may run on a commit containing `SN_COMMIT_P2` during this plan (the floating `:devnet` tag the devnet2 observer and the testnet-v2 releases follow with `pullPolicy: Always` would move pods no runbook covers). Nothing on devnet2 changes in this task.

Notes:
- **The owner is a second ClickHouse (contract deviation, recorded in Appendix B).** Contract §24.5–§24.6 describe one fenced server holding the owner's `hg_safe` table, `si_reader`, `si_member` and `si_owner_0`. Measured while drafting on `clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3` (26.3.51.7): ClickHouse executes `remote()` whose address is the server's own (`localhost:9000` and its own container hostname alike, `prefer_localhost_replica = 0` included) locally as the calling user, so `si_member`'s pull from a collection naming its own server is refused with 497 `it's necessary to have the grant SHOW COLUMNS ON hg_safe.<table>` — the member's grants rightly hold nothing on `hg_safe`. The acceptance therefore runs two 26.3.37.3 servers on a private Docker network, as arbiter Task 36's `scripts/test-clickhouse-member.sh` does: the owner's (`CH_OWNER_ADDR`, reached from the member's server as `si-owner:9000`, `CH_OWNER_ADDR_FROM_MEMBER`) and the fenced member server (`CH_MEMBER_ADDR`) with the access-control file. Everything else of §24.5 holds as written; on devnet2 the member's server and its owners are different installations anyway.
- **The reader needs `SHOW COLUMNS ON system.parts` (contract issue, recorded in Appendix B).** Spec §8.6 gives the owner's reader `SHOW COLUMNS` and the column-restricted `SELECT` on `system.parts`; Plan S3-B contract §11, which contract §20.2 cites as the reader's grants, lists only the three `SELECT` grants. Measured on 26.3.51.7: the resolve query `SELECT name, rows FROM remote(si_owner_0, database = 'system', table = 'parts') WHERE …` through a collection whose user holds only those three is refused with 497 `it's necessary to have the grant SHOW COLUMNS ON system.parts`, and succeeds once `GRANT SHOW COLUMNS ON system.parts` is added; the pull from `hg_safe` itself needs nothing beyond `SELECT ON hg_safe.*`. The acceptance's `si_reader` therefore holds the four grants of spec §8.6 (`siReaderGrants`); devnet2's `si_reader` users (Plan S3-B's) need the fourth before any member pulls, which Plan S3-C3 must add (the open question this task raises).
- **The collection needs `named_collection_control`.** The image's `CLICKHOUSE_DEFAULT_ACCESS_MANAGEMENT=1` gives `default` access management but not `named_collection_control`: `CREATE NAMED COLLECTION` as `default` is refused with 497 `CREATE NAMED COLLECTION ON <name>` (measured). The member server therefore also mounts `scripts/ci/clickhouse-member-users.xml`, which turns that flag on for `default` only, as arbiter-core's mechanics runner does with its `clickhouse-mechanics-users.xml` (Plan S3-A). The fence file stays byte-identical to arbiter-core's.
- **`system.grants` is not readable by `si_member` on 26.3 (fact).** As `si_member`, `SELECT … FROM system.grants WHERE user_name = currentUser()` is refused with 497 `SELECT ON system.grants` on 26.3.51.7, so `sources.ReadOwnGrants` answers `ErrGrantsUnreadable`, the role relies on the behavioural probes, and `sentio_node_si_member_grants_unreadable` reads 1 (the follow-up of this plan's front matter). The behavioural probes were measured as the role runs them: ``CREATE TABLE hg_rstage.`member-b_engine_probe` (x UInt8) ENGINE = Log`` and `INSERT INTO FUNCTION remote(si_owner_0, database = 'hg_safe', table = 'si_member_write_probe') SELECT 1` are both refused with 497 as `si_member` on the fenced server, and the owner pull (`CREATE DATABASE` without `ENGINE`, an explicit-`MergeTree` copy and scratch, the no-split `INSERT … SELECT * FROM remote(si_owner_0, …) WHERE _part = '<name>'`, `ATTACH PARTITION tuple() FROM` the scratch, `DROP PART`, `sum(bytes_on_disk)` over `system.parts`) succeeds with exactly `SI_MEMBER_GRANTS`, the pulled part keeping the owner's `hash_of_all_files`.
- **Its own file, its own login (K30, S3-B K16).** `LoadSIMemberConfig` never touches `LoadConfig` or `PRIVATE_KEY`; `KnownFields(true)` refuses every key outside `SIMemberConfig` (Plan S3-C3's ConfigMap renders only §24.2's keys, and Plan S3-C4 and Plan S3-E4 add their blocks as fields). The two key refusals run on the YAML nodes before the decode, because the decode would refuse the same keys with the generic `field clickhouse_password not found in type config.StorageIntegrityMemberConfig` and a field could not tell a null value from an absent key. `clickhouse_username` is required and may not be `default` (the passwordless `default` is locked to loopback on every SI ClickHouse since L). The password is read from the environment when `ClickhouseOptions` builds the options, the restore key when `MemberConfig` builds `member.Config`; neither is kept in the config types, every config type's `String()` and `LogValue()` name only where a secret comes from, `Run` logs the config through `LogValue`, and the refusals name only variables. `RestoreConfig`'s own redaction (Task 31) covers the `member.Config` the role holds; `TestSIMemberConfigNeverPrintsASecret` checks both.
- **Defaults from arbiter-core.** `poll_interval` 0 → `member.DefaultPollInterval`, `stop_installs_ratio` 0 → `install.DefaultStopInstallsRatio`, `self_audit_interval` 0 → `install.DefaultSelfAuditInterval`, and the minimums are `member.MinPollInterval` and `install.MinSelfAuditInterval`, so the file can never accept a value the role refuses. `metrics_listen` defaults to `:9093`; Plan S3-C3 renders `:9095`. `FeedMaxWalk` and `FeedCacheEntries` stay 0 (`manifestfeed`'s defaults: the file has no key for them). The member's Keeper shard is 0, as the SNode's (`siMemberKeeperShardID`), and `Protocol` is the host's `{hg_unsafe, hg_safe, hg_promote}`, so the role's intersect check sees the real protocol databases.
- **One process, one registry (K30).** `simember.Run` serves only `/metrics` (its own `prometheus.Registry`: the member collector plus the Go and process collectors) and `/readyz` on `metrics_listen`; it reads no status token (D29: Plan S3-C4 adds the authenticated listener with the token from its own Secret). The follower runs beside the role because the role's startup step (6) waits for it (`dataplane.WaitReady`); `TestRunWiresTheMemberRoleWithItsOwnLogin` checks that the follower reached the configured arbiter. The first part that stops ends the process with its error (the StatefulSet restarts it); the caller's cancellation ends it cleanly with exit status 0.
- **Logging.** arbiter-core logs through `slog`; `simember/slog.go` hands every record to sentio-core's zap logger (`common/log.WithContext`), so `--log-level` and the log format of every other command apply, and values are resolved first, so a value's `LogValue` is what reaches the log. It mirrors the unexported adapter of `standalone/slog_adapter.go`, which `simember` cannot import without pulling in the whole host.
- **`clear-foreign` is offline (K36).** The command loads the same file as the process (so a run outside the pod needs the same environment, the restore variables included when `restore` is set) and calls `install.ClearForeign`, which refuses while a member holds `<state_dir>/LOCK`; it prints one line and nothing else. `--table` is the journal's key, `<database>.<table>` of the logical table, refused unless it has exactly one dot with a non-empty side.
- **Order and rollback.** `SN_COMMIT_P2` needs `CORE_TAG_P2` and `P2_CONFINEMENT` recorded (the Global Constraints), and sentio-node `main` at or after `SN_COMMIT_P1`. No running pod takes `SN_DIGEST_P2` in this plan; Plan S3-C3 runs it only in the si-member StatefulSets, and a host that never invokes `si-member` behaves exactly as on `SN_COMMIT_P1`.
- **Base (review, 2026-10-17):** sentio-node `origin/main` `0828f21` is Plan S3-B Task 12's `SN_COMMIT`; do not reapply that executed task. Apply the complete reviewed Plan S3-C1 Task 25 first. The actual reviewed housegate `ed24705` plus Task 22 and arbiter-core `cfd4f42` plus Tasks 23–24 and 29–34 were used for local verification, without a role stub. Their released tags remain execution-time ledger values, never predicted.
- **Config strictness (review):** the member-only loader rejects trailing YAML documents and cyclic alias/merge graphs before walking secret keys; `siMemberYAMLMappingValues` bounds each walk to one visit per node, including overridden secret keys. import re
```bash
import sys

path, core_tag, core_sha = sys.argv[1:]
text = open(path).read()


def sub(pattern, repl):
    global text
    text, n = re.subn(pattern, repl, text)
    if n != 1:
        sys.exit(f"MODULE.bazel: {pattern!r} matched {n} times; nothing written")


sub(r'(bazel_dep\(\n    name = "arbiter_core",\n    version = ")[^"]+(",\n\))', r"\g<1>" + core_tag[1:] + r"\g<2>")
sub(r'(module_name = "arbiter_core",\n    # Resolved arbiter-core )v[^;]+(; source is pinned by the commit below\.\n    commit = ")[0-9a-f]{40}(",)', r"\g<1>" + core_tag + r"\g<2>" + core_sha + r"\g<3>")
open(path, "w").write(text)
print(f"MODULE.bazel: arbiter-core {core_tag} at {core_sha}")
PY
git -C "$W" diff -- MODULE.bazel
git -C "$W" log -1 --format='%an <%ae>'
[ "$(git -C "$W" log -1 --format='%an <%ae>')" = "poetry <chen@sentio.xyz>" ] || { echo "unexpected commit author; stop"; exit 1; }
git -C "$W" verify-commit HEAD || exit 1
```

```go
// The secret values the tests set; none of them may ever be printed.
const (

	siMemberTestKeyID    = "GOOG1E-key-id-3b8c"
	siMemberTestSecret   = "restore-secret-9e2a7d4c"

// clearSIMemberEnv empties the three si-member variables for one test, so a
// value in the CI environment never leaks into a refusal test.
func clearSIMemberEnv(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, name := range []string{
		StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv,
		StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreAccessKeyIDEnv,
		StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreSecretEnv,
	} {
		t.Setenv(name, "")
	}
}

func writeSIMemberConfig(t *testing.T, text string) string {
	t.Helper()
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "si-member.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(text), 0o600))
	return path
}

// replaceOnce edits a config text and fails the test unless old occurs
// exactly once, so a fixture edit can never silently miss.
func replaceOnce(t *testing.T, text, old, replacement string) string {
	t.Helper()
	require.Equal(t, 1, strings.Count(text, old), "fixture must contain %q exactly once", old)
	return strings.Replace(text, old, replacement, 1)
}

func loadSIMemberText(t *testing.T, text string) (*SIMemberConfig, string, error) {
	t.Helper()
	path := writeSIMemberConfig(t, text)
	cfg, err := LoadSIMemberConfig(path)
	return cfg, path, err
}

		Restore:           &sources.RestoreConfig{Endpoint: "https://storage.googleapis.com", Bucket: "si-replica", AccessKeyID: siMemberTestKeyID, Secret: siMemberTestSecret},
		Shadow:            true,
		PollInterval:      10 * time.Second,
		DiskBudgetBytes:   107374182400,
		StopInstallsRatio: 0.5,
		SelfAuditInterval: 12 * time.Hour,
	}, got)
}

// TestLoadSIMemberConfigRefusesTheHostsConfigFile pins K30: the si-member
// reads its own file with KnownFields, so pointing it at the host's
// sentio-node config fails instead of running with half a config.
func TestLoadSIMemberConfigRefusesTheHostsConfigFile(t *testing.T) {
	clearSIMemberEnv(t)
	_, path, err := loadSIMemberText(t, `node:
  node_type: indexer
housegate:
  listen: "0.0.0.0:9000"
storage_integrity:
  enabled: true
  arbiter_peers:
    - {id: arb-1, addr: "127.0.0.1:7080"}
  payload_store_data_addr: "127.0.0.1:9001"
  clickhouse_dsn: "127.0.0.1:9000"
  snode:
    node_id: snode-1
`)
	require.Error(t, err)
	require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "si-member config "+path+": "), err.Error())
	for _, unknown := range []string{
		"field node not found in type config.SIMemberConfig",
		"field housegate not found in type config.SIMemberConfig",
		"field enabled not found in type config.SIMemberStorageIntegrity",
		"field clickhouse_dsn not found in type config.SIMemberStorageIntegrity",
		"field snode not found in type config.SIMemberStorageIntegrity",
	} {
		require.ErrorContains(t, err, unknown)
	}
}

func TestSIMemberConfigRefusesAClickhousePasswordKey(t *testing.T) {
	clearSIMemberEnv(t)
	for _, value := range []string{`"` + siMemberTestPassword + `"`, `""`, ``, `null`} {
		text := replaceOnce(t, siMemberMinimalYAML, "    clickhouse_username: si_member\n",
			"    clickhouse_username: si_member\n    clickhouse_password: "+value+"\n")
		_, path, err := loadSIMemberText(t, text)
		require.EqualError(t, err, "si-member config "+path+": storage_integrity.member.clickhouse_password is not read from the config file; set STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD instead", "value %q", value)
		require.NotContains(t, err.Error(), siMemberTestPassword)
	}
	// A merge key cannot smuggle the key in either.
	text := replaceOnce(t, siMemberMinimalYAML, "storage_integrity:\n", "base: &base\n  clickhouse_password: x\nstorage_integrity:\n")
	text = replaceOnce(t, text, "  member:\n", "  member:\n    <<: *base\n")
	_, path, err := loadSIMemberText(t, text)
	require.EqualError(t, err, "si-member config "+path+": storage_integrity.member.clickhouse_password is not read from the config file; set STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD instead")
}

func TestSIMemberConfigRequiresAUsername(t *testing.T) {
	clearSIMemberEnv(t)
	_, _, err := loadSIMemberText(t, replaceOnce(t, siMemberMinimalYAML, "    clickhouse_username: si_member\n", ""))
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "storage_integrity.member.clickhouse_username is required: the si-member never connects as default")
	require.NotContains(t, err.Error(), "a ClickHouse password needs a user", "no password is set")

	_, _, err = loadSIMemberText(t, replaceOnce(t, siMemberMinimalYAML, "clickhouse_username: si_member", "clickhouse_username: default"))
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "storage_integrity.member.clickhouse_username must not be default: the si-member never connects as default")

	for _, key := range []string{"node_id", "host_indexer_id", "state_dir", "network_id", "genesis_snapshot_id", "clickhouse_dsn", "disk_budget_bytes"} {
		lines := strings.Split(siMemberMinimalYAML, "\n")
		kept := lines[:0]
		for _, line := range lines {
			if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "    "+key+":") {
				kept = append(kept, line)
			}
		}
		_, _, err := loadSIMemberText(t, strings.Join(kept, "\n"))
		require.ErrorContains(t, err, "storage_integrity.member."+key+" is required", key)
	}
	_, _, err = loadSIMemberText(t, replaceOnce(t, siMemberMinimalYAML, "    peers:\n      - {indexer_id: 0, collection: si_owner_0}\n", ""))
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "storage_integrity.member.peers is required")
	_, _, err = loadSIMemberText(t, replaceOnce(t, siMemberMinimalYAML, "  arbiter_peers:\n    - {id: arbiter-0, addr: \"127.0.0.1:7080\"}\n", ""))
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "storage_integrity.arbiter_peers is required")
	_, _, err = loadSIMemberText(t, replaceOnce(t, siMemberMinimalYAML, "  payload_store_data_addr: \"127.0.0.1:9001\"\n", ""))
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "storage_integrity.payload_store_data_addr is required")
}

func TestSIMemberConfigDefaults(t *testing.T) {
	clearSIMemberEnv(t)
	cfg, _, err := loadSIMemberText(t, siMemberMinimalYAML)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	m := cfg.StorageIntegrity.Member
	require.Equal(t, 5*time.Second, m.PollInterval)
	require.Equal(t, 0.8, m.StopInstallsRatio)
	require.Equal(t, 6*time.Hour, m.SelfAuditInterval)
	require.Equal(t, ":9093", m.MetricsListen)
	require.Equal(t, DefaultSIMemberMetricsListen, m.MetricsListen)
	require.False(t, m.ShadowVerification, "shadow verification is opt-in")
	require.Nil(t, m.Restore, "no restore source unless configured")
	require.Empty(t, m.StoragePolicy, "the server's default policy unless configured")

	got, err := cfg.MemberConfig()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Nil(t, got.Restore)
	require.Equal(t, ddl.DefaultMemberPinned("member-b", 0, ""), got.Pinned)
	require.Zero(t, got.FeedMaxWalk, "arbiter-core's DefaultMaxWalk")
	require.Zero(t, got.FeedCacheEntries, "arbiter-core's DefaultCacheEntries")

	for _, tc := range []struct{ old, replacement, refusal string }{
		{"    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n", "    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n    stop_installs_ratio: 1\n", "storage_integrity.member.stop_installs_ratio must satisfy 0 < ratio < 1, got 1"},
		{"    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n", "    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n    stop_installs_ratio: -0.1\n", "storage_integrity.member.stop_installs_ratio must satisfy 0 < ratio < 1, got -0.1"},
		{"    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n", "    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n    poll_interval: 500ms\n", "storage_integrity.member.poll_interval must be at least 1s, got 500ms"},
		{"    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n", "    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n    self_audit_interval: 5m\n", "storage_integrity.member.self_audit_interval must be at least 10m, got 5m0s"},
		{"    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n", "    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n    metrics_listen: \"9093\"\n", `storage_integrity.member.metrics_listen must be host:port, got "9093"`},
		{"genesis_snapshot_id: \"0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111\"", "genesis_snapshot_id: \"0xABC\"", `storage_integrity.member.genesis_snapshot_id "0xABC" must be a 0x-prefixed 64-digit lowercase hex digest`},
	} {
		_, _, err := loadSIMemberText(t, replaceOnce(t, siMemberMinimalYAML, tc.old, tc.replacement))
		require.ErrorContains(t, err, tc.refusal)
	}

	_, _, err = loadSIMemberText(t, replaceOnce(t, siMemberMinimalYAML, "    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n",
		"    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n    restore:\n      endpoint: https://storage.googleapis.com\n      bucket: si-replica\n"))
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "storage_integrity.member.restore needs both endpoint and bucket, and both restore environment variables")
	t.Setenv(StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreAccessKeyIDEnv, siMemberTestKeyID)
	t.Setenv(StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreSecretEnv, siMemberTestSecret)
	_, _, err = loadSIMemberText(t, replaceOnce(t, siMemberMinimalYAML, "    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n",
		"    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n    restore:\n      endpoint: https://storage.googleapis.com\n"))
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "storage_integrity.member.restore needs both endpoint and bucket, and both restore environment variables")

	for _, tc := range []struct{ old, replacement, refusal string }{
		{"    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n", "    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n    genesis_tables:\n      - {table_id: orders.t, columns: [{name: v, type: Int128x}]}\n", "storage_integrity.member.genesis_tables[0]: table orders.t column \"v\""},
		{"    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n", "    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n    genesis_tables:\n      - {columns: [{name: v, type: UInt64}]}\n", "storage_integrity.member.genesis_tables[0].table_id is required"},
		{"    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n", "    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824\n    genesis_tables:\n      - {table_id: orders.t}\n      - {table_id: orders.t}\n", `storage_integrity.member.genesis_tables[1] duplicates "orders.t"`},
	} {
		_, _, err := loadSIMemberText(t, replaceOnce(t, siMemberMinimalYAML, tc.old, tc.replacement))
		require.ErrorContains(t, err, tc.refusal)
	}
}

func TestSIMemberClickhouseOptionsCarryTheUserAndTheEnvironmentPassword(t *testing.T) {
	clearSIMemberEnv(t)
	t.Setenv(StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv, siMemberTestPassword)
	cfg, _, err := loadSIMemberText(t, siMemberMinimalYAML)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	m := cfg.StorageIntegrity.Member

	require.Equal(t, &clickhouse.Options{
		Addr: []string{"127.0.0.1:9000"},
		Auth: clickhouse.Auth{Username: "si_member", Password: siMemberTestPassword},
	}, m.ClickhouseOptions())

	first, second := m.ClickhouseOptions(), m.ClickhouseOptions()
	require.NotSame(t, first, second, "clickhouse.Open fills in its defaults, so every call returns fresh options")
	first.Addr[0] = "mutated"
	require.Equal(t, []string{"127.0.0.1:9000"}, second.Addr)

	// The password is read when the options are built, never kept in the config.
	t.Setenv(StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv, "")
	require.Equal(t, clickhouse.Auth{Username: "si_member"}, m.ClickhouseOptions().Auth)
	require.Empty(t, m.ClickhouseOptions().Auth.Database, "the member names every database itself")
}

func TestSIMemberConfigNeverPrintsASecret(t *testing.T) {
	clearSIMemberEnv(t)
	t.Setenv(StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv, siMemberTestPassword)
	t.Setenv(StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreAccessKeyIDEnv, siMemberTestKeyID)
	t.Setenv(StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreSecretEnv, siMemberTestSecret)
	cfg, err := LoadSIMemberConfig(filepath.Join("testdata", "si-member.yaml"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	memberCfg, err := cfg.MemberConfig()
	require.NoError(t, err)

	var logged bytes.Buffer
	logger := slog.New(slog.NewJSONHandler(&logged, nil))
	logger.Info("si-member config", "config", *cfg, "pointer", cfg, "member", cfg.StorageIntegrity.Member, "restore", memberCfg.Restore)
	logger = slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(&logged, nil))
	logger.Info("si-member config", "config", *cfg, "member", cfg.StorageIntegrity.Member, "restore", *memberCfg.Restore)

	printed := []string{logged.String()}
	for _, verb := range []string{"%v", "%+v", "%s"} {
		printed = append(printed,
			fmt.Sprintf(verb, *cfg), fmt.Sprintf(verb, cfg), fmt.Sprintf(verb, cfg.StorageIntegrity.Member),
			fmt.Sprintf(verb, memberCfg.Restore), fmt.Sprintf(verb, *memberCfg.Restore))
	}
	printed = append(printed, fmt.Sprintf("%#v", *cfg), fmt.Sprintf("%#v", cfg.StorageIntegrity.Member))
	for _, out := range printed {
		for _, secret := range []string{siMemberTestPassword, siMemberTestKeyID, siMemberTestSecret} {
			require.NotContains(t, out, secret)
		}
	}
	require.Contains(t, fmt.Sprint(cfg.StorageIntegrity.Member), "member-b", "the rendering still names the member")
	require.Contains(t, logged.String(), StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv, "the rendering names where the password comes from")
}

// The member config is exactly one YAML document. A recursive merge must
// fail closed before the node walk can recurse indefinitely.
func TestSIMemberConfigRejectsTrailingDocumentsAndRecursiveMerges(t *testing.T) {
	clearSIMemberEnv(t)
	for _, suffix := range []string{"---\nnode: {}\n", "---\n", "---\nmember: [\n"} {
		_, _, err := loadSIMemberText(t, siMemberMinimalYAML+suffix)
		require.Error(t, err, "a trailing document must not be ignored")
	}
	for _, text := range []string{
		"storage_integrity: &cycle {<<: *cycle}\n",
		"storage_integrity: {member: &cycle {<<: [*cycle]}}\n",
		"storage_integrity: {member: {restore: &cycle {<<: *cycle}}}\n",
	} {
		_, _, err := loadSIMemberText(t, text)
		require.ErrorContains(t, err, "recursive YAML alias or merge")
	}
}

func TestSIMemberSecretKeysThroughAliasesAndMergeSequences(t *testing.T) {
	clearSIMemberEnv(t)
	for _, text := range []string{
		"base: &base {member: {clickhouse_password: null}}\nstorage_integrity: {<<: *base}\n",
		"base: &base {restore: {secret: null}}\nstorage_integrity: {member: {<<: [*base]}}\n",
		"base: &base {access_key_id: null}\nstorage_integrity: {member: {restore: {<<: *base}}}\n",
		"base: &base {clickhouse_password: null}\nstorage_integrity: {member: *base}\n",
	} {
		_, _, err := loadSIMemberText(t, text)
		require.ErrorContains(t, err, "not read from the config file")
		require.NotContains(t, err.Error(), "field base not found", "the secret refusal wins")
	}
	text := replaceOnce(t, siMemberMinimalYAML, "node_id: member-b", "node_id: &id member-b")
	text = replaceOnce(t, text, "state_dir: /data/si-member", "state_dir: *id")
	cfg, _, err := loadSIMemberText(t, text)
	require.NoError(t, err, "an acyclic alias stays valid")
	require.Equal(t, "member-b", cfg.StorageIntegrity.Member.StateDir)
	// Forty shared merge layers have only linear-size YAML, but an
	// unbounded node walk would revisit the same branches 2^40 times.
	var graph strings.Builder
	graph.WriteString("a0: &a0 {}\n")
	for i := 1; i <= 40; i++ {
		fmt.Fprintf(&graph, "a%d: &a%d {<<: [*a%d, *a%d]}\n", i, i, i-1, i-1)
	}
	graph.WriteString("storage_integrity: {<<: *a40}\n")
	_, _, err = loadSIMemberText(t, graph.String())
	require.Error(t, err, "the invalid graph must be refused without exponential preflight work")
}

func TestSIMemberShadowRequiresAnExplicitStoragePolicy(t *testing.T) {
	clearSIMemberEnv(t)
	text := siMemberMinimalYAML + "    shadow_verification: true\n"
	_, _, err := loadSIMemberText(t, text)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "storage_integrity.member.storage_policy is required when shadow_verification is true: choose the member disk policy explicitly")
	for _, policy := range []string{"default", "member"} {
		cfg, _, err := loadSIMemberText(t, text+"    storage_policy: "+policy+"\n")
		require.NoError(t, err)
		mapped, err := cfg.MemberConfig()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, policy, mapped.Pinned.StoragePolicy)
	}
}
```

```go
package config

import (
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log/slog"
	"net"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/lthash"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/install"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/sources"
	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
)

// The si-member's secrets come only from its environment (housegate spec
// 2026-10-14 §8.2, Plan S3-B K16): its config file is rendered into a
// ConfigMap, so it never carries the si_member password or the restore key.
const (
	StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv = "STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD"
	StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreAccessKeyIDEnv = "STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
	StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreSecretEnv      = "STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_SECRET"
	// DefaultSIMemberMetricsListen serves the member's Prometheus metrics and
	// GET /readyz when storage_integrity.member.metrics_listen is unset.
	DefaultSIMemberMetricsListen = ":9093"
)

// siMemberKeeperShardID is the Keeper shard of every member table: the
// SNode's, which is 0 in v1 (standalone builds the SNode with 0).
const siMemberKeeperShardID uint32 = 0

var (
	// siMemberNodeIDPattern is K29's member node id: a P6 VERIFIER node id
	// and Keeper replica name, and the scratch-table prefix of spec §8.5.
	siMemberNodeIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,30}[a-z0-9]$`)
	// siMemberCollectionPattern is one bare ClickHouse identifier: the member
	// names a collection unquoted in remote(<collection>, ...).
	siMemberCollectionPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`)
)

// SIMemberConfig is the whole si-member config file (Plan S3-C2 K30): the
// process reads only this file through LoadSIMemberConfig, never the host's
// sentio-node config.
type SIMemberConfig struct {
	StorageIntegrity SIMemberStorageIntegrity `yaml:"storage_integrity"`
}

// SIMemberStorageIntegrity is the file's storage_integrity block: the
// arbiter peers and the DA data address, as the host names them, and the
// member block.
type SIMemberStorageIntegrity struct {
	ArbiterPeers         []StorageIntegrityPeer       `yaml:"arbiter_peers"`
	PayloadStoreDataAddr string                       `yaml:"payload_store_data_addr"`
	Member               StorageIntegrityMemberConfig `yaml:"member"`
}

// StorageIntegrityMemberConfig is storage_integrity.member (Plan S3-C2
// contract §24.2). It holds no secret: the si_member password and the
// restore key are read from the environment only when a connection or the
// member.Config is built.
type StorageIntegrityMemberConfig struct {
	NodeID             string                         `yaml:"node_id"`
	HostIndexerID      *uint64                        `yaml:"host_indexer_id"`
	StateDir           string                         `yaml:"state_dir"`
	NetworkID          string                         `yaml:"network_id"`
	GenesisSnapshotID  string                         `yaml:"genesis_snapshot_id"`
	GenesisTables      []StorageIntegrityTable        `yaml:"genesis_tables"`
	ClickhouseDSN      string                         `yaml:"clickhouse_dsn"`
	ClickhouseUsername string                         `yaml:"clickhouse_username"`
	StoragePolicy      string                         `yaml:"storage_policy"`
	Peers              []StorageIntegrityMemberPeer   `yaml:"peers"`
	PoolCollections    []string                       `yaml:"pool_collections"`
	Restore            *StorageIntegrityMemberRestore `yaml:"restore"`
	ShadowVerification bool                           `yaml:"shadow_verification"`
	PollInterval       time.Duration                  `yaml:"poll_interval"`
	DiskBudgetBytes    uint64                         `yaml:"disk_budget_bytes"`
	StopInstallsRatio  float64                        `yaml:"stop_installs_ratio"`
	SelfAuditInterval  time.Duration                  `yaml:"self_audit_interval"`
	MetricsListen      string                         `yaml:"metrics_listen"`
}

// StorageIntegrityMemberPeer is one owner in the member's static group scope
// (P2: every enrolled SI indexer but the host) and the NOT OVERRIDABLE named
// collection that reaches its source ClickHouse as si_reader.
type StorageIntegrityMemberPeer struct {
	IndexerID  uint64 `yaml:"indexer_id"`
	Collection string `yaml:"collection"`
}

// StorageIntegrityMemberRestore names the object store of the restore byte
// source (Plan S3-C1's P1 bucket); its key is read from the environment.
type StorageIntegrityMemberRestore struct {
	Endpoint string `yaml:"endpoint"`
	Bucket   string `yaml:"bucket"`
}

// StorageIntegrityTable is one genesis table schema, checked at startup
// against the genesis manifest's schema hash.
type StorageIntegrityTable struct {
	TableID     string                   `yaml:"table_id"`
	PartitionBy string                   `yaml:"partition_by"`
	Columns     []StorageIntegrityColumn `yaml:"columns"`
}

// StorageIntegrityColumn is one declared column of a genesis table.
type StorageIntegrityColumn struct {
	Name string `yaml:"name"`
	Type string `yaml:"type"`
}

// Schema is the table as the replay executor and the DDL take it.
func (t StorageIntegrityTable) Schema() payloadexec.TableSchema {
	columns := make([]lthash.Column, 0, len(t.Columns))
	for _, c := range t.Columns {
		columns = append(columns, lthash.Column{Name: c.Name, Type: c.Type})
	}
	return payloadexec.TableSchema{TableID: t.TableID, PartitionBy: t.PartitionBy, Columns: columns}
}

// LoadSIMemberConfig reads and validates the si-member's own config file. It
// first refuses the password and restore-key keys (any value, null included),
// then decodes the whole file with KnownFields, so a key outside
// SIMemberConfig, and with it the host's config file, is refused; it never
// loads the node config or PRIVATE_KEY.
func LoadSIMemberConfig(path string) (*SIMemberConfig, error) {
	cfg, err := loadSIMemberConfig(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("si-member config %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	return cfg, nil
}

func loadSIMemberConfig(path string) (*SIMemberConfig, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := refuseSIMemberSecretKeys(data); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var cfg SIMemberConfig
	decoder := yaml.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	decoder.KnownFields(true)
	if err := decoder.Decode(&cfg); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return nil, err
	}
	var extra yaml.Node
	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return nil, errors.New("si-member config must contain exactly one YAML document")
	}
	cfg.applyDefaults()
	if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &cfg, nil
}

// refuseSIMemberSecretKeys refuses a document that sets the member's
// ClickHouse password or restore key, whatever the value. It reads the YAML
// nodes before the struct decode, so these refusals win over the unknown-field
// error KnownFields gives the same keys, and it follows aliases and merge keys
// (siMemberYAMLMappingValues) as the decoder does.
func refuseSIMemberSecretKeys(data []byte) error {
	var doc yaml.Node
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(data, &doc); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if doc.Kind != yaml.DocumentNode || len(doc.Content) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	if err := checkSIMemberYAMLAliases(&doc, make(map[*yaml.Node]bool), make(map[*yaml.Node]bool)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, si := range siMemberYAMLMappingValues(doc.Content[0], "storage_integrity") {
		for _, block := range siMemberYAMLMappingValues(si, "member") {
			if len(siMemberYAMLMappingValues(block, "clickhouse_password")) > 0 {
				return fmt.Errorf("storage_integrity.member.clickhouse_password is not read from the config file; set %s instead", StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv)
			}
			for _, restore := range siMemberYAMLMappingValues(block, "restore") {
				if len(siMemberYAMLMappingValues(restore, "access_key_id")) > 0 || len(siMemberYAMLMappingValues(restore, "secret")) > 0 {
					return fmt.Errorf("storage_integrity.member.restore.access_key_id and storage_integrity.member.restore.secret are not read from the config file; set %s and %s instead", StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreAccessKeyIDEnv, StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreSecretEnv)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// siMemberYAMLMappingValues follows aliases and merge keys once per node,
// including overridden values: even a shadowed secret key is forbidden.
// The graph was checked for cycles before any of these walks.
func siMemberYAMLMappingValues(node *yaml.Node, key string) []*yaml.Node {
	seen := make(map[*yaml.Node]bool)
	var values []*yaml.Node
	var walk func(*yaml.Node)
	walk = func(n *yaml.Node) {
		if n == nil || seen[n] {
			return
		}
		seen[n] = true
		if n.Kind == yaml.AliasNode {
			walk(n.Alias)
			return
		}
		if n.Kind == yaml.SequenceNode {
			for _, child := range n.Content {
				walk(child)
			}
			return
		}
		if n.Kind != yaml.MappingNode {
			return
		}
		for i := 0; i+1 < len(n.Content); i += 2 {
			name, value := n.Content[i], n.Content[i+1]
			if name.Value == key {
				values = append(values, value)
			}
			if name.ShortTag() == "!!merge" {
				walk(value)
			}
		}
	}
	walk(node)
	return values
}

// checkSIMemberYAMLAliases rejects a cycle before yamlMappingValues walks
// aliases and merge keys. A shared acyclic alias is permitted. Visiting every
// graph node once also bounds the preflight work independently of alias reuse.
func checkSIMemberYAMLAliases(node *yaml.Node, active, done map[*yaml.Node]bool) error {
	if node == nil || done[node] {
		return nil
	}
	if active[node] {
		return errors.New("si-member config contains a recursive YAML alias or merge")
	}
	active[node] = true
	children := node.Content
	if node.Kind == yaml.AliasNode {
		children = []*yaml.Node{node.Alias}
	}
	for _, child := range children {
		if err := checkSIMemberYAMLAliases(child, active, done); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	delete(active, node)
	done[node] = true
	return nil
}

// applyDefaults fills the zero values contract §24.2 gives a default:
// arbiter-core's own constants, so the two never drift apart.
func (c *SIMemberConfig) applyDefaults() {
	m := &c.StorageIntegrity.Member
	if m.PollInterval == 0 {
		m.PollInterval = member.DefaultPollInterval
	}
	if m.StopInstallsRatio == 0 {
		m.StopInstallsRatio = install.DefaultStopInstallsRatio
	}
	if m.SelfAuditInterval == 0 {
		m.SelfAuditInterval = install.DefaultSelfAuditInterval
	}
	if m.MetricsListen == "" {
		m.MetricsListen = DefaultSIMemberMetricsListen
	}
}

// Validate checks a config after its defaults are applied and joins every
// refusal. It reads the password and restore-key variables to check that they
// are set, never their values.
func (c SIMemberConfig) Validate() error {
	si := c.StorageIntegrity
	m := si.Member
	var errs []error
	refuse := func(format string, args ...any) { errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf(format, args...)) }
	blank := func(s string) bool { return strings.TrimSpace(s) == "" }

	if len(si.ArbiterPeers) == 0 {
		refuse("storage_integrity.arbiter_peers is required")
	}
	for i, peer := range si.ArbiterPeers {
		if blank(peer.ID) {
			refuse("storage_integrity.arbiter_peers[%d].id is required", i)
		}
		if blank(peer.Addr) {
			refuse("storage_integrity.arbiter_peers[%d].addr is required", i)
		}
	}
	if blank(si.PayloadStoreDataAddr) {
		refuse("storage_integrity.payload_store_data_addr is required")
	}

	required := func(key string, missing bool) {
		if missing {
			refuse("storage_integrity.member.%s is required", key)
		}
	}
	required("node_id", blank(m.NodeID))
	if !blank(m.NodeID) && !siMemberNodeIDPattern.MatchString(m.NodeID) {
		refuse("storage_integrity.member.node_id must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,30}[a-z0-9]$, got %q", m.NodeID)
	}
	required("host_indexer_id", m.HostIndexerID == nil)
	required("state_dir", blank(m.StateDir))
	required("network_id", blank(m.NetworkID))
	required("genesis_snapshot_id", blank(m.GenesisSnapshotID))
	if !blank(m.GenesisSnapshotID) && !storageIntegrityGenesisSnapshotIDPattern.MatchString(m.GenesisSnapshotID) {
		refuse("storage_integrity.member.genesis_snapshot_id %q must be a 0x-prefixed 64-digit lowercase hex digest", m.GenesisSnapshotID)
	}
	required("clickhouse_dsn", blank(m.ClickhouseDSN))
	required("disk_budget_bytes", m.DiskBudgetBytes == 0)
	required("peers", len(m.Peers) == 0)

	password := os.Getenv(StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv)
	switch {
	case blank(m.ClickhouseUsername) && password != "":
		refuse("%s is set but storage_integrity.member.clickhouse_username is empty: a ClickHouse password needs a user", StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv)
	case blank(m.ClickhouseUsername):
		refuse("storage_integrity.member.clickhouse_username is required: the si-member never connects as default")
	case m.ClickhouseUsername == "default":
		refuse("storage_integrity.member.clickhouse_username must not be default: the si-member never connects as default")
	}

	seen := make(map[uint64]bool, len(m.Peers))
	for i, peer := range m.Peers {
		if m.HostIndexerID != nil && peer.IndexerID == *m.HostIndexerID {
			refuse("storage_integrity.member.peers[%d].indexer_id %d is the host's own indexer", i, peer.IndexerID)
		}
		if seen[peer.IndexerID] {
			refuse("storage_integrity.member.peers must name each indexer once (indexer %d twice)", peer.IndexerID)
		}
		seen[peer.IndexerID] = true
		if !siMemberCollectionPattern.MatchString(peer.Collection) {
			refuse("storage_integrity.member.peers[%d].collection must be one ClickHouse identifier ([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)", i)
		}
	}
	for i, collection := range m.PoolCollections {
		if !siMemberCollectionPattern.MatchString(collection) {
			refuse("storage_integrity.member.pool_collections[%d] must be one ClickHouse identifier ([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)", i)
		}
	}
	tableIDs := make(map[string]bool, len(m.GenesisTables))
	for i, table := range m.GenesisTables {
		switch {
		case blank(table.TableID):
			refuse("storage_integrity.member.genesis_tables[%d].table_id is required", i)
		case tableIDs[table.TableID]:
			refuse("storage_integrity.member.genesis_tables[%d] duplicates %q", i, table.TableID)
		}
		tableIDs[table.TableID] = true
		if err := payloadexec.ValidateTableSchemaColumns(table.Schema()); err != nil {
			refuse("storage_integrity.member.genesis_tables[%d]: %w", i, err)
		}
	}
	if m.ShadowVerification && blank(m.StoragePolicy) {
		refuse("storage_integrity.member.storage_policy is required when shadow_verification is true: choose the member disk policy explicitly")
	}
	if m.Restore != nil && (blank(m.Restore.Endpoint) || blank(m.Restore.Bucket) ||
		os.Getenv(StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreAccessKeyIDEnv) == "" || os.Getenv(StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreSecretEnv) == "") {
		refuse("storage_integrity.member.restore needs both endpoint and bucket, and both restore environment variables")
	}
	if !(m.StopInstallsRatio > 0 && m.StopInstallsRatio < 1) {
		refuse("storage_integrity.member.stop_installs_ratio must satisfy 0 < ratio < 1, got %v", m.StopInstallsRatio)
	}
	if m.PollInterval < member.MinPollInterval {
		refuse("storage_integrity.member.poll_interval must be at least 1s, got %s", m.PollInterval)
	}
	if m.SelfAuditInterval < install.MinSelfAuditInterval {
		refuse("storage_integrity.member.self_audit_interval must be at least 10m, got %s", m.SelfAuditInterval)
	}
	if _, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(m.MetricsListen); err != nil {
		refuse("storage_integrity.member.metrics_listen must be host:port, got %q", m.MetricsListen)
	}
	return errors.Join(errs...)
}

// ClickhouseOptions returns the options of the member's one ClickHouse
// connection: its own user, with the password read from
// StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv now. A fresh value on every
// call, because clickhouse.Open fills in its defaults.
func (c StorageIntegrityMemberConfig) ClickhouseOptions() *clickhouse.Options {
	return &clickhouse.Options{
		Addr: []string{c.ClickhouseDSN},
		Auth: clickhouse.Auth{
			Username: c.ClickhouseUsername,
			Password: os.Getenv(StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv),
		},
	}
}

// MemberConfig maps a validated file onto arbiter-core's member.Config. The
// restore key is read from the environment on every call and lives only in
// the returned value; log neither that value nor the member.Config itself.
func (c SIMemberConfig) MemberConfig() (member.Config, error) {
	m := c.StorageIntegrity.Member
	if m.HostIndexerID == nil {
		return member.Config{}, errors.New("storage_integrity.member.host_indexer_id is required")
	}
	genesis := make([]payloadexec.TableSchema, 0, len(m.GenesisTables))
	for _, table := range m.GenesisTables {
		genesis = append(genesis, table.Schema())
	}
	peers := make([]member.Peer, 0, len(m.Peers))
	for _, peer := range m.Peers {
		peers = append(peers, member.Peer{IndexerID: peer.IndexerID, Collection: peer.Collection})
	}
	var restore *sources.RestoreConfig
	if m.Restore != nil {
		keyID, secret := os.Getenv(StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreAccessKeyIDEnv), os.Getenv(StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreSecretEnv)
		if m.Restore.Endpoint == "" || m.Restore.Bucket == "" || keyID == "" || secret == "" {
			return member.Config{}, errors.New("storage_integrity.member.restore needs both endpoint and bucket, and both restore environment variables")
		}
		restore = &sources.RestoreConfig{Endpoint: m.Restore.Endpoint, Bucket: m.Restore.Bucket, AccessKeyID: keyID, Secret: secret}
	}
	var pool []string
	if len(m.PoolCollections) > 0 {
		pool = append(pool, m.PoolCollections...)
	}
	return member.Config{
		NodeID:            m.NodeID,
		HostIndexerID:     *m.HostIndexerID,
		NetworkID:         m.NetworkID,
		GenesisSnapshotID: m.GenesisSnapshotID,
		Genesis:           genesis,
		Pinned:            ddl.DefaultMemberPinned(m.NodeID, siMemberKeeperShardID, m.StoragePolicy),
		Protocol: ddl.Pinned{
			UnsafeDB:  StorageIntegrityUnsafeDatabase,
			SafeDB:    StorageIntegritySafeDatabase,
			PromoteDB: StorageIntegrityPromoteDatabase,
		},
		StateDir:          m.StateDir,
		Peers:             peers,
		PoolCollections:   pool,
		Restore:           restore,
		Shadow:            m.ShadowVerification,
		PollInterval:      m.PollInterval,
		DiskBudgetBytes:   m.DiskBudgetBytes,
		StopInstallsRatio: m.StopInstallsRatio,
		SelfAuditInterval: m.SelfAuditInterval,
	}, nil
}

// String renders the member block for logs. It names where each secret comes
// from and never reads one.
func (c StorageIntegrityMemberConfig) String() string {
	host := "unset"
	if c.HostIndexerID != nil {
		host = strconv.FormatUint(*c.HostIndexerID, 10)
	}
	peers := make([]string, 0, len(c.Peers))
	for _, peer := range c.Peers {
		peers = append(peers, fmt.Sprintf("%d via %s", peer.IndexerID, peer.Collection))
	}
	restore := "off"
	if c.Restore != nil {
		restore = fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s with the key from %s and %s", c.Restore.Endpoint, c.Restore.Bucket, StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreAccessKeyIDEnv, StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreSecretEnv)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("si-member %s (host indexer %s, state %s, network %s, clickhouse %s as %s with the password from %s, peers [%s], pool %v, restore %s, shadow %t, metrics %s)",
		c.NodeID, host, c.StateDir, c.NetworkID, c.ClickhouseDSN, c.ClickhouseUsername, StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv,
		strings.Join(peers, ", "), c.PoolCollections, restore, c.ShadowVerification, c.MetricsListen)
}

// LogValue is String's structured form.
func (c StorageIntegrityMemberConfig) LogValue() slog.Value {
	host := "unset"
	if c.HostIndexerID != nil {
		host = strconv.FormatUint(*c.HostIndexerID, 10)
	}
	peers := make([]string, 0, len(c.Peers))
	for _, peer := range c.Peers {
		peers = append(peers, fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", peer.IndexerID, peer.Collection))
	}
	return slog.GroupValue(
		slog.String("node_id", c.NodeID),
		slog.String("host_indexer_id", host),
		slog.String("state_dir", c.StateDir),
		slog.String("network_id", c.NetworkID),
		slog.String("clickhouse_dsn", c.ClickhouseDSN),
		slog.String("clickhouse_username", c.ClickhouseUsername),
		slog.String("clickhouse_password", "from "+StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv),
		slog.String("peers", strings.Join(peers, ",")),
		slog.Bool("restore", c.Restore != nil),
		slog.Bool("shadow_verification", c.ShadowVerification),
		slog.String("metrics_listen", c.MetricsListen),
	)
}

// String renders the file for logs through the member block's String.
func (c SIMemberConfig) String() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s; %d arbiter peer(s), payload store %s", c.StorageIntegrity.Member, len(c.StorageIntegrity.ArbiterPeers), c.StorageIntegrity.PayloadStoreDataAddr)
}

// LogValue is String's structured form.
func (c SIMemberConfig) LogValue() slog.Value {
	return slog.GroupValue(
		slog.Any("member", c.StorageIntegrity.Member),
		slog.Int("arbiter_peers", len(c.StorageIntegrity.ArbiterPeers)),
		slog.String("payload_store_data_addr", c.StorageIntegrity.PayloadStoreDataAddr),
	)
}
```

```go
	"sentio_node_si_member_shadow_unverdicted_total",
	"sentio_node_si_member_unconfigured_owners",
}

// gatherSIMember scrapes the collector and returns every series as
// name{label="value",...} (labels sorted) with its value, and each family's
// type (GAUGE or COUNTER).
func gatherSIMember(t *testing.T, c prometheus.Collector) (map[string]float64, map[string]string) {
	t.Helper()
	registry := prometheus.NewPedanticRegistry()
	require.NoError(t, registry.Register(c))
	families, err := registry.Gather()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	series := map[string]float64{}
	types := map[string]string{}
	for _, family := range families {
		types[family.GetName()] = family.GetType().String()
		for _, metric := range family.GetMetric() {
			labels := make([]string, 0, len(metric.GetLabel()))
			for _, label := range metric.GetLabel() {
				labels = append(labels, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%q", label.GetName(), label.GetValue()))
			}
			sort.Strings(labels)
			key := family.GetName()
			if len(labels) > 0 {
				key += "{" + strings.Join(labels, ",") + "}"
			}
			value := metric.GetGauge().GetValue()
			if family.GetType().String() == "COUNTER" {
				value = metric.GetCounter().GetValue()
			}
			_, dup := series[key]
			require.False(t, dup, "series %s exported twice", key)
			series[key] = value
		}
	}
	return series, types
}

// siMemberZeroSeries is every series a member with the given owners exports
// before it has done anything.
func siMemberZeroSeries(nodeID string, host uint64, owners ...uint64) map[string]float64 {
	want := map[string]float64{
		fmt.Sprintf(`sentio_node_si_member_info{host_indexer_id="%d",node_id=%q}`, host, nodeID): 1,
		"sentio_node_si_member_ready":                     0,
		"sentio_node_si_member_feed_full_fetches_total":   0,
		"sentio_node_si_member_audit_dropped_twins_total": 0,
		"sentio_node_si_member_audit_clean":               0,
		"sentio_node_si_member_installs_paused":           0,
		"sentio_node_si_member_disk_used_bytes":           0,
		"sentio_node_si_member_disk_budget_bytes":         0,
		"sentio_node_si_member_grants_unreadable":         0,
		"sentio_node_si_member_unconfigured_owners":       0,
		"sentio_node_si_member_shadow_next_block_seq":     0,
	}
	for _, owner := range owners {
		for _, name := range []string{"copies", "copy_safe_block_seq", "copy_applied_promotion_seq", "published_safe_block_seq", "copy_behind_seconds",
			"diverged_partitions_total", "diverged_tables", "foreign_tables", "shadow_blocks_total", "shadow_missed_scans_total", "shadow_unverdicted_total"} {
			want[fmt.Sprintf(`sentio_node_si_member_%s{owner="%d"}`, name, owner)] = 0
		}
		for _, kind := range []string{"receipt", "scan", "claim"} {
			want[fmt.Sprintf(`sentio_node_si_member_shadow_mismatches_total{kind=%q,owner="%d"}`, kind, owner)] = 0
		}
	}
	for _, outcome := range []string{"kept", "rename_race", "split", "doubled", "foreign", "missed", "refused", "unreachable"} {
		want[fmt.Sprintf(`sentio_node_si_member_install_outcomes_total{outcome=%q}`, outcome)] = 0
	}
	for _, source := range []string{"owner_pull", "peer_unsafe_pull", "restore"} {
		want[fmt.Sprintf(`sentio_node_si_member_installs_total{source=%q}`, source)] = 0
	}
	for _, outcome := range []string{"accepted", "refused"} {
		want[fmt.Sprintf(`sentio_node_si_member_feed_manifests_total{outcome=%q}`, outcome)] = 0
	}
	for _, trigger := range []string{"startup", "clickhouse_restart", "self_audit"} {
		want[fmt.Sprintf(`sentio_node_si_member_audit_runs_total{trigger=%q}`, trigger)] = 0
	}
	return want
}

func TestSIMemberCollectorExportsEveryCounterIncludingZeros(t *testing.T) {
	// A member that has done nothing yet still exports every series of every

func TestSIMemberCollectorNamesAreTheReviewedSet(t *testing.T) {
	_, types := gatherSIMember(t, newSIMemberCollector(fakeSIMemberStats{member.Stats{NodeID: "member-b", HostIndexerID: 1}}, []uint64{0}))
	names := make([]string, 0, len(types))
	for name, kind := range types {
		names = append(names, name)
		want := "GAUGE"
		if strings.HasSuffix(name, "_total") {
			want = "COUNTER"
		}
		require.Equal(t, want, kind, name)
	}
	slices.Sort(names)
	require.Equal(t, siMemberMetricNames, names)
	require.Len(t, names, 27)
}
```

```go
package simember

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"google.golang.org/grpc"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/emptypb"
)

// fakeSIMemberRole stands in for *member.Role: Run blocks until its context
// ends, or returns fail when set.
type fakeSIMemberRole struct {
	ready atomic.Bool
	stats member.Stats
	fail  error
	ran   chan struct{}
}

func newFakeSIMemberRole(stats member.Stats) *fakeSIMemberRole {
	return &fakeSIMemberRole{stats: stats, ran: make(chan struct{})}
}

func (f *fakeSIMemberRole) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
	close(f.ran)
	if f.fail != nil {
		return f.fail
	}
	<-ctx.Done()
	return ctx.Err()
}

func (f *fakeSIMemberRole) Ready() bool         { return f.ready.Load() }
func (f *fakeSIMemberRole) Stats() member.Stats { return f.stats }

// disabledTableRegistry answers GetTableRegistry as an arbiter whose registry
// is still disabled, which closes a follower's Ready channel.
type disabledTableRegistry struct {
	pb.UnimplementedTableRegistryServer
	gets atomic.Int32
}

func (r *disabledTableRegistry) GetTableRegistry(context.Context, *emptypb.Empty) (*pb.TableRegistrySnapshot, error) {
	r.gets.Add(1)
	return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, dataplane.TableRegistryDisabledMessage)
}

func startDisabledTableRegistry(t *testing.T) (string, *disabledTableRegistry) {
	t.Helper()
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	registry := &disabledTableRegistry{}
	server := grpc.NewServer()
	pb.RegisterTableRegistryServer(server, registry)
	go func() { _ = server.Serve(listener) }()
	t.Cleanup(server.Stop)
	return listener.Addr().String(), registry
}

// siMemberRunTestConfig is a valid member config whose DA store and
// ClickHouse are never reached (clickhouse.Open and dastore dial lazily) and
// whose metrics listener takes a free loopback port; @ARBITER@ is the
// arbiter peer's address.
const siMemberRunTestConfig = `storage_integrity:
  arbiter_peers:
    - {id: arbiter-0, addr: "@ARBITER@"}
  payload_store_data_addr: "127.0.0.1:1"
  member:
    node_id: member-b
    host_indexer_id: 1
    state_dir: /data/si-member
    network_id: devnet2
    genesis_snapshot_id: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111"
    clickhouse_dsn: "source-clickhouse:9000"
    clickhouse_username: si_member
    peers:
      - {indexer_id: 0, collection: si_owner_0}
      - {indexer_id: 2, collection: si_owner_2}
    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824
    metrics_listen: "127.0.0.1:0"
`

func loadSIMemberRunTestConfig(t *testing.T, arbiterAddr string) *config.SIMemberConfig {
	t.Helper()
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "si-member.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(strings.ReplaceAll(siMemberRunTestConfig, "@ARBITER@", arbiterAddr)), 0o600))
	cfg, err := config.LoadSIMemberConfig(path)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return cfg
}

func httpGet(t *testing.T, url string) (int, string) {
	t.Helper()
	resp, err := http.Get(url)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return resp.StatusCode, string(body)
}

func TestRunWiresTheMemberRoleWithItsOwnLogin(t *testing.T) {
	const password = "test-only-si-member-password"
	t.Setenv(config.StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv, password)
	arbiterAddr, registry := startDisabledTableRegistry(t)
	cfg := loadSIMemberRunTestConfig(t, arbiterAddr)
	wantCfg, err := cfg.MemberConfig()
	require.NoError(t, err)

	role := newFakeSIMemberRole(member.Stats{NodeID: "member-b", HostIndexerID: 1})
	var (
		opts     *clickhouse.Options
		conn     clickhouse.Conn
		gotCfg   member.Config
		gotDeps  member.Deps
		metrics  = make(chan net.Addr, 1)
		runError = make(chan error, 1)
	)
	deps := runDeps{
		openClickHouse: func(o *clickhouse.Options) (clickhouse.Conn, error) {
			opts = o
			var err error
			conn, err = clickhouse.Open(o)
			return conn, err
		},
		newRole: func(c member.Config, d member.Deps) (siMemberRole, error) {
			gotCfg, gotDeps = c, d
			return role, nil
		},
		listen:  net.Listen,
		started: func(_ siMemberRole, addr net.Addr) { metrics <- addr },
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	defer cancel()
	go func() { runError <- run(ctx, cfg, deps) }()

	var addr net.Addr
	select {
	case addr = <-metrics:
	case err := <-runError:
		t.Fatalf("run ended before it served: %v", err)
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("run did not bind its metrics listener")
	}
	select {
	case <-role.ran:
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("run did not start the member role")
	}

	// Its own login: the configured user, the password only from the
	// environment, the configured server.
	require.Equal(t, []string{"source-clickhouse:9000"}, opts.Addr)
	require.Equal(t, clickhouse.Auth{Username: "si_member", Password: password}, opts.Auth)
	// The role gets exactly the mapped config and the process's clients.
	require.Equal(t, wantCfg, gotCfg)
	require.NotNil(t, gotDeps.Client)
	require.Same(t, conn, gotDeps.Conn)
	require.IsType(t, &dataplane.RegistryFollower{}, gotDeps.Registry)
	require.IsType(t, &dastore.Client{}, gotDeps.Payloads)
	require.Nil(t, gotDeps.AfterAttach, "the fault-injection seam is for tests only")
	require.NotNil(t, gotDeps.Logger)
	// Run runs the follower the role reads, on the configured arbiter peers.
	select {
	case <-gotDeps.Registry.Ready():
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("the table-registry follower never answered: run does not run it")
	}
	require.Positive(t, registry.gets.Load())

	// Metrics and readiness on metrics_listen, from the process's own registry.
	code, body := httpGet(t, "http://"+addr.String()+"/metrics")
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, code)
	require.Contains(t, body, `sentio_node_si_member_info{host_indexer_id="1",node_id="member-b"} 1`)
	require.Contains(t, body, `sentio_node_si_member_copies{owner="2"} 0`)
	code, _ = httpGet(t, "http://"+addr.String()+"/readyz")
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, code)
	role.ready.Store(true)
	code, _ = httpGet(t, "http://"+addr.String()+"/readyz")
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, code)

	// The caller's cancellation is a clean exit, and the listener closes.
	cancel()
	select {
	case err := <-runError:
		require.NoError(t, err)
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("run did not return after its context ended")
	}
	_, err = net.DialTimeout("tcp", addr.String(), time.Second)
	require.Error(t, err, "the metrics listener is closed")
}

func TestRunReturnsTheRolesError(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv(config.StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv, "")
	cfg := loadSIMemberRunTestConfig(t, "127.0.0.1:1")
	role := newFakeSIMemberRole(member.Stats{NodeID: "member-b", HostIndexerID: 1})
	role.fail = errors.New("sources: the engine fence is off")
	deps := defaultRunDeps()
	deps.newRole = func(member.Config, member.Deps) (siMemberRole, error) { return role, nil }
	err := run(t.Context(), cfg, deps)
	require.EqualError(t, err, "si-member: member role: sources: the engine fence is off")

	deps.newRole = func(member.Config, member.Deps) (siMemberRole, error) {
		return nil, errors.New("member: 1 is the host's own indexer; a member never copies its host")
	}
	require.EqualError(t, run(t.Context(), cfg, deps), "si-member: member: 1 is the host's own indexer; a member never copies its host")
}

func TestReadyzFollowsTheRole(t *testing.T) {
	role := newFakeSIMemberRole(member.Stats{})
	server := httptest.NewServer(readyzHandler(role))
	defer server.Close()

	code, body := httpGet(t, server.URL)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, code)
	require.Equal(t, "not ready\n", body)

	role.ready.Store(true)
	code, body = httpGet(t, server.URL)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, code)
	require.Equal(t, "ready\n", body)

	resp, err := http.Post(server.URL, "text/plain", nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	resp.Body.Close()
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, resp.StatusCode)
	require.Equal(t, "GET, HEAD", resp.Header.Get("Allow"))
}
```

```go
package simember

import (
```
