```go
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"compute-network-node/config"

	"github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/lthash"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/chexec"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/install"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"google.golang.org/grpc"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/emptypb"
)

// The acceptance's environment (sentio-node CI step "si-member install
// acceptance"): the fenced member server, the owner's source server, and the
// owner's address as the member server reaches it. ClickHouse runs remote()
// against its own address locally, as the calling user, so the owner is a
// second server.
const (
	siMemberCHE2EEnv             = "SENTIO_SI_MEMBER_CH_E2E"
	siMemberCHMemberAddrEnv      = "CH_MEMBER_ADDR"
	siMemberCHOwnerAddrEnv       = "CH_OWNER_ADDR"
	siMemberCHOwnerFromMemberEnv = "CH_OWNER_ADDR_FROM_MEMBER"
)

// siMemberGrants is SI_MEMBER_GRANTS (Plan S3-C2 contract §23.2), one GRANT
// per entry without TO; GRANT NAMED COLLECTION is added per collection.
var siMemberGrants = []string{
	"GRANT SELECT ON hg_member_unsafe.*",
	"GRANT SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA ON hg_member_unsafe.*",
	"GRANT SELECT, INSERT, ALTER DELETE, CREATE TABLE, DROP TABLE ON hg_replica.*",
	"GRANT SELECT, INSERT, ALTER, CREATE TABLE, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, OPTIMIZE ON hg_rstage.*",
	"GRANT CREATE DATABASE ON hg_replica.*",
	"GRANT CREATE DATABASE ON hg_rstage.*",
	"GRANT READ ON S3",
	"GRANT TABLE ENGINE ON MergeTree",
	"GRANT TABLE ENGINE ON Memory",
	"GRANT SELECT ON system.parts",
	"GRANT SELECT ON system.tables",
	"GRANT SELECT ON system.detached_tables",
	"GRANT SELECT ON system.replicas",
	"GRANT SELECT ON system.zookeeper",
	"GRANT READ ON REMOTE",
	"GRANT CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE ON *.*",
}

// siReaderGrants are the owner reader's grants of spec §8.6: Plan S3-B
// contract §11's three and SHOW COLUMNS ON system.parts, without which
// remote(<collection>, database = 'system', table = 'parts') is refused (497)
// on 26.3.
var siReaderGrants = []string{
	"GRANT SELECT ON hg_safe.*",
	"GRANT SELECT ON hg_unsafe.*",
	"GRANT SHOW COLUMNS ON system.parts",
	"GRANT SELECT(database, table, name, active, rows, partition_id, hash_of_all_files) ON system.parts",
}

func requireSIMemberCHAcceptance(t *testing.T) (memberAddr, ownerAddr, ownerFromMember string) {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv(siMemberCHE2EEnv) != "1" {
		t.Skipf("set %s=1, %s, %s and %s to run the si-member install acceptance", siMemberCHE2EEnv, siMemberCHMemberAddrEnv, siMemberCHOwnerAddrEnv, siMemberCHOwnerFromMemberEnv)
	}
	values := make([]string, 0, 3)
	for _, name := range []string{siMemberCHMemberAddrEnv, siMemberCHOwnerAddrEnv, siMemberCHOwnerFromMemberEnv} {
		value := os.Getenv(name)
		if value == "" {
			t.Fatalf("%s=1 needs %s", siMemberCHE2EEnv, name)
		}
		values = append(values, value)
	}
	return values[0], values[1], values[2]
}

// openSIMemberCH opens a connection as the server's passwordless default
// user, which the acceptance's servers give access management.
func openSIMemberCH(t *testing.T, addr string) clickhouse.Conn {
	t.Helper()
	conn, err := clickhouse.Open(&clickhouse.Options{Addr: []string{addr}})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = conn.Close() })
	require.NoError(t, conn.Ping(t.Context()), "ping %s", addr)
	return conn
}

// siMemberTestPassword is a fresh password from crypto/rand for one test user.
func siMemberTestPassword(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	raw := make([]byte, 24)
	_, err := rand.Read(raw)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return hex.EncodeToString(raw)
}

// mustExecSIMember runs one statement; a failure names what, never the
// statement, which may carry a password.
func mustExecSIMember(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, what, query string) {
	t.Helper()
	require.NoError(t, conn.Exec(t.Context(), query), "%s", what)
}

type siMemberCHPart struct {
	Name, PartitionID, HashOfAllFiles string
	Rows, Bytes                       uint64
}

func activeSIMemberParts(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, database, table string) []siMemberCHPart {
	t.Helper()
	rows, err := conn.Query(t.Context(),
		"SELECT name, partition_id, hash_of_all_files, rows, bytes_on_disk FROM system.parts WHERE database = ? AND table = ? AND active ORDER BY name",
		database, table)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer rows.Close()
	var parts []siMemberCHPart
	for rows.Next() {
		var p siMemberCHPart
		require.NoError(t, rows.Scan(&p.Name, &p.PartitionID, &p.HashOfAllFiles, &p.Rows, &p.Bytes))
		parts = append(parts, p)
	}
	require.NoError(t, rows.Err())
	return parts
}

// rowHashesOf scans every active part of database.table and returns the part
// row LtHashes, sorted, so two tables compare as multisets.
func rowHashesOf(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, database, table string, schema payloadexec.TableSchema) []string {
	t.Helper()
	parts := activeSIMemberParts(t, conn, database, table)
	require.NotEmpty(t, parts, "%s.%s has no active part", database, table)
	names := make([]string, 0, len(parts))
	for _, p := range parts {
		names = append(names, p.Name)
	}
	scans, err := chexec.ScanParts(t.Context(), conn, database+"."+table, schema, names)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	hashes := make([]string, 0, len(scans))
	for _, s := range scans {
		hashes = append(hashes, s.RowLtHash)
	}
	return sortedStrings(hashes)
}

func sortedStrings(in []string) []string {
	out := slices.Clone(in)
	slices.Sort(out)
	return out
}

// fakeSIMemberSafeState serves the watermark and the manifests by id; the
// member never asks for a manifest by block (spec §8.4).
type fakeSIMemberSafeState struct {
	pb.UnimplementedSafeStateServer
	t         *testing.T
	watermark *pb.SafeWatermark
	manifests map[string]*pb.SafeSnapshotManifest
}

func (f *fakeSIMemberSafeState) GetSafeWatermark(context.Context, *pb.GetSafeWatermarkRequest) (*pb.SafeWatermark, error) {
	return proto.Clone(f.watermark).(*pb.SafeWatermark), nil
}

func (f *fakeSIMemberSafeState) GetManifest(_ context.Context, ref *pb.SnapshotRef) (*pb.SafeSnapshotManifest, error) {
	m, ok := f.manifests[ref.GetSnapshotId()]
	if !ok {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.NotFound, "unknown snapshot id")
	}
	return proto.Clone(m).(*pb.SafeSnapshotManifest), nil
}

func (f *fakeSIMemberSafeState) GetManifestByBlock(context.Context, *pb.BlockRef) (*pb.SafeSnapshotManifest, error) {
	f.t.Error("the si-member called GetManifestByBlock")
	return nil, status.Error(codes.Unimplemented, "GetManifestByBlock is not served to a member")
}

// fakeSIMemberRegistry serves one fixed table registry and purge node set.
type fakeSIMemberRegistry struct {
	pb.UnimplementedTableRegistryServer
	snapshot *pb.TableRegistrySnapshot
	purge    []string
}

func (f *fakeSIMemberRegistry) GetTableRegistry(context.Context, *emptypb.Empty) (*pb.TableRegistrySnapshot, error) {
	return proto.Clone(f.snapshot).(*pb.TableRegistrySnapshot), nil
}

func (f *fakeSIMemberRegistry) WatchTableRegistry(req *pb.WatchTableRegistryRequest, stream grpc.ServerStreamingServer[pb.TableRegistrySnapshot]) error {
	if f.snapshot.GetVersion() > req.GetSinceVersion() {
		if err := stream.Send(proto.Clone(f.snapshot).(*pb.TableRegistrySnapshot)); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	<-stream.Context().Done()
	return stream.Context().Err()
}

func (f *fakeSIMemberRegistry) GetPurgeNodeSet(context.Context, *emptypb.Empty) (*pb.PurgeNodeSet, error) {
	return &pb.PurgeNodeSet{NodeIds: append([]string(nil), f.purge...)}, nil
}

// methodRecorder records every RPC the member makes.
type methodRecorder struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	methods map[string]bool
}

func (r *methodRecorder) record(method string) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	r.methods[method] = true
}

func (r *methodRecorder) seen() []string {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	out := make([]string, 0, len(r.methods))
	for method := range r.methods {
		out = append(out, method)
	}
	return sortedStrings(out)
}

func startFakeSIMemberArbiter(t *testing.T, safe *fakeSIMemberSafeState, registry *fakeSIMemberRegistry) (string, *methodRecorder) {
	t.Helper()
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	calls := &methodRecorder{methods: map[string]bool{}}
	server := grpc.NewServer(
		grpc.UnaryInterceptor(func(ctx context.Context, req any, info *grpc.UnaryServerInfo, handler grpc.UnaryHandler) (any, error) {
			calls.record(info.FullMethod)
			return handler(ctx, req)
		}),
		grpc.StreamInterceptor(func(srv any, ss grpc.ServerStream, info *grpc.StreamServerInfo, handler grpc.StreamHandler) error {
			calls.record(info.FullMethod)
			return handler(srv, ss)
		}),
	)
	pb.RegisterSafeStateServer(server, safe)
	pb.RegisterTableRegistryServer(server, registry)
	go func() { _ = server.Serve(listener) }()
	t.Cleanup(server.Stop)
	return listener.Addr().String(), calls
}

// TestSIMemberInstallsACopyFromTheOwnerPull runs sentio-node's si-member
// (simember's run with the member role of CORE_TAG_P2) against a fenced
// ClickHouse 26.3 as si_member (SI_MEMBER_GRANTS), an owner source server
// holding a promoted hg_safe table read through the NOT OVERRIDABLE
// collection si_owner_0 as si_reader, and a fake arbiter serving the
// registry, the purge node set, the watermark and the manifests. Shadow
// verification is off. The member must become ready with a copy that equals
// the manifest's parts by row hash and a journal entry at the watermark.
//
// Requires SENTIO_SI_MEMBER_CH_E2E=1, CH_MEMBER_ADDR, CH_OWNER_ADDR and
// CH_OWNER_ADDR_FROM_MEMBER (sentio-node CI step "si-member install
// acceptance").
func TestSIMemberInstallsACopyFromTheOwnerPull(t *testing.T) {
	memberAddr, ownerAddr, ownerFromMember := requireSIMemberCHAcceptance(t)
	ownerHost, ownerPortText, err := net.SplitHostPort(ownerFromMember)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	ownerPort, err := strconv.ParseUint(ownerPortText, 10, 16)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	admin := openSIMemberCH(t, memberAddr)
	owner := openSIMemberCH(t, ownerAddr)

	const (
		networkID      = "sentio-node-si-member"
		database       = "devuser1"
		nodeID         = "member-b"
		incarnationSeq = uint64(1)
		collection     = "si_owner_0"
	)
	table := fmt.Sprintf("si_member_%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
	tableKey := database + "." + table
	physical := ddl.CHTableName(tableKey)
	schema := payloadexec.TableSchema{TableID: tableKey, Columns: []lthash.Column{{Name: "value", Type: "UInt64"}}}
	schemaJSON, err := json.Marshal(schema)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	readerPassword, memberPassword := siMemberTestPassword(t), siMemberTestPassword(t)

	// The owner's source ClickHouse: si_reader and an hg_safe table with three
	// promoted parts (merges stopped by ddl.SafeSettings).
	mustExecSIMember(t, owner, "drop an old si_reader", "DROP USER IF EXISTS si_reader")
	mustExecSIMember(t, owner, "create si_reader", "CREATE USER si_reader IDENTIFIED WITH sha256_password BY '"+readerPassword+"'")
	for _, grant := range siReaderGrants {
		mustExecSIMember(t, owner, grant, grant+" TO si_reader")
	}
	_, safe, _, err := ddl.IncarnationIntents(ddl.Pinned{
		UnsafeDB: config.StorageIntegrityUnsafeDatabase, SafeDB: config.StorageIntegritySafeDatabase,
		PromoteDB: config.StorageIntegrityPromoteDatabase, NodeID: "snode-1",
	}, schema, incarnationSeq)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	mustExecSIMember(t, owner, "create hg_safe", "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS "+config.StorageIntegritySafeDatabase)
	mustExecSIMember(t, owner, "create the owner's hg_safe table", safe.SQL())
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Minute)
		defer cancel()
		_ = owner.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `%s`.`%s` SYNC", config.StorageIntegritySafeDatabase, physical))
		_ = owner.Exec(ctx, "DROP USER IF EXISTS si_reader")
	})
	next := byte(1)
	for _, values := range [][]uint64{{1, 2}, {3}, {4, 5, 6}} {
		batch, err := owner.PrepareBatch(t.Context(), fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO `%s`.`%s` (%s, value)", config.StorageIntegritySafeDatabase, physical, ddl.RowIDColumn))
		require.NoError(t, err)
		for _, value := range values {
			require.NoError(t, batch.Append(strings.Repeat(string([]byte{'a' + next}), 32), value))
			next++
		}
		require.NoError(t, batch.Send())
	}
	ownerParts := activeSIMemberParts(t, owner, config.StorageIntegritySafeDatabase, physical)
	require.Len(t, ownerParts, 3)
	names := make([]string, 0, len(ownerParts))
	for _, p := range ownerParts {
		names = append(names, p.Name)
	}
	scans, err := chexec.ScanParts(t.Context(), owner, config.StorageIntegritySafeDatabase+"."+physical, schema, names)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	entries := make([]replay.PartManifestEntry, 0, len(ownerParts))
	hashes := make([]string, 0, len(ownerParts))
	for i, p := range ownerParts {
		require.Equal(t, p.Name, scans[i].PartName)
		entries = append(entries, replay.PartManifestEntry{
			TableID: tableKey, PartitionID: p.PartitionID, PartName: p.Name, PartPhysHash: p.HashOfAllFiles,
			PartRowLtHash: scans[i].RowLtHash, RowCount: p.Rows, Bytes: p.Bytes,
		})
		hashes = append(hashes, scans[i].RowLtHash)
	}
	root, err := payloadexec.SumPartRowLtHashes(hashes)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	// The fenced member server: the collection and si_member.
	mustExecSIMember(t, admin, "drop an old si_member", "DROP USER IF EXISTS si_member")
	mustExecSIMember(t, admin, "drop an old "+collection, "DROP NAMED COLLECTION IF EXISTS "+collection)
	mustExecSIMember(t, admin, "create "+collection, fmt.Sprintf(
		"CREATE NAMED COLLECTION %s AS host = '%s' NOT OVERRIDABLE, port = %d NOT OVERRIDABLE, user = 'si_reader' NOT OVERRIDABLE, password = '%s' NOT OVERRIDABLE",
		collection, ownerHost, ownerPort, readerPassword))
	mustExecSIMember(t, admin, "create si_member", "CREATE USER si_member IDENTIFIED WITH sha256_password BY '"+memberPassword+"'")
	for _, grant := range append(slices.Clone(siMemberGrants), "GRANT NAMED COLLECTION ON "+collection) {
		mustExecSIMember(t, admin, grant, grant+" TO si_member")
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Minute)
		defer cancel()
		for _, stmt := range []string{
			"DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS " + ddl.ReplicaDatabase + " SYNC",
			"DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS " + ddl.StageDatabase + " SYNC",
			"DROP USER IF EXISTS si_member",
			"DROP NAMED COLLECTION IF EXISTS " + collection,
		} {
			_ = admin.Exec(ctx, stmt)
		}
	})

	// The arbiter: the genesis manifest (no genesis table), the watermark
	// manifest with both indexers' track entries, owner 0's Active chain
	// incarnation and the enrolled SI indexers.
	genesis, err := replay.SafeSnapshotManifest{
		SchemaSnapshotID: "schema-si-member", SchemaRoot: payloadexec.SchemaRoot(networkID, nil), ExecutorProfileID: "profile-si-member",
	}.Seal()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	ownerEntry := replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 0, SafeBlockSeq: 3, AppliedPromotionSeq: 3}
	watermark, err := replay.SafeSnapshotManifest{
		ParentSnapshotID: genesis.SnapshotID, SafeBlockSeq: 3,
		SchemaSnapshotID: genesis.SchemaSnapshotID, SchemaRoot: genesis.SchemaRoot, ExecutorProfileID: genesis.ExecutorProfileID,
		Tables: []replay.TableManifest{{
			TableID: tableKey, SchemaHash: payloadexec.TableSchemaHash(networkID, schema),
			PartitionRoots: []replay.PartitionCommitment{{TableID: tableKey, PartitionID: ownerParts[0].PartitionID, Root: root}},
			ActiveParts:    entries,
		}},
		TrackFrontiers: []replay.TrackFrontier{ownerEntry, {IndexerID: 1}},
	}.Seal()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	ownerID := uint64(0)
	arbiterAddr, calls := startFakeSIMemberArbiter(t,
		&fakeSIMemberSafeState{t: t,
			watermark: &pb.SafeWatermark{SnapshotId: watermark.SnapshotID, SafeBlockSeq: watermark.SafeBlockSeq, ManifestRoot: watermark.ManifestRoot},
			manifests: map[string]*pb.SafeSnapshotManifest{genesis.SnapshotID: wire.ManifestToPB(genesis), watermark.SnapshotID: wire.ManifestToPB(watermark)},
		},
		&fakeSIMemberRegistry{
			snapshot: &pb.TableRegistrySnapshot{
				Params:  &pb.TableRegistryParams{SiIndexerId: 0, ActivationBlock: 100, Confirmation: "safe"},
				Version: 7,
				Seeded:  true,
				SiIndexers: []*pb.SIIndexerEntry{
					{IndexerId: 0, ActivationBlock: 100, Signer: "0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000a0", SnodeNodeId: "snode-1", EnrollmentJws: "enrollment-0"},
					{IndexerId: 1, ActivationBlock: 100, Signer: "0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000a1", SnodeNodeId: "snode-2", EnrollmentJws: "enrollment-1"},
				},
				SeededIndexers: []uint64{0, 1},
				Incarnations: []*pb.TableIncarnation{{
					Seq: incarnationSeq, DatabaseId: database, TableId: table,
					Origin: pb.TableIncarnationOrigin_TABLE_INCARNATION_ORIGIN_CHAIN, Status: pb.TableIncarnationStatus_TABLE_INCARNATION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
					Created:       &pb.L2EventRef{BlockNumber: 150, BlockHash: "0x" + strings.Repeat("b", 64), TxHash: "0x" + strings.Repeat("c", 64)},
					SchemaVersion: 1, SchemaHash: payloadexec.TableSchemaHash(networkID, schema), SchemaJson: string(schemaJSON),
					AddBlockSeq: 2, OwnerIndexerId: &ownerID,
				}},
			},
			purge: []string{"snode-1", "snode-2", "verifier-1"},
		})

	// The member: its own config file, the password only in the environment.
	stateDir := t.TempDir()
	cfgPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "si-member.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(cfgPath, []byte(fmt.Sprintf(`storage_integrity:
  arbiter_peers:
    - {id: arbiter-0, addr: %q}
  payload_store_data_addr: "127.0.0.1:1"
  member:
    node_id: %s
    host_indexer_id: 1
    state_dir: %q
    network_id: %s
    genesis_snapshot_id: %q
    clickhouse_dsn: %q
    clickhouse_username: si_member
    peers:
      - {indexer_id: 0, collection: %s}
    storage_policy: default
    shadow_verification: false
    poll_interval: 1s
    disk_budget_bytes: 10737418240
    metrics_listen: "127.0.0.1:0"
`, arbiterAddr, nodeID, stateDir, networkID, genesis.SnapshotID, memberAddr, collection)), 0o600))
	t.Setenv(config.StorageIntegrityMemberClickhousePasswordEnv, memberPassword)
	t.Setenv(config.StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreAccessKeyIDEnv, "")
	t.Setenv(config.StorageIntegrityMemberRestoreSecretEnv, "")
	cfg, err := config.LoadSIMemberConfig(cfgPath)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	deps := defaultRunDeps()
	type startedMember struct {
		role siMemberRole
		addr net.Addr
	}
	started := make(chan startedMember, 1)
	deps.started = func(role siMemberRole, addr net.Addr) { started <- startedMember{role, addr} }
	ctx, stop := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 5*time.Minute)
	defer stop()
	runErr := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { runErr <- run(ctx, cfg, deps) }()
	var running startedMember
	select {
	case running = <-started:
	case err := <-runErr:
		t.Fatalf("the si-member stopped before serving: %v", err)
	}
	deadline := time.Now().Add(2 * time.Minute)
	for {
		resp, err := http.Get("http://" + running.addr.String() + "/readyz")
		if err == nil {
			resp.Body.Close()
			if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK {
				break
			}
		}
		select {
		case err := <-runErr:
			t.Fatalf("the si-member stopped before it was ready: %v", err)
		case <-time.After(500 * time.Millisecond):
		}
		require.True(t, time.Now().Before(deadline), "the si-member was not ready within 2m; stats %+v", running.role.Stats())
	}

	// The copy holds exactly the manifest's parts, by row hash.
	copyTable := ddl.CopyTableName(tableKey, incarnationSeq)
	require.Equal(t, sortedStrings(hashes), rowHashesOf(t, admin, ddl.ReplicaDatabase, copyTable, schema))

	// The journal holds owner 0's entry at the watermark and the copy's parts.
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(stateDir, install.JournalFile))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var journal install.Journal
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &journal))
	require.Equal(t, 1, journal.Version)
	require.Equal(t, nodeID, journal.NodeID)
	ownerJournal := journal.Owners["0"]
	require.NotNil(t, ownerJournal, "the journal has no entry of owner 0: %s", data)
	require.Equal(t, watermark.SnapshotID, ownerJournal.SnapshotID)
	require.Equal(t, ownerEntry, ownerJournal.Entry)
	tableJournal := ownerJournal.Tables[tableKey]
	require.NotNil(t, tableJournal, "the journal has no copy of %s: %s", tableKey, data)
	require.Equal(t, incarnationSeq, tableJournal.IncarnationSeq)
	require.Equal(t, copyTable, tableJournal.Copy)
	require.False(t, tableJournal.Foreign)
	require.Empty(t, tableJournal.Diverged)
	journaled := make([]string, 0, len(tableJournal.Parts))
	for _, p := range tableJournal.Parts {
		journaled = append(journaled, p.PartRowLtHash)
	}
	require.Equal(t, sortedStrings(hashes), sortedStrings(journaled))

	stats := running.role.Stats()
	require.True(t, stats.Ready)
	require.Equal(t, 1, stats.Owners[0].Copies)
	require.Equal(t, ownerEntry, stats.Owners[0].Entry)

	// The member called only the read RPCs of contract §20.1.
	allowed := map[string]bool{
		"/arbiter.SafeState/GetSafeWatermark":       true,
		"/arbiter.SafeState/GetManifest":            true,
		"/arbiter.SafeState/GetBlockVerification":   true,
		"/arbiter.TableRegistry/GetTableRegistry":   true,
		"/arbiter.TableRegistry/WatchTableRegistry": true,
		"/arbiter.TableRegistry/GetPurgeNodeSet":    true,
	}
	for _, method := range calls.seen() {
		require.True(t, allowed[method], "the si-member called %s", method)
	}

	stop()
	select {
	case err := <-runErr:
		require.NoError(t, err)
	case <-time.After(time.Minute):
		t.Fatal("the si-member did not stop after its context ended")
	}
}
```

```go
// Package simember runs the storage-integrity si-member (housegate spec
// 2026-10-14 §8.1, Plan S3-C2 K30): a process of its own, beside the host's
// sentio-node, that keeps verified hg_replica copies of every peer owner's SI
// tables and shadow-verifies the owners' sealed blocks. It reads only its own
// config file, logs in to ClickHouse as its own user, needs no PRIVATE_KEY
// and calls only the arbiter's read RPCs (contract §20.1).
package simember

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log/slog"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"compute-network-node/config"

	"github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"
	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/collectors"
	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promhttp"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/dastore"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member"
)

// siMemberShutdownTimeout bounds the metrics server's graceful shutdown.
const siMemberShutdownTimeout = 10 * time.Second

// siMemberRole is the part of *member.Role that Run drives.
type siMemberRole interface {
	Run(ctx context.Context) error
	Ready() bool
	Stats() member.Stats
}

// runDeps are Run's seams; production uses defaultRunDeps.
type runDeps struct {
	openClickHouse func(*clickhouse.Options) (clickhouse.Conn, error)
	newRole        func(member.Config, member.Deps) (siMemberRole, error)
	listen         func(network, address string) (net.Listener, error)
	// started, when set, is called once the metrics listener is bound and
	// before the role runs.
	started func(role siMemberRole, metrics net.Addr)
}

func defaultRunDeps() runDeps {
	return runDeps{
		openClickHouse: clickhouse.Open,
		newRole: func(cfg member.Config, deps member.Deps) (siMemberRole, error) {
			role, err := member.New(cfg, deps)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return role, nil
		},
		listen: net.Listen,
	}
}

// Run runs the si-member until ctx ends: one ClickHouse connection as
// storage_integrity.member.clickhouse_username, a data-plane client and a
// table-registry follower on the arbiter peers, a DA client on
// payload_store_data_addr, the member role, and Prometheus metrics plus
// GET /readyz on metrics_listen. It returns nil once ctx ends and an error
// when any part stops on its own.
func Run(ctx context.Context, cfg *config.SIMemberConfig) error {
	return run(ctx, cfg, defaultRunDeps())
}

func run(ctx context.Context, cfg *config.SIMemberConfig, deps runDeps) error {
	if cfg == nil {
		return errors.New("si-member: a config is required")
	}
	si := cfg.StorageIntegrity
	m := si.Member
	memberCfg, err := cfg.MemberConfig()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("si-member: %w", err)
	}
	logger := newSIMemberLogger(ctx).With("component", "si-member", "node_id", m.NodeID)
	logger.Info("starting the si-member", "config", *cfg)

	conn, err := deps.openClickHouse(m.ClickhouseOptions())
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("si-member clickhouse: %w", err)
	}
	defer closeLogged(logger, "clickhouse connection", conn.Close)

	peers := make([]dataplane.Peer, 0, len(si.ArbiterPeers))
	for _, peer := range si.ArbiterPeers {
		peers = append(peers, dataplane.Peer{ID: peer.ID, GRPCAddr: peer.Addr})
	}
	client, err := dataplane.New(dataplane.Config{Peers: peers, Logger: logger})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("si-member arbiter client: %w", err)
	}
	defer client.Close()
	follower := dataplane.NewRegistryFollower(client, logger)

	payloads, err := dastore.New(dastore.Config{DataAddr: si.PayloadStoreDataAddr})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("si-member payload store: %w", err)
	}
	defer closeLogged(logger, "payload store", payloads.Close)

	role, err := deps.newRole(memberCfg, member.Deps{
		Client:   client,
		Conn:     conn,
		Registry: follower,
		Payloads: payloads,
		Logger:   logger,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("si-member: %w", err)
	}

	owners := make([]uint64, 0, len(m.Peers))
	for _, peer := range m.Peers {
		owners = append(owners, peer.IndexerID)
	}
	registry := prometheus.NewRegistry()
	for _, collector := range []prometheus.Collector{
		newSIMemberCollector(role, owners),
		collectors.NewGoCollector(),
		collectors.NewProcessCollector(collectors.ProcessCollectorOpts{}),
	} {
		if err := registry.Register(collector); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("si-member metrics: %w", err)
		}
	}
	listener, err := deps.listen("tcp", m.MetricsListen)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("si-member metrics listener %s: %w", m.MetricsListen, err)
	}
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.Handle("/metrics", promhttp.HandlerFor(registry, promhttp.HandlerOpts{}))
	mux.Handle("/readyz", readyzHandler(role))
	server := &http.Server{Handler: mux, ReadHeaderTimeout: 10 * time.Second}
	if deps.started != nil {
		deps.started(role, listener.Addr())
	}
	logger.Info("si-member metrics and readiness listening", "addr", listener.Addr().String())

	runCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	defer cancel()
	type exit struct {
		part string
		err  error
	}
	exits := make(chan exit, 3)
	go func() {
		err := server.Serve(listener)
		if errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
			err = nil
		}
		exits <- exit{"metrics server", err}
	}()
	go func() { exits <- exit{"table registry follower", follower.Run(runCtx)} }()
	go func() { exits <- exit{"member role", role.Run(runCtx)} }()

	first := <-exits
	cancel()
	shutdownCtx, done := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), siMemberShutdownTimeout)
	defer done()
	if err := server.Shutdown(shutdownCtx); err != nil {
		logger.Warn("shut down the si-member metrics server", "err", err)
	}
	for range 2 {
		<-exits
	}
	if ctx.Err() != nil {
		logger.Info("si-member stopped")
		return nil
	}
	if first.err == nil {
		first.err = errors.New("stopped while the si-member was running")
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("si-member: %s: %w", first.part, first.err)
}

// readyzHandler answers GET /readyz with 200 once the role is ready (its
// startup audit is clean and every peer's copies reached a manifest) and 503
// before; Plan S3-C3's StatefulSet uses it as the readiness probe.
func readyzHandler(role interface{ Ready() bool }) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Method != http.MethodGet && r.Method != http.MethodHead {
			w.Header().Set("Allow", "GET, HEAD")
			http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
		if !role.Ready() {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, "not ready\n")
			return
		}
		_, _ = io.WriteString(w, "ready\n")
	})
}

func closeLogged(logger *slog.Logger, what string, close func() error) {
	if err := close(); err != nil {
		logger.Warn("close the si-member "+what, "err", err)
	}
}
```

Create `simember/metrics.go`:

```go
package simember

import (
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"time"

	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/install"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/shadow"
)

// siMemberStats is the member role's stats surface ((*member.Role).Stats).
type siMemberStats interface {
	Stats() member.Stats
}

// The label values exported at zero before the member has seen any of them
// (Plan S3-C2 contract §24.4), so an alert never reads a missing series. A
// value a later arbiter-core adds is exported too, never dropped.
var (
	siMemberInstallOutcomes = []install.Outcome{"kept", "rename_race", "split", "doubled", "foreign", "missed", "refused", "unreachable"}
	siMemberInstallSources  = []string{"owner_pull", "peer_unsafe_pull", "restore"}
	siMemberFeedOutcomes    = []string{"accepted", "refused"}
	siMemberAuditTriggers   = []string{"startup", "clickhouse_restart", "self_audit"}
	siMemberMismatchKinds   = []shadow.MismatchKind{shadow.MismatchReceipt, shadow.MismatchScan, shadow.MismatchClaim}
)

// siMemberCollector exports member.Stats at scrape time on the si-member's
// own registry. Plan S3-C3's alerts read these series: a shadow mismatch, a
// Foreign or Diverged copy, a copy that stays behind its owner, the disk
// budget and the readiness of the member.
type siMemberCollector struct {
	source siMemberStats
	owners []uint64
	now    func() time.Time

	info, ready                                       *prometheus.Desc
	copies, copySafeBlockSeq, copyAppliedPromotionSeq *prometheus.Desc
	publishedSafeBlockSeq, copyBehindSeconds          *prometheus.Desc
	divergedPartitions, divergedTables, foreignTables *prometheus.Desc
	installOutcomes, installs                         *prometheus.Desc
	feedManifests, feedFullFetches                    *prometheus.Desc
	auditRuns, auditDroppedTwins, auditClean          *prometheus.Desc
	installsPaused, diskUsedBytes, diskBudgetBytes    *prometheus.Desc
	grantsUnreadable, unconfiguredOwners              *prometheus.Desc
	shadowBlocks, shadowMismatches, shadowMissedScans *prometheus.Desc
	shadowUnverdicted, shadowNextBlockSeq             *prometheus.Desc
}

// newSIMemberCollector exports source's stats; owners are the configured
// peers, every one of which is exported from zero.
func newSIMemberCollector(source siMemberStats, owners []uint64) *siMemberCollector {
	owned := slices.Clone(owners)
	slices.Sort(owned)
	desc := func(name, help string, labels ...string) *prometheus.Desc {
		return prometheus.NewDesc("sentio_node_si_member_"+name, help, labels, nil)
	}
	return &siMemberCollector{
		source: source,
		owners: slices.Compact(owned),
		now:    time.Now,

		info:                    desc("info", "The si-member's identity: always 1.", "node_id", "host_indexer_id"),
		ready:                   desc("ready", "1 once the startup audit is clean and every peer's copies reached a manifest (GET /readyz answers 200)."),
		copies:                  desc("copies", "Ready hg_replica copies of the owner's SI tables.", "owner"),
		copySafeBlockSeq:        desc("copy_safe_block_seq", "safe_block_seq of the owner's track entry the copies are journaled at.", "owner"),
		copyAppliedPromotionSeq: desc("copy_applied_promotion_seq", "applied_promotion_seq of the owner's track entry the copies are journaled at.", "owner"),
		publishedSafeBlockSeq:   desc("published_safe_block_seq", "safe_block_seq of the owner's track entry in the newest accepted manifest.", "owner"),
		copyBehindSeconds:       desc("copy_behind_seconds", "Seconds since the owner's copies first lagged the newest accepted manifest; 0 while they match it.", "owner"),
		divergedPartitions:      desc("diverged_partitions_total", "Partitions of the owner's copies found Diverged and repaired since startup.", "owner"),
		divergedTables:          desc("diverged_tables", "The owner's copies that hold a Diverged partition awaiting repair.", "owner"),
		foreignTables:           desc("foreign_tables", "The owner's copies quarantined locally because a scratch held a part no manifest lists (cleared only offline with si-member clear-foreign).", "owner"),
		installOutcomes:         desc("install_outcomes_total", "Scratch fetches by outcome since startup.", "outcome"),
		installs:                desc("installs_total", "Parts installed into a copy since startup, by byte source.", "source"),
		feedManifests:           desc("feed_manifests_total", "Watermark manifests the feed accepted or refused since startup.", "outcome"),
		feedFullFetches:         desc("feed_full_fetches_total", "Watermark manifests accepted alone because the parent walk exceeded its bound or nothing was accepted before."),
		auditRuns:               desc("audit_runs_total", "Copy audits since startup, by trigger.", "trigger"),
		auditDroppedTwins:       desc("audit_dropped_twins_total", "Equal-hash twin parts the audits dropped with DROP PART since startup."),
		auditClean:              desc("audit_clean", "1 while the last audit found every copy consistent with the journal."),
		installsPaused:          desc("installs_paused", "1 while installs pause above stop_installs_ratio of the member disk budget."),
		diskUsedBytes:           desc("disk_used_bytes", "bytes_on_disk of every part of hg_replica and hg_rstage."),
		diskBudgetBytes:         desc("disk_budget_bytes", "The configured member disk budget."),
		grantsUnreadable:        desc("grants_unreadable", "1 when system.grants is not readable by si_member, so only the behavioural posture probes ran."),
		unconfiguredOwners:      desc("unconfigured_owners", "Enrolled SI indexers that are neither a configured peer nor the host."),
		shadowBlocks:            desc("shadow_blocks_total", "The owner's sealed blocks the shadow verifier compared since startup.", "owner"),
		shadowMismatches:        desc("shadow_mismatches_total", "Shadow-verification mismatches of the owner's blocks since startup, by kind.", "owner", "kind"),
		shadowMissedScans:       desc("shadow_missed_scans_total", "Candidate parts already cleaned from the owner's hg_unsafe when the shadow verifier pulled them.", "owner"),
		shadowUnverdicted:       desc("shadow_unverdicted_total", "The owner's blocks compared without an evaluated verdict after the verdict wait.", "owner"),
		shadowNextBlockSeq:      desc("shadow_next_block_seq", "The next block seq the shadow verifier reads (its durable cursor)."),
	}
}

func (c *siMemberCollector) Describe(ch chan<- *prometheus.Desc) {
	for _, d := range []*prometheus.Desc{
		c.info, c.ready, c.copies, c.copySafeBlockSeq, c.copyAppliedPromotionSeq, c.publishedSafeBlockSeq, c.copyBehindSeconds,
		c.divergedPartitions, c.divergedTables, c.foreignTables, c.installOutcomes, c.installs, c.feedManifests, c.feedFullFetches,
		c.auditRuns, c.auditDroppedTwins, c.auditClean, c.installsPaused, c.diskUsedBytes, c.diskBudgetBytes, c.grantsUnreadable,
		c.unconfiguredOwners, c.shadowBlocks, c.shadowMismatches, c.shadowMissedScans, c.shadowUnverdicted, c.shadowNextBlockSeq,
	} {
		ch <- d
	}
}

func (c *siMemberCollector) Collect(ch chan<- prometheus.Metric) {
	s := c.source.Stats()
	gauge := func(d *prometheus.Desc, v float64, labels ...string) {
		ch <- prometheus.MustNewConstMetric(d, prometheus.GaugeValue, v, labels...)
	}
	counter := func(d *prometheus.Desc, v uint64, labels ...string) {
		ch <- prometheus.MustNewConstMetric(d, prometheus.CounterValue, float64(v), labels...)
	}
	flag := func(b bool) float64 {
		if b {
			return 1
		}
		return 0
	}

	gauge(c.info, 1, s.NodeID, strconv.FormatUint(s.HostIndexerID, 10))
	gauge(c.ready, flag(s.Ready))
	now := c.now()
	for _, owner := range labelValues(c.owners, s.Owners) {
		o, label := s.Owners[owner], strconv.FormatUint(owner, 10)
		gauge(c.copies, float64(o.Copies), label)
		gauge(c.copySafeBlockSeq, float64(o.Entry.SafeBlockSeq), label)
		gauge(c.copyAppliedPromotionSeq, float64(o.Entry.AppliedPromotionSeq), label)
		gauge(c.publishedSafeBlockSeq, float64(o.PublishedEntry.SafeBlockSeq), label)
		behind := 0.0
		if !o.BehindSince.IsZero() && now.After(o.BehindSince) {
			behind = now.Sub(o.BehindSince).Seconds()
		}
		gauge(c.copyBehindSeconds, behind, label)
		counter(c.divergedPartitions, o.DivergedPartitions, label)
		gauge(c.divergedTables, float64(o.DivergedTables), label)
		gauge(c.foreignTables, float64(o.ForeignTables), label)
		counter(c.shadowBlocks, o.ShadowBlocks, label)
		for _, kind := range labelValues(siMemberMismatchKinds, o.ShadowMismatches) {
			counter(c.shadowMismatches, o.ShadowMismatches[kind], label, string(kind))
		}
		counter(c.shadowMissedScans, o.ShadowMissedScans, label)
		counter(c.shadowUnverdicted, o.ShadowUnverdicted, label)
	}
	for _, outcome := range labelValues(siMemberInstallOutcomes, s.InstallOutcomes) {
		counter(c.installOutcomes, s.InstallOutcomes[outcome], string(outcome))
	}
	for _, source := range labelValues(siMemberInstallSources, s.Installs) {
		counter(c.installs, s.Installs[source], source)
	}
	feed := map[string]uint64{"accepted": s.FeedAccepted, "refused": s.FeedRefused}
	for _, outcome := range siMemberFeedOutcomes {
		counter(c.feedManifests, feed[outcome], outcome)
	}
	counter(c.feedFullFetches, s.FeedFullFetches)
	for _, trigger := range labelValues(siMemberAuditTriggers, s.AuditRuns) {
		counter(c.auditRuns, s.AuditRuns[trigger], trigger)
	}
	counter(c.auditDroppedTwins, s.AuditDroppedTwins)
	gauge(c.auditClean, flag(s.AuditClean))
	gauge(c.installsPaused, flag(s.InstallsPaused))
	gauge(c.diskUsedBytes, float64(s.DiskUsedBytes))
	gauge(c.diskBudgetBytes, float64(s.DiskBudgetBytes))
	gauge(c.grantsUnreadable, flag(s.GrantsUnreadable))
	gauge(c.unconfiguredOwners, float64(len(s.UnconfiguredOwners)))
	gauge(c.shadowNextBlockSeq, float64(s.ShadowNextBlockSeq))
}

// labelValues is fixed followed by every other key of seen, sorted, so each
// fixed value is exported from zero and a value only a later arbiter-core
// knows is still exported.
func labelValues[K interface{ ~string | ~uint64 }, V any](fixed []K, seen map[K]V) []K {
	out := slices.Clone(fixed)
	var extra []K
	for key := range seen {
		if !slices.Contains(fixed, key) {
			extra = append(extra, key)
		}
	}
	slices.Sort(extra)
	return append(out, extra...)
}
```

Create `simember/slog.go`:

```go
package simember

import (
	"context"
	"log/slog"
	"strings"

	"compute-network-node/common/log"

	"go.uber.org/zap"
	"go.uber.org/zap/zapcore"
)

// zapSlogHandler hands slog records (arbiter-core's member role and
// data-plane clients log through slog) to the process's zap logger, so the
// --log-level flag and the log format of every sentio-node command apply to
// the si-member too. Attribute values are resolved first, so a value's
// LogValue (the config's redacted rendering) is what reaches the log.
type zapSlogHandler struct {
	logger *zap.SugaredLogger
	fields []any
	groups []string
}

func newSIMemberLogger(ctx context.Context) *slog.Logger {
	return slog.New(&zapSlogHandler{logger: log.WithContext(ctx)})
}

func (h *zapSlogHandler) Enabled(_ context.Context, level slog.Level) bool {
	return h.logger.Desugar().Core().Enabled(zapLevel(level))
}

func (h *zapSlogHandler) Handle(_ context.Context, record slog.Record) error {
	fields := append([]any(nil), h.fields...)
	record.Attrs(func(attr slog.Attr) bool {
		fields = appendSlogField(fields, h.groups, attr)
		return true
	})
	switch zapLevel(record.Level) {
	case zapcore.ErrorLevel:
		h.logger.Errorw(record.Message, fields...)
	case zapcore.WarnLevel:
		h.logger.Warnw(record.Message, fields...)
	case zapcore.InfoLevel:
		h.logger.Infow(record.Message, fields...)
	default:
		h.logger.Debugw(record.Message, fields...)
	}
	return nil
}

func (h *zapSlogHandler) WithAttrs(attrs []slog.Attr) slog.Handler {
	clone := *h
	clone.fields = append([]any(nil), h.fields...)
	for _, attr := range attrs {
		clone.fields = appendSlogField(clone.fields, h.groups, attr)
	}
	return &clone
}

func (h *zapSlogHandler) WithGroup(name string) slog.Handler {
	if name == "" {
		return h
	}
	clone := *h
	clone.groups = append(append([]string(nil), h.groups...), name)
	return &clone
}

func zapLevel(level slog.Level) zapcore.Level {
	switch {
	case level >= slog.LevelError:
		return zapcore.ErrorLevel
	case level >= slog.LevelWarn:
		return zapcore.WarnLevel
	case level >= slog.LevelInfo:
		return zapcore.InfoLevel
	default:
		return zapcore.DebugLevel
	}
}

// appendSlogField flattens one attribute into zap's key-value list, joining
// group names with dots.
func appendSlogField(fields []any, groups []string, attr slog.Attr) []any {
	attr.Value = attr.Value.Resolve()
	if attr.Equal(slog.Attr{}) {
		return fields
	}
	if attr.Value.Kind() == slog.KindGroup {
		if attr.Key != "" {
			groups = append(append([]string(nil), groups...), attr.Key)
		}
		for _, child := range attr.Value.Group() {
			fields = appendSlogField(fields, groups, child)
		}
		return fields
	}
	key := strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), groups...), attr.Key), ".")
	if key == "" {
		return fields
	}
	return append(fields, key, attr.Value.Any())
}
```

```go
package commands

import (
	"bytes"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"testing"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

// writeSIMemberCommandConfig writes a valid si-member config whose state
// directory is stateDir and returns its path.
func writeSIMemberCommandConfig(t *testing.T, stateDir string) string {
	t.Helper()
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "si-member.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(strings.ReplaceAll(`storage_integrity:
  arbiter_peers:
    - {id: arbiter-0, addr: "127.0.0.1:1"}
  payload_store_data_addr: "127.0.0.1:1"
  member:
    node_id: member-b
    host_indexer_id: 1
    state_dir: @STATE@
    network_id: devnet2
    genesis_snapshot_id: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111"
    clickhouse_dsn: "127.0.0.1:9000"
    clickhouse_username: si_member
    peers:
      - {indexer_id: 0, collection: si_owner_0}
    disk_budget_bytes: 1073741824
`, "@STATE@", stateDir)), 0o600))
	return path
}

func TestSIMemberCommandIsRegistered(t *testing.T) {
	path := "si-member.yaml"
	cmd := NewSIMemberCommand(&path)
	require.Equal(t, "si-member", cmd.Name())
	require.Equal(t, "Run the storage-integrity si-member (copies and shadow verification, stage 3 P2)", cmd.Short)
	require.NotNil(t, cmd.RunE, "si-member runs the member process itself")
	require.Error(t, cmd.Args(cmd, []string{"extra"}), "si-member takes no positional arguments")
	require.NoError(t, cmd.Args(cmd, nil))
	require.Nil(t, cmd.Flags().Lookup("config-path"), "the root's persistent --config-path names the member's own file")

	sub, rest, err := cmd.Find([]string{"clear-foreign"})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Empty(t, rest)
	require.Equal(t, "clear-foreign", sub.Name())
	table := sub.Flags().Lookup("table")
	require.NotNil(t, table)
	require.Equal(t, []string{"true"}, table.Annotations["cobra_annotation_bash_completion_one_required_flag"], "--table is required")
}

func TestSIMemberClearForeignNeedsATable(t *testing.T) {
	path := "si-member.yaml"
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		args    []string
		refusal string
	}{
		{[]string{"clear-foreign"}, `required flag(s) "table" not set`},
		{[]string{"clear-foreign", "--table", "orders"}, `si-member clear-foreign --table must be <database>.<table>, got "orders"`},
		{[]string{"clear-foreign", "--table", "orders.t.x"}, `si-member clear-foreign --table must be <database>.<table>, got "orders.t.x"`},
		{[]string{"clear-foreign", "--table", ".t"}, `si-member clear-foreign --table must be <database>.<table>, got ".t"`},
	} {
		cmd := NewSIMemberCommand(&path)
		var out bytes.Buffer
		cmd.SetOut(&out)
		cmd.SetErr(&out)
		cmd.SetArgs(tc.args)
		require.EqualError(t, cmd.Execute(), tc.refusal, "%v", tc.args)
	}
}

// TestSIMemberClearForeignClearsTheConfiguredStateDir pins the offline
// command's contract: install.ClearForeign on storage_integrity.member's
// state_dir and the table, then one line on stdout.
func TestSIMemberClearForeignClearsTheConfiguredStateDir(t *testing.T) {
	stateDir := t.TempDir()
	path := writeSIMemberCommandConfig(t, stateDir)
	var gotDir, gotTable string
	saved := siMemberClearForeign
	t.Cleanup(func() { siMemberClearForeign = saved })
	siMemberClearForeign = func(dir, table string) error {
		gotDir, gotTable = dir, table
		return nil
	}

	cmd := NewSIMemberCommand(&path)
	var out bytes.Buffer
	cmd.SetOut(&out)
	cmd.SetErr(&out)
	cmd.SetArgs([]string{"clear-foreign", "--table", "orders.t"})
	require.NoError(t, cmd.Execute())
	require.Equal(t, stateDir, gotDir)
	require.Equal(t, "orders.t", gotTable)
	require.Equal(t, "cleared foreign quarantine of orders.t; the copy is rebuilt at the next start\n", out.String())
}

// TestSIMemberClearForeignRefusesWhileTheMemberRuns pins K36: the quarantine
// is cleared only offline, so clear-foreign refuses while a member holds the
// state directory's lock.
func TestSIMemberClearForeignRefusesWhileTheMemberRuns(t *testing.T) {
	stateDir := t.TempDir()
	path := writeSIMemberCommandConfig(t, stateDir)
	lock, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(stateDir, member.LockFile), os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer lock.Close()
	require.NoError(t, syscall.Flock(int(lock.Fd()), syscall.LOCK_EX|syscall.LOCK_NB))

	cmd := NewSIMemberCommand(&path)
	var out bytes.Buffer
	cmd.SetOut(&out)
	cmd.SetErr(&out)
	cmd.SetArgs([]string{"clear-foreign", "--table", "orders.t"})
	require.EqualError(t, cmd.Execute(), "install: state dir "+stateDir+" is locked by a running si-member")
	require.NotContains(t, out.String(), "cleared foreign quarantine")
}
```

Create `commands/si_member.go`:

```go
package commands

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"strings"
	"syscall"

	"compute-network-node/config"
	"compute-network-node/simember"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/install"
	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
)

// siMemberClearForeign is install.ClearForeign; a variable so the command
// test can observe what reaches it.
var siMemberClearForeign = install.ClearForeign

// NewSIMemberCommand runs the storage-integrity si-member (housegate spec
// 2026-10-14 §8.1, Plan S3-C2 K30) as a process of its own: it reads only the
// member's config file named by the root's --config-path, never the host's
// sentio-node config, needs no PRIVATE_KEY, and stops cleanly on SIGINT or
// SIGTERM.
func NewSIMemberCommand(configPath *string) *cobra.Command {
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "si-member",
		Short: "Run the storage-integrity si-member (copies and shadow verification, stage 3 P2)",
		Long: "Keeps one hg_replica copy of every SI table of every configured peer owner, filled only with parts a " +
			"verified arbiter manifest lists, and, with storage_integrity.member.shadow_verification, shadow-verifies " +
			"the peers' sealed blocks. It logs in to ClickHouse as storage_integrity.member.clickhouse_username with the " +
			"password from STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD, calls only the arbiter's read RPCs and serves " +
			"Prometheus metrics and GET /readyz on storage_integrity.member.metrics_listen.",
		Args: cobra.NoArgs,
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
			cfg, err := config.LoadSIMemberConfig(*configPath)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			parent := cmd.Context()
			if parent == nil {
				parent = context.Background()
			}
			ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(parent, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
			defer stop()
			return simember.Run(ctx, cfg)
		},
	}
	cmd.AddCommand(newSIMemberClearForeignCommand(configPath))
	return cmd
}

// newSIMemberClearForeignCommand clears a Foreign quarantine (Plan S3-C2
// K36) offline: install.ClearForeign refuses while a member holds the state
// directory, and the copy is dropped and rebuilt at the member's next start.
func newSIMemberClearForeignCommand(configPath *string) *cobra.Command {
	var table string
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "clear-foreign",
		Short: "Clear a copy's Foreign quarantine while the si-member is stopped",
		Long: "Run it with the si-member stopped, after the scratch the journal names as foreign_scratch has been " +
			"examined. It reads storage_integrity.member.state_dir from the member's config file; the copy is dropped " +
			"and rebuilt from its sources at the next start.",
		Args: cobra.NoArgs,
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
			database, name, ok := strings.Cut(table, ".")
			if !ok || database == "" || name == "" || strings.Contains(name, ".") {
				return fmt.Errorf("si-member clear-foreign --table must be <database>.<table>, got %q", table)
			}
			cfg, err := config.LoadSIMemberConfig(*configPath)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := siMemberClearForeign(cfg.StorageIntegrity.Member.StateDir, table); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			_, err = fmt.Fprintf(cmd.OutOrStdout(), "cleared foreign quarantine of %s; the copy is rebuilt at the next start\n", table)
			return err
		},
	}
	cmd.Flags().StringVar(&table, "table", "", "the quarantined table, <database>.<table> as the install journal and the logs name it")
	cobra.CheckErr(cmd.MarkFlagRequired("table"))
	return cmd
}
```

with:

````markdown
### Storage-integrity si-member (stage 3 P2)

`sentio-node si-member` runs a storage-integrity member next to an SI host (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §8): a process of its own, never part of the host's sentio-node, that keeps one `hg_replica` copy of every SI table of every configured peer owner and fills it only with parts a verified arbiter manifest lists (arbiter-core `member.Role`). With `shadow_verification` it also replays every sealed block of its peers from DA, scans the block's candidate parts pulled from the owner's `hg_unsafe`, and compares its receipts and scans with the verifiers' evidence; it never submits anything. It has no consensus identity: it calls only the arbiter's read RPCs and needs no `PRIVATE_KEY`. It reads only its own config file, never the host's sentio-node config, which it refuses (every key outside `storage_integrity.arbiter_peers`, `payload_store_data_addr` and `member` is refused):

```yaml
storage_integrity:
  arbiter_peers:
    - {id: arbiter-0, addr: "arbiter-0.arbiter:7080"}
  payload_store_data_addr: "payload-store:9001"
  member:
    node_id: member-b  # ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,30}[a-z0-9]$, never an SNode, verifier or voter id
    host_indexer_id: 1  # the host's SI indexer, never one of the peers
    state_dir: /data/si-member  # the install journal, the shadow cursor and the LOCK one process holds
    network_id: devnet2
    genesis_snapshot_id: "0x2f5b1c7e9a4d3b6f8e0a1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f"
    genesis_tables: []  # the genesis table schemas, checked against the genesis manifest at startup
    clickhouse_dsn: "source-clickhouse:9000"  # the host's own source ClickHouse
    clickhouse_username: si_member  # required: never default; the password only from STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD
    storage_policy: member  # the member disk's policy; empty keeps the server's default
    peers:  # P2's static group scope: every other SI indexer, each through its NOT OVERRIDABLE collection
      - {indexer_id: 0, collection: si_owner_0}
      - {indexer_id: 2, collection: si_owner_2}
    pool_collections: [si_peer_verifier_1, si_peer_verifier_2]  # the peer unsafe pull's sources
    restore: {endpoint: "https://storage.googleapis.com", bucket: si-replica}  # optional; its key only from the environment
    shadow_verification: true
    poll_interval: 5s  # the default; at least 1s
    disk_budget_bytes: 107374182400  # required
    stop_installs_ratio: 0.8  # the default; installs pause at this share of disk_budget_bytes
    self_audit_interval: 6h  # the default; at least 10m
    metrics_listen: ":9093"  # the default
```

```bash
/sentio-node si-member --config-path /config/si-member.yaml
/sentio-node si-member clear-foreign --config-path /config/si-member.yaml --table orders.t
```

The member logs in to ClickHouse as `clickhouse_username` with the password from `STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD`, and the restore source takes its key from `STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_SECRET`. A config file that sets `storage_integrity.member.clickhouse_password`, `restore.access_key_id` or `restore.secret` is refused whatever the value, and no rendering of the config prints a secret. Before it writes any copy, the member refuses to start unless its server refuses an ungranted engine (`access_control_improvements.table_engines_require_grant`) and `remote()` refuses writes for its user, and unless its node id is unused, every peer is enrolled and the genesis tables match the genesis manifest. Its ClickHouse user is `si_member` with exactly the grants of Plan S3-C2 contract §23.2; every collection logs in to the peer's ClickHouse as `si_reader`, which needs `SELECT` on `hg_safe.*` and `hg_unsafe.*`, `SHOW COLUMNS ON system.parts` and `SELECT(database, table, name, active, rows, partition_id, hash_of_all_files) ON system.parts`.

`metrics_listen` serves the member's Prometheus series (`sentio_node_si_member_*`: readiness, copies and their track entries per owner, install outcomes and sources, feed, audits, disk budget, shadow blocks, mismatches, missed scans and unverdicted blocks, every label value exported from zero) and `GET /readyz`, which answers 200 once the startup audit is clean and every peer's copies reached a manifest, and 503 before. A copy whose scratch received a part no manifest lists is quarantined (Foreign): only `si-member clear-foreign`, run while the si-member is stopped, clears it, and the copy is rebuilt at the next start.

`si-member install acceptance` in CI (`TestSIMemberInstallsACopyFromTheOwnerPull`, `SENTIO_SI_MEMBER_CH_E2E=1`) runs the member against two `clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3.37.3` servers on a private Docker network: the owner's, with a promoted `hg_safe` table, and the member's, with `scripts/ci/clickhouse-member-access-control.xml` (the engine fence) and `scripts/ci/clickhouse-member-users.xml` (lets the test's `default` create the collection); `CH_MEMBER_ADDR` and `CH_OWNER_ADDR` are the two servers as the test reaches them and `CH_OWNER_ADDR_FROM_MEMBER` the owner as the member's server reaches it. `remote()` against a server's own address runs locally as the calling user, so the owner is never the member's server.
````

```bash
The si-member process of stage 3 P2 of the multi-source storage-integrity network (housegate spec `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-multi-source-si-stage3-database-groups-design.md` §8.1, §8.2, §8.5, §8.6, §16 P2; Plan S3-C2 Task 35, contract §24).

- Pins arbiter-core `@CORE_TAG_P2@` (go.mod, bazel_dep and git_override), which adds the si-member role; housegate stays `@HG_TAG_P1@` and arbiter-proto `@PROTO_TAG@`.
- `sentio-node si-member --config-path <file>`: a process of its own, never part of the host's sentio-node. It reads only its own file (`config.LoadSIMemberConfig`, `KnownFields`, so the host's config is refused), logs in to ClickHouse as `storage_integrity.member.clickhouse_username` (required, never `default`) with the password only from `STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD`, takes the restore key only from `STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_ACCESS_KEY_ID` / `STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_SECRET` (a file that sets any of them is refused whatever the value), needs no `PRIVATE_KEY` and calls only the arbiter's read RPCs.
- `simember`: the member role with a data-plane client, a table-registry follower and the DA client; on `metrics_listen` its own registry with the 27 `sentio_node_si_member_*` series (every label value exported from zero) and `GET /readyz` (200 once the startup audit is clean and every peer's copies reached a manifest).
- `sentio-node si-member clear-foreign --table <database>.<table>`: clears a Foreign quarantine offline; refused while a member holds the state directory.
- CI: the `integration-clickhouse` job's new step `si-member install acceptance` runs `TestSIMemberInstallsACopyFromTheOwnerPull` on two `clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3.37.3` servers (the owner's and a fenced member server with `table_engines_require_grant`); the job's timeout goes from 30 to 45 minutes.

No host behaviour changes: `standalone.Run` and the host's config loader are untouched, and nothing runs `si-member` until the stage-3 P2 chart change.
```

Notes:
- **No consensus change, no release (contract §20.1, §24.7).** The pin commit moves arbiter-core to `CORE_TAG_P2` and housegate to `HG_TAG_P1`; the rest is tests, a script and CI. `cut-release.yml` is not touched and not run; `ARBITER_PIN_P2` becomes part of the base Plan S3-D releases as `ARBITER_TAG_P4`. The merge to `main` runs `ci.yml` on the push, whose `docker-dev` job moves `ghcr.io/sentioxyz/arbiter:dev` as every merge does; devnet2's voters, verifiers and hosts pin `ARBITER_DIGEST` by digest, so no devnet2 pod changes.
- **The equality proof (contract §24.8).** `TestManifestTableOwnerMatchesWireManifestOwner` builds four registries by hand (pre-signed-claims chain incarnations, whose owner is the founding indexer; post-activation ones with explicit owners, indexer 0 among them; Pending never added; Refused re-creations, including a Refused-only key; Retiring, Purging, Purged and a re-creation after a purge; and a Refused incarnation that carries an add block, which Apply cannot produce but which pins the order of the checks) and one through Apply (Plan S2-A's track-manifest fixture with a Refused duplicate of the genesis table and a Pending table), maps the FSM's `TableRegistryView` — what the `TableRegistry` read API serves — to `wire.TableRegistrySnapshot` field by field (statuses, origins and retire reasons through explicit maps; the field counts of both structs are pinned at 18), and requires `manifestTableOwnerLocked` and `ManifestOwner` to agree on every key and on an unknown one. While drafting, six mutations of the ported rule (no Refused skip, any origin, a missing owner read as 0, oldest incarnation first, genesis needing an add block, Active instead of an add block) each failed it.
- **The activation sequence (contract §24.9, K37; Appendix B).** The contract lists its parts; the order is the gates': the signed-claims gate refuses unless every registered SNode it does not evict advertised `signed_claims_v1` to this leader in its term (`server/signed_claims_gate.go`), and an SNode advertises it only with a claim signer, so the SNode restarts with indexer 0's key (on its durable state) before the activation, not after. The verifiers register signed and with every feature from the start; `gatedConsensusUpdate` registers all four nodes again only when a gate refuses (a leader change), as the integration harness does. The tracks activation names every voter's admin address (each node's gRPC listener serves ConsensusAdmin in this harness). Consensus updates go straight to the leader, because the harness's `withLeaderRetry` takes every `FailedPrecondition`, a gate refusal included, for a redirect. The table registry's activation block, chain id and contract are the integration harness's. After `enableTracks` the registry attributes `db.t` to indexer 0, and the first manifest published afterwards carries `track_frontiers [{0, …}]` (`TestPipeline_TracksActivationOnTheHarnessSNode`, which also runs in the existing `integration-clickhouse` job on ClickHouse 25.8).
- **Fraud under tracks.** After the activation a Rejected block quarantines its track automatically and the arbiter accepts only signed result claims, so `registerRC` signs the fraud tests' manual claims with the owner's key (unchanged before the activation: `claimSigner` is nil there), and the fraud test waits until the shadow verifier is past the Rejected block — while its candidate parts are still in the owner's `hg_unsafe` — before it releases the track with an authority-signed `ReleaseIndexer` acknowledging exactly that block and waits for the rejected-part cleanup. It then writes an honest statement, so the copy is checked against a manifest published after the Rejected block as well.
- **The member's two servers.** ClickHouse runs `remote()` against its own address locally, as the calling user, so the owner is a second server: `CH_ADDR` is the harness's own (SNode, verifiers, `hg_safe_<suffix>`, `hg_unsafe_<suffix>`, `si_reader`), `CH_MEMBER_ADDR` the fenced member server (`table_engines_require_grant` from `scripts/ci/clickhouse-member-access-control.xml`, `si_member`, `si_owner_0`), which reaches the owner as `CH_OWNER_ADDR_FROM_MEMBER=si-owner:9000` on the script's docker network. Every test drops `hg_replica`, `hg_rstage`, `si_member` and `si_owner_0` on the member server and `si_reader` on the owner first, so each starts with a fresh member; passwords come from `crypto/rand` and no statement that carries one is printed (`mustExecMember` names what failed, never the SQL).
- **`si_reader` needs `SHOW COLUMNS ON system.parts` (Appendix B; reported to Plans S3-B and S3-C3).** Measured while drafting on `clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3` (26.3.51.7): with the three grants of Plan S3-B contract §11, the owner pull's resolve `SELECT name, rows FROM remote(si_owner_0, database = 'system', table = 'parts') WHERE …` is refused on the owner with 497 `it's necessary to have the grant SHOW COLUMNS ON system.parts`, while the data pull `… FROM remote(si_owner_0, database = '<db>', table = '<t>') WHERE _part = …` passes; with the fourth grant both pass. `siReaderGrants` therefore adds it; devnet2's `si_reader` needs it too before any member pulls (Plan S3-C3 Task 37).
- **Named collections by SQL.** `CLICKHOUSE_DEFAULT_ACCESS_MANAGEMENT=1` gives the image's `default` user access management but not named-collection control (measured: `CREATE NAMED COLLECTION` is refused with 497 `CREATE NAMED COLLECTION ON si_owner_0`), so the script copies a users file giving `default` `named_collection_control` into the member container before it starts, beside the access-control file; nothing is bind-mounted, and no other user gets the right.
- **What the four tests rely on from Tasks 29–34.** A member refuses a watermark manifest without `track_frontiers` (K37) and the genesis manifest has none, so every test publishes one statement before the member starts and can require `FeedRefused == 0`. The copy is compared with the latest published manifest by part row hash (a multiset, through `chexec.ScanParts` on the copy) and with the owner's `hg_safe` rows; part names differ by design (the copy's parts are its own). The kill test requires at least one active part of the copy that the journal does not list after the hook fired, then a converged copy after the restart; it accepts either outcome of K36 (adopted, or Diverged and repaired) and requires only that nothing is diverged or foreign at the end. A real installer that journals before calling `AfterAttach`, or ignores its error, fails that test (checked while drafting with a simulation stub: "every attached part … is journaled"); a copy that took a Rejected statement's rows fails the fraud test ("the copy holds the Rejected statement's row 901").
- **Polling.** Waits read the leader's own FSM in process (`TrackStateView`, `TableRegistryView`, `StatementStatusView`), which appends nothing to the Raft log; the few barriered reads that are polled (`waitConsensusGenesis`) poll every 100 ms (`pollBarriered`). A first draft polled `GetTrackState` every 10 ms and slowed the soak to about 16 s per block.
- **The soak (K38, D38).** One statement per block (`sealMaxStatements: 1`, checked on every block), spread over ten partitions, at most four blocks written ahead of the last published one (`memberSoakWindow`), then the wait for the shadow cursor and the copy. The soak line is printed before the final checks, so a failing run still shows its counts. Missed scans (a candidate already cleaned from the owner's `hg_unsafe`) and unverdicted blocks are reported, never failed (contract §24.9). The script's test timeout is `1800 + 15 × <soak blocks>` seconds (2550 s for 50, 9300 s for 500), inside the CI job's 60 minutes and the workflow's 180.
- **Log noise that is not a failure.** On a loaded runner the harness logs bursts of `byte-side scan failed; refusing to attest … not found (or empty) in hg_unsafe_<suffix>.db__t`: the orchestrator redelivers a scan request every `RetryInterval/2` to a verifier whose attestation landed after the quorum latched, and the candidate part is already cleaned (`orchestrator/dispatch.go`, stage-2 behaviour, not this task's); and `the arbiter accepted an owed cleanup acknowledgement`, the SNode's 10 s re-send of an acknowledgement that timed out. Neither fails a test.
- **Why the full soak runs after the merge (D38, contract §20.4).** GitHub dispatches only a workflow that exists on the default branch, so `member-soak.yml` can run only after the merge; its run must have `headSha` equal to the merge commit, which is then `ARBITER_PIN_P2`. A failing or cancelled full soak records nothing: stop and ask; a fix lands through a new PR, and `ARBITER_PIN_P2` is the merge commit on which the full soak passed.

```go
package fsm

import (
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"slices"
	"testing"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// wireIncarnationStatus, wireIncarnationOrigin and wireRetireReason map the
// FSM's spellings to arbiter-core's, one entry per FSM constant, as the
// TableRegistry read API serves them (server/table_registry.go).
var (
	wireIncarnationStatus = map[TableIncarnationStatus]wire.TableIncarnationStatus{
		TableStatusLegacy: wire.TableStatusLegacy, TableStatusPending: wire.TableStatusPending,
		TableStatusRefused: wire.TableStatusRefused, TableStatusActive: wire.TableStatusActive,
		TableStatusRetiring: wire.TableStatusRetiring, TableStatusPurging: wire.TableStatusPurging,
		TableStatusPurged: wire.TableStatusPurged,
	}
	wireIncarnationOrigin = map[TableOrigin]wire.TableOrigin{
		TableOriginGenesis: wire.TableOriginGenesis, TableOriginLegacy: wire.TableOriginLegacy, TableOriginChain: wire.TableOriginChain,
	}
	wireRetireReason = map[RetireReason]wire.TableRetireReason{
		"": wire.TableRetireReasonUnspecified, RetireReasonTableDeleted: wire.TableRetireReasonTableDeleted,
		RetireReasonDatabaseDeleted: wire.TableRetireReasonDatabaseDeleted,
	}
)

// wireRegistrySnapshot maps the FSM's detached registry view to
// arbiter-core's wire.TableRegistrySnapshot field by field: what a member's
// registry follower holds after the TableRegistry read API served v.
func wireRegistrySnapshot(t *testing.T, v TableRegistryView) wire.TableRegistrySnapshot {
	t.Helper()
	out := wire.TableRegistrySnapshot{Params: v.Params, Version: v.Version, Seeded: v.Seeded,
		Cursor: wire.TableRegistryCursor{BlockNumber: v.Cursor.BlockNumber, BlockHash: v.Cursor.BlockHash,
			LogIndex: v.Cursor.LogIndex, BlockComplete: v.Cursor.BlockComplete},
		ClientLanes: v.ClientLanes, SIIndexers: v.SIIndexers, SeededIndexers: v.SeededIndexers,
		QuarantinedIndexers: v.QuarantinedIndexers}
	for _, inc := range v.Incarnations {
		status, okStatus := wireIncarnationStatus[inc.Status]
		origin, okOrigin := wireIncarnationOrigin[inc.Origin]
		reason, okReason := wireRetireReason[inc.RetireReason]
		if !okStatus || !okOrigin || !okReason {
			t.Fatalf("incarnation %d of %s: status %q, origin %q or retire reason %q has no wire spelling", inc.Seq, inc.Key(), inc.Status, inc.Origin, inc.RetireReason)
		}
		out.Incarnations = append(out.Incarnations, wire.TableIncarnation{
			Seq: inc.Seq, DatabaseID: inc.DatabaseID, TableID: inc.TableID, Origin: origin, Status: status,
			Created: inc.Created, SchemaRef: inc.SchemaRef, SchemaVersion: inc.SchemaVersion,
			SchemaHash: inc.SchemaHash, SchemaJSON: inc.SchemaJSON, RefusedReason: inc.RefusedReason,
			RefusedCode: string(inc.RefusedCode), Deleted: inc.Deleted, RetireReason: reason,
			AddBlockSeq: inc.AddBlockSeq, RetireBlockSeq: inc.RetireBlockSeq, PurgedBy: inc.PurgedBy,
			OwnerIndexerID: inc.OwnerIndexerID,
		})
	}
	return out
}

// requireManifestOwnersAgree compares f.manifestTableOwnerLocked with
// ManifestOwner over the wire form of f's registry view for every key of the
// registry and for an unknown one; it returns how many keys an incarnation
// attributes, so a case can require that it exercised both answers.
func requireManifestOwnersAgree(t *testing.T, f *FSM) (attributed, unattributed int) {
	t.Helper()
	view, ok := f.TableRegistryView()
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("the table registry is not enabled")
	}
	snap := wireRegistrySnapshot(t, view)
	keys := []string{"db.never-declared"}
	for _, inc := range view.Incarnations {
		if !slices.Contains(keys, inc.Key()) {
			keys = append(keys, inc.Key())
		}
	}
	f.mu.RLock()
	defer f.mu.RUnlock()
	for _, key := range keys {
		wantOwner, wantOK := f.manifestTableOwnerLocked(key)
		gotOwner, gotOK := snap.ManifestOwner(key)
		if gotOwner != wantOwner || gotOK != wantOK {
			t.Errorf("%s: wire ManifestOwner = %d %v, fsm manifestTableOwnerLocked = %d %v", key, gotOwner, gotOK, wantOwner, wantOK)
		}
		if wantOK {
			attributed++
		} else {
			unattributed++
		}
	}
	return attributed, unattributed
}

// TestManifestTableOwnerMatchesWireManifestOwner (plan S3-C2 contract §24.8):
// arbiter-core's wire.TableRegistrySnapshot.ManifestOwner, by which a
// stage-3 member attributes the tables of a manifest it installs, names the
// owner the FSM's manifestTableOwnerLocked names, on every key of registries
// holding genesis-origin incarnations, chain incarnations recorded before and
// after the signed-claims activation (owner absent and present), a Pending
// incarnation never added, Refused re-creations, Retiring and Purged
// incarnations and a re-creation after a purge, built by hand and through
// Apply. The wire form is the registry view mapped field by field.
func TestManifestTableOwnerMatchesWireManifestOwner(t *testing.T) {
	if n := reflect.TypeOf(TableIncarnation{}).NumField(); n != 18 {
		t.Fatalf("fsm.TableIncarnation has %d fields, the mapping covers 18: map the new field in wireRegistrySnapshot", n)
	}
	if n := reflect.TypeOf(wire.TableIncarnation{}).NumField(); n != 18 {
		t.Fatalf("wire.TableIncarnation has %d fields, the mapping covers 18: map the new field in wireRegistrySnapshot", n)
	}
	owner := func(id uint64) *uint64 { return &id }
	event := func(block uint64) *arbiter.L2EventRef {
		return &arbiter.L2EventRef{BlockNumber: block, BlockHash: fmt.Sprintf("0x%x", block), TxHash: "0xtx"}
	}
	chain := func(db, table string, status TableIncarnationStatus, added uint64, ownerID *uint64) *TableIncarnation {
		return &TableIncarnation{DatabaseID: db, TableID: table, Origin: TableOriginChain, Status: status,
			Created: event(150), SchemaRef: event(151), SchemaVersion: 1, SchemaHash: "0xschema", SchemaJSON: `{"table_id":"` + db + "." + table + `"}`,
			AddBlockSeq: added, OwnerIndexerID: ownerID}
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name         string
		founding     uint64
		incarnations []*TableIncarnation
	}{
		{
			name: "before the signed-claims activation", founding: 0,
			incarnations: []*TableIncarnation{
				{DatabaseID: "db", TableID: "t", Origin: TableOriginGenesis, Status: TableStatusActive},
				{DatabaseID: "db", TableID: "old", Origin: TableOriginLegacy, Status: TableStatusLegacy},
				chain("dbc", "added", TableStatusActive, 3, nil),
				chain("dbc", "pending", TableStatusPending, 0, nil),
				func() *TableIncarnation {
					inc := chain("db", "t", TableStatusRefused, 0, nil)
					inc.RefusedCode, inc.RefusedReason = "duplicate_table", "db.t is already live"
					return inc
				}(),
			},
		},
		{
			name: "after the signed-claims activation", founding: 1,
			incarnations: []*TableIncarnation{
				{DatabaseID: "db", TableID: "t", Origin: TableOriginGenesis, Status: TableStatusActive},
				chain("dba", "pre", TableStatusActive, 2, nil),
				chain("dbb", "post", TableStatusActive, 5, owner(2)),
				chain("dbb", "never", TableStatusPending, 0, owner(2)),
				func() *TableIncarnation {
					inc := chain("dbb", "post", TableStatusRefused, 0, owner(2))
					inc.RefusedCode, inc.RefusedReason = "duplicate_table", "dbb.post is already live"
					return inc
				}(),
				func() *TableIncarnation {
					inc := chain("dbz", "zero", TableStatusActive, 6, owner(0))
					return inc
				}(),
			},
		},
		{
			name: "retirement, purge and re-creation", founding: 1,
			incarnations: []*TableIncarnation{
				func() *TableIncarnation {
					inc := chain("dbr", "gone", TableStatusPurged, 4, owner(2))
					inc.Deleted, inc.RetireReason, inc.RetireBlockSeq, inc.PurgedBy = event(160), RetireReasonTableDeleted, 7, []string{"snode-2", "verifier-1"}
					return inc
				}(),
				func() *TableIncarnation {
					inc := chain("dbr", "retiring", TableStatusRetiring, 5, owner(3))
					inc.Deleted, inc.RetireReason, inc.RetireBlockSeq = event(161), RetireReasonDatabaseDeleted, 8
					return inc
				}(),
				func() *TableIncarnation {
					inc := chain("dbr", "purging", TableStatusPurging, 5, owner(2))
					inc.Deleted, inc.RetireReason, inc.RetireBlockSeq, inc.PurgedBy = event(162), RetireReasonTableDeleted, 8, []string{"snode-2"}
					return inc
				}(),
				chain("dbr", "gone", TableStatusPending, 0, owner(3)),
				func() *TableIncarnation {
					inc := chain("dbr", "gone", TableStatusRefused, 0, owner(3))
					inc.RefusedCode, inc.RefusedReason = "duplicate_table", "dbr.gone is already live"
					return inc
				}(),
				func() *TableIncarnation {
					inc := chain("dbr", "refused-only", TableStatusRefused, 0, owner(2))
					inc.RefusedCode, inc.RefusedReason = "unsupported_type", "column type not admitted"
					return inc
				}(),
				func() *TableIncarnation {
					inc := chain("dbr", "again", TableStatusPurged, 4, owner(2))
					inc.Deleted, inc.RetireReason, inc.RetireBlockSeq, inc.PurgedBy = event(163), RetireReasonTableDeleted, 7, []string{"snode-2"}
					return inc
				}(),
				// The re-creation after the purge entered a table set too: the
				// newest one names the owner.
				chain("dbr", "again", TableStatusActive, 9, owner(3)),
			},
		},
		{
			// Not reachable through Apply (a Refused declaration never
			// enters a table set); it pins the order of the checks: Refused
			// is skipped before origin and add block are looked at.
			name: "a Refused incarnation carrying an add block", founding: 1,
			incarnations: []*TableIncarnation{
				{DatabaseID: "db", TableID: "t", Origin: TableOriginGenesis, Status: TableStatusActive},
				chain("dbq", "q", TableStatusActive, 3, owner(2)),
				func() *TableIncarnation {
					inc := chain("dbq", "q", TableStatusRefused, 9, owner(3))
					inc.RefusedCode, inc.RefusedReason = "duplicate_table", "dbq.q is already live"
					return inc
				}(),
				{DatabaseID: "dbq", TableID: "g", Origin: TableOriginGenesis, Status: TableStatusRefused, OwnerIndexerID: owner(3)},
			},
		},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newTestFSM(t)
			for i, inc := range tc.incarnations {
				inc.Seq = uint64(i) + 1
			}
			params := testRegistryParams()
			params.SIIndexerID = tc.founding
			f.st.Params.TableRegistry = params
			f.st.TableRegistry = &TableRegistryState{Version: uint64(len(tc.incarnations)), Seeded: true, Incarnations: tc.incarnations}
			if attributed, unattributed := requireManifestOwnersAgree(t, f); attributed == 0 || unattributed == 0 {
				t.Fatalf("the case attributes %d keys and leaves %d unattributed; it must exercise both answers", attributed, unattributed)
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("built through Apply", func(t *testing.T) {
		x := newTrackManifestFixture(t)
		mustApply(t, x.f, ownedAddCmd(t, x.f, "db", "t", ev(160, "0x160", 0), ev(161, "0x161", 0), 1))
		x.addTable("db2", "p", 2, 170)
		if attributed, unattributed := requireManifestOwnersAgree(t, x.f); attributed == 0 || unattributed == 0 {
			t.Fatalf("the Apply-built registry attributes %d keys and leaves %d unattributed; it must exercise both answers", attributed, unattributed)
		}
	})
}
```

```go
// signing SNode are sealed one per block on track 0, promoted and

// track_frontiers entry and matches system.parts (plan S3-C2 Task 36; the
// base the member tests stand on).
func TestPipeline_TracksActivationOnTheHarnessSNode(t *testing.T) {
	conn := requireCH(t)
	h := startTracksHarness(t, conn)
	var last ownerWrite
	for i, w := range []struct {
		partition string
		value     uint64
	}{{"p0", 1}, {"p1", 2}} {
		last = h.writeOwnerStatement(t, uint64(i+1), w.partition, w.value)
		h.requireOwnerBlock(t, last.block)
		h.waitTrackPublished(t, last.block, 90*time.Second)
	}
	m := h.latestManifest(t)
	if len(m.TrackFrontiers) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("manifest %s track_frontiers = %+v, want indexer %d's entry alone", m.SnapshotID, m.TrackFrontiers, tracksOwnerIndexerID)
	}
	if entry := ownerEntryOf(t, m); entry.SafeBlockSeq < last.block || entry.AppliedPromotionSeq == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("indexer %d's entry %+v does not cover block %d with a promotion", tracksOwnerIndexerID, entry, last.block)
	}
	h.assertManifestMatchesSystemParts(t, m)
	if got := h.queryValues(t); !slices.Equal(got, []uint64{1, 2}) {
		t.Fatalf("safe values = %v, want [1 2]", got)
	}
	h.waitUnsafePartsGone(t, 30*time.Second)
}
```
