Create `integration/chpipeline/harness_tracks_test.go`:

```go
package chpipeline

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	"github.com/hashicorp/raft"
	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/metadata"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/emptypb"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/server"
)

// The stage-2 activation sequence on the harness's one SNode (plan S3-C2
// contract §24.9, clarification K37). The harness starts pre-registry and
// pre-tracks; a stage-3 member has no pre-tracks mode, so before a member
// starts enableTracks runs, in this order: the table registry founded by
// indexer 0 at block 100 and its (empty) founding seed; the SNode restarted
// with indexer 0's claim signer, so that it registers advertising
// signed_claims_v1; the signed-claims activation, which enrols indexer 0 with
// snode-1 as its SNode and lists verifier-1..3 under their keys; and the
// tracks activation. Afterwards db.t is indexer 0's genesis table, every
// statement is sealed on track 0, and every manifest published from then on
// carries track_frontiers [{0, ...}]. The integration harness of
// integration/tracks_harness_test.go runs the same sequence against fake
// data-plane nodes; here the SNode and the verifiers are the real roles.
const (
	tracksRegistryChainID                  = 7892301
	tracksRegistryDatabasesContract        = "0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000d1"
	tracksRegistryActivationBlock   uint64 = 100
	// tracksOwnerIndexerID is the harness's one SI indexer, which founds the
	// registry and owns db.t; tracksOwnerSNodeID is its SNode.
	tracksOwnerIndexerID uint64 = 0
	tracksOwnerSNodeID          = "snode-1"
)

// ownerWrite is one statement written through the owner's SNode and the
// block it was sealed in.
type ownerWrite struct {
	env   arbiter.StatementEnvelope
	block uint64
}

// startTracksHarness starts the harness with its own authority key,
// consensus updates enabled and one statement per block, and runs
// enableTracks on it.
func startTracksHarness(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn) *harness {
	t.Helper()
	authorityKey, _ := rotationAuthority(t)
	h := startHarnessWithOptions(t, conn, harnessOptions{sealMaxStatements: 1, authorityKeyHex: authorityKey, consensusUpdatesEnabled: true})
	enableTracks(t, h)
	return h
}

// enableTracks runs the stage-2 activation sequence on h (see above). h must
// have been started with harnessOptions.authorityKeyHex and
// consensusUpdatesEnabled, and must not have written anything yet: the
// tracks activation requires every sealed block to be safe and published.
func enableTracks(t *testing.T, h *harness) {
	t.Helper()
	if h.authorityKeyHex == "" {
		t.Fatal("enableTracks needs a harness started with harnessOptions.authorityKeyHex and consensusUpdatesEnabled")
	}
	genesisID := h.waitConsensusGenesis(t)
	if genesisID != h.genesisID {
		t.Fatalf("the arbiter's genesis snapshot id is %s, the harness configured %s", genesisID, h.genesisID)
	}

	// The table registry, founded by indexer 0, and its founding seed at
	// block 99: besides the genesis table db.t, which the registry holds
	// already, the chain has no Legacy table, so the seed is empty. The
	// harness runs no L2 watcher; the seed goes straight to the leader.
	h.consensusUpdate(t, "enable the table registry", func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) {
		u.TableRegistry = &arbiter.TableRegistryParams{ChainID: tracksRegistryChainID, DatabasesContract: tracksRegistryDatabasesContract,
			SIIndexerID: tracksOwnerIndexerID, ActivationBlock: tracksRegistryActivationBlock, Confirmation: arbiter.TableRegistryConfirmationSafe}
	})
	h.proposeRegistry(t, wire.Command{SeedLegacyTables: &wire.SeedLegacyTables{AtBlock: tracksL2Block(tracksRegistryActivationBlock - 1)}})

	// Indexer 0's on-chain signer key. The SNode restarts on its durable
	// state with it as claim signer and registers advertising
	// signed_claims_v1, which the activation gate requires of every
	// registered SNode it does not evict (server/signed_claims_gate.go).
	_, signer := rotationAuthority(t)
	h.claimSigner = signer
	h.restartSNode(t)

	// The signed-claims activation: indexer 0 restated with snode-1 (the
	// founding entry restates the registry's activation block), and the
	// three verifiers listed under the keys they registered with.
	enrolment := h.ownerEnrolment(t, genesisID)
	h.gatedConsensusUpdate(t, "signed-claims activation", func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) {
		u.SIIndexers = []arbiter.SIIndexerEntry{enrolment}
		u.Verifiers = h.verifierEntries()
	})

	// The tracks activation, which names every voter's admin address.
	h.gatedConsensusUpdate(t, "tracks activation", func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) { u.TracksEnabled = true })
	view := h.trackState(t)
	if !view.GetTracksEnabled() || len(view.GetIndexers()) != 1 || view.GetIndexers()[0].GetIndexerId() != tracksOwnerIndexerID || view.GetIndexers()[0].GetQuarantined() {
		t.Fatalf("track state after the activation = %v, want one unquarantined track of indexer %d", view, tracksOwnerIndexerID)
	}
	snap := h.registrySnapshot(t)
	if !snap.SignedClaimsActive() {
		t.Fatalf("the registry view after the activation carries no si_indexers: %+v", snap)
	}
	if owner, ok := snap.ManifestOwner(testTableID); !ok || owner != tracksOwnerIndexerID {
		t.Fatalf("ManifestOwner(%s) = %d %v, want indexer %d", testTableID, owner, ok, tracksOwnerIndexerID)
	}
}

func tracksL2Block(block uint64) arbiter.L2BlockRef {
	return arbiter.L2BlockRef{Number: block, Hash: fmt.Sprintf("0x%064x", block)}
}

// waitConsensusGenesis waits until the leader reports the genesis snapshot
// id every signed message binds, and returns it.
func (h *harness) waitConsensusGenesis(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	var id string
	pollBarriered(t, "the arbiter's genesis snapshot id", 30*time.Second, func() bool {
		h.failOnBackground(t)
		state, err := h.leaderConsensusParams()
		if err != nil {
			return false
		}
		id = state.GetGenesisSnapshotId()
		return id != ""
	})
	return id
}

// leaderConsensusParams is the leader's barriered ConsensusAdmin view.
func (h *harness) leaderConsensusParams() (*pb.ConsensusParamsState, error) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(h.ctx, 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	var state *pb.ConsensusParamsState
	err := h.cluster.withLeaderRetry(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, conn *grpc.ClientConn) error {
		var err error
		state, err = pb.NewConsensusAdminClient(conn).GetConsensusParams(ctx, &emptypb.Empty{})
		return err
	})
	return state, err
}

// pollBarriered is waitFor for a condition whose evaluation crosses the
// leader's read barrier, which appends a Raft log entry: it polls every 100
// ms instead of every 10 ms, so that a long wait does not flood the log.
func pollBarriered(t *testing.T, what string, timeout time.Duration, cond func() bool) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
	for {
		if cond() {
			return
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatalf("timeout waiting for %s", what)
		}
		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// isNotLeader reports whether err is a follower's NotLeader refusal, which
// carries a pb.NotLeader detail; a gate refusal is a FailedPrecondition too,
// but without one.
func isNotLeader(err error) bool {
	st, ok := status.FromError(err)
	if !ok || st.Code() != codes.FailedPrecondition {
		return false
	}
	for _, d := range st.Details() {
		if _, ok := d.(*pb.NotLeader); ok {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// leaderAdmin is the ConsensusAdmin client of the node that answers as
// leader now.
func (h *harness) leaderAdmin(ctx context.Context) (pb.ConsensusAdminClient, error) {
	id, err := h.cluster.leaderID(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return pb.NewConsensusAdminClient(h.cluster.conn(id)), nil
}

// tryConsensusUpdate signs and submits one consensus update built from the
// leader's view, so that every committed parameter is carried as
// arbiter-admin carries them, with mutate applied. The update that first
// sets tracks_enabled names every voter's admin address, as arbiter-admin
// consensus update --tracks-enabled does. A NotLeader refusal is retried on
// the next leader; every other refusal is returned.
func (h *harness) tryConsensusUpdate(t *testing.T, mutate func(*arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate)) error {
	t.Helper()
	signer, err := authority.NewSignerFromHex(h.authorityKeyHex)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("authority signer: %v", err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(h.ctx, 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	for {
		admin, err := h.leaderAdmin(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		state, err := admin.GetConsensusParams(ctx, &emptypb.Empty{})
		if isNotLeader(err) {
			if err := waitTick(ctx, 50*time.Millisecond); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		current := state.GetCurrent()
		u := arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate{
			NetworkID: state.GetNetworkId(), GenesisSnapshotID: state.GetGenesisSnapshotId(),
			ExpectedEpoch: state.GetEpoch(), PreviousParamsDigest: state.GetParamsDigest(), ExpectedPromotionSeq: state.GetPromotionSeq(),
			AuthorityAddresses: current.GetAuthorityAddresses(), MaxWriters: current.GetMaxWriters(),
			ArtifactDispositionCapability: current.GetArtifactDispositionCapability(),
			TableRegistry:                 wire.TableRegistryParamsFromPB(current.GetTableRegistry()),
			ClientLanes:                   wire.ClientLaneParamsFromPB(current.GetClientLanes()),
			SIIndexers:                    wire.SIIndexerEntriesFromPB(current.GetSiIndexers()),
			Verifiers:                     wire.VerifierEntriesFromPB(current.GetVerifiers()),
			TracksEnabled:                 current.GetTracksEnabled(),
		}
		mutate(&u)
		if u, err = authority.NormalizeConsensusParamsUpdate(u); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		token, err := signer.SignConsensusParamsUpdate(u)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		callCtx := ctx
		if u.TracksEnabled && !current.GetTracksEnabled() {
			callCtx = metadata.AppendToOutgoingContext(ctx, server.TracksVotersMetadataKey, h.voterAdminAddresses())
		}
		_, err = admin.UpdateConsensusParams(callCtx, &pb.UpdateConsensusParamsCmd{Update: wire.ConsensusParamsUpdateToPB(u), AuthorityJws: token})
		if isNotLeader(err) {
			if err := waitTick(ctx, 50*time.Millisecond); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			continue
		}
		return err
	}
}

// consensusUpdate is tryConsensusUpdate that fails the test on a refusal.
func (h *harness) consensusUpdate(t *testing.T, what string, mutate func(*arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate)) {
	t.Helper()
	if err := h.tryConsensusUpdate(t, mutate); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s: %v", what, err)
	}
}

// gatedConsensusUpdate submits an activation behind a leader-local feature
// gate (signed claims, tracks). The gate reads the features registered with
// this leader in its current term, which a leader change empties; on a gate
// refusal every data-plane node registers again with the current leader, as
// the README's activation order asks, and the update is retried.
func (h *harness) gatedConsensusUpdate(t *testing.T, what string, mutate func(*arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate)) {
	t.Helper()
	for attempt := 1; ; attempt++ {
		err := h.tryConsensusUpdate(t, mutate)
		if err == nil {
			return
		}
		if attempt == 3 || status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "gate refused") {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", what, err)
		}
		t.Logf("%s: %v; every data-plane node registers again with the current leader", what, err)
		h.reregisterDataPlane(t)
	}
}

// reregisterDataPlane registers the three verifiers and the SNode again.
func (h *harness) reregisterDataPlane(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	for i, v := range h.verifierRoles {
		registerRole(t, h.ctx, fmt.Sprintf("verifier-%d", i+1), v.Register)
	}
	registerRole(t, h.ctx, "snode", h.snode.Register)
}

// voterAdminAddresses is the arbiter-tracks-voters value: every voter's
// admin address (the harness serves ConsensusAdmin on each node's gRPC
// listener), sorted, comma-separated.
func (h *harness) voterAdminAddresses() string {
	h.cluster.mu.RLock()
	defer h.cluster.mu.RUnlock()
	addresses := make([]string, 0, len(h.cluster.nodes))
	for _, app := range h.cluster.nodes {
		addresses = append(addresses, app.grpcAddr)
	}
	slices.Sort(addresses)
	return strings.Join(addresses, ",")
}

// proposeRegistry proposes one registry command on the leader exactly as the
// L2 watcher does through the orchestrator: VerifyLeader, then Apply of the
// encoded command; a domain refusal comes back as fsm.Rejected. A proposal
// the node refuses as not leader never entered the log and is retried on
// the next leader.
func (h *harness) proposeRegistry(t *testing.T, cmd wire.Command) {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := wire.Encode(cmd)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("encode registry command: %v", err)
	}
	for attempt := 1; ; attempt++ {
		app := h.leaderApp(t)
		if err := app.node.VerifyLeader(); err == nil {
			fut := app.node.Apply(data, 2*time.Second)
			if err := applyWithin(fut, 10*time.Second); err == nil {
				if rejected, ok := fut.Response().(fsm.Rejected); ok {
					t.Fatalf("registry command rejected: %s", rejected.Reason)
				}
				return
			} else if !errors.Is(err, raft.ErrNotLeader) {
				t.Fatalf("propose registry command: %v", err)
			}
		}
		if attempt == 50 {
			t.Fatal("no leader accepted the registry command")
		}
		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// applyWithin waits at most d for fut; with BatchApplyCh the timeout given to
// Apply bounds only the enqueue.
func applyWithin(fut raft.ApplyFuture, d time.Duration) error {
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- fut.Error() }()
	timer := time.NewTimer(d)
	defer timer.Stop()
	select {
	case err := <-done:
		return err
	case <-timer.C:
		return fmt.Errorf("no answer within %s; the command's outcome is unknown", d)
	}
}

// leaderApp is the live node that answers as leader now.
func (h *harness) leaderApp(t *testing.T) *testApp {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(h.ctx, 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	id, err := h.cluster.leaderID(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("leader: %v", err)
	}
	h.cluster.mu.RLock()
	defer h.cluster.mu.RUnlock()
	return h.cluster.nodes[id]
}

// restartSNode stops the SNode and starts it again on its durable state,
// with h.claimSigner as its claim signer when set.
func (h *harness) restartSNode(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	h.snodeStop()
	select {
	case <-h.snodeDone:
	case <-time.After(30 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("the SNode did not stop")
	}
	h.snode = startSNode(t, h, newDataPlaneClient(t, h.cluster), h.cluster.authorityAddr)
}

// ownerEnrolment is indexer 0's si_indexers entry: snode-1 as its SNode,
// enrolled by its claim signer on this network and genesis.
func (h *harness) ownerEnrolment(t *testing.T, genesisID string) arbiter.SIIndexerEntry {
	t.Helper()
	jws, err := h.claimSigner.SignSNodeEnrollment(authority.SNodeEnrollmentStatement{NetworkID: testNetworkID, GenesisSnapshotID: genesisID,
		IndexerID: tracksOwnerIndexerID, SNodeNodeID: tracksOwnerSNodeID})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("sign the enrolment: %v", err)
	}
	return arbiter.SIIndexerEntry{IndexerID: tracksOwnerIndexerID, ActivationBlock: tracksRegistryActivationBlock,
		Signer: h.claimSigner.Address(), SNodeNodeID: tracksOwnerSNodeID, EnrollmentJWS: jws}
}

// verifierEntries lists verifier-1..3 under the ed25519 keys startVerifiers
// gives them.
func (h *harness) verifierEntries() []arbiter.VerifierEntry {
	out := make([]arbiter.VerifierEntry, 0, 3)
	for i := 1; i <= 3; i++ {
		key := ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(verifierSeed(byte(i)))
		out = append(out, arbiter.VerifierEntry{NodeID: fmt.Sprintf("verifier-%d", i), Ed25519Pubkey: []byte(key.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey))})
	}
	return out
}

// authorityContext is the {network, genesis, epoch} an authority token signed
// now must carry.
func (h *harness) authorityContext(t *testing.T) authority.ConsensusContext {
	t.Helper()
	state, err := h.leaderConsensusParams()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read consensus parameters: %v", err)
	}
	return authority.ConsensusContext{NetworkID: state.GetNetworkId(), GenesisSnapshotID: state.GetGenesisSnapshotId(), AuthorityEpoch: state.GetEpoch()}
}

// trackState is the leader's barriered GetTrackState answer.
func (h *harness) trackState(t *testing.T) *pb.TrackStateView {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(h.ctx, 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	var view *pb.TrackStateView
	if err := h.cluster.withLeaderRetry(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, conn *grpc.ClientConn) error {
		var err error
		view, err = pb.NewConsensusAdminClient(conn).GetTrackState(ctx, &emptypb.Empty{})
		return err
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("GetTrackState: %v", err)
	}
	return view
}

// ownerTrack is indexer 0's track in the leader's own FSM: an in-process
// read, so that waiting on it appends nothing to the Raft log.
func (h *harness) ownerTrack(t *testing.T) fsm.IndexerTrackView {
	t.Helper()
	for _, tr := range h.leaderFSM(t).TrackStateView().Indexers {
		if tr.IndexerID == tracksOwnerIndexerID {
			return tr
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("the leader has no track of indexer %d", tracksOwnerIndexerID)
	return fsm.IndexerTrackView{}
}

// waitOwnerTrack waits until cond holds for indexer 0's track and returns
// that track.
func (h *harness) waitOwnerTrack(t *testing.T, what string, timeout time.Duration, cond func(fsm.IndexerTrackView) bool) fsm.IndexerTrackView {
	t.Helper()
	var last fsm.IndexerTrackView
	waitFor(t, what, timeout, func() bool {
		h.failOnBackground(t)
		last = h.ownerTrack(t)
		return cond(last)
	})
	return last
}

// waitTrackPublished waits until the latest published manifest's entry of
// indexer 0 covers block.
func (h *harness) waitTrackPublished(t *testing.T, block uint64, timeout time.Duration) {
	t.Helper()
	h.waitOwnerTrack(t, fmt.Sprintf("track %d published through block %d", tracksOwnerIndexerID, block), timeout, func(tr fsm.IndexerTrackView) bool {
		return tr.Published.SafeBlockSeq >= block
	})
}

// registrySnapshot is the leader's barriered GetTableRegistry answer in
// arbiter-core's wire form, the view a member's registry follower holds.
func (h *harness) registrySnapshot(t *testing.T) wire.TableRegistrySnapshot {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(h.ctx, 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	var m *pb.TableRegistrySnapshot
	if err := h.cluster.withLeaderRetry(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, conn *grpc.ClientConn) error {
		var err error
		m, err = pb.NewTableRegistryClient(conn).GetTableRegistry(ctx, &emptypb.Empty{})
		return err
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("GetTableRegistry: %v", err)
	}
	snap, err := wire.TableRegistrySnapshotFromPB(m)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode the registry: %v", err)
	}
	return snap
}

// leaderFSM is the leader's own replicated FSM.
func (h *harness) leaderFSM(t *testing.T) *fsm.FSM {
	t.Helper()
	return h.leaderApp(t).state
}

// writeOwnerStatement writes one statement (partition, value) through the
// owner's signing SNode and returns it with the block it was sealed in.
func (h *harness) writeOwnerStatement(t *testing.T, seq uint64, partition string, value uint64) ownerWrite {
	t.Helper()
	env, payload := h.statement(t, seq, partition, value)
	h.submitToArbiter(t, env)
	if err := h.snode.SubmitLocalStatement(h.ctx, env, payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("submit local statement %d: %v", seq, err)
	}
	return ownerWrite{env: env, block: h.blockOfStatement(t, env)}
}

// blockOfStatement waits until env is sealed and returns its block.
func (h *harness) blockOfStatement(t *testing.T, env arbiter.StatementEnvelope) uint64 {
	t.Helper()
	flat := env.StatementID.Flat()
	var block uint64
	waitFor(t, "statement "+flat+" sealed", time.Minute, func() bool {
		h.failOnBackground(t)
		state := h.leaderFSM(t)
		info, ok := state.StatementStatusView(flat)
		if !ok {
			return false
		}
		sealed := state.MetricsSnapshot().SealedBlockSeq
		for b := uint64(1); b <= sealed; b++ {
			header, _, _, err := state.L3BlockView(b)
			if err != nil {
				continue
			}
			if header.StatementSeqStart <= info.Seq && info.Seq < header.StatementSeqStart+uint64(header.StatementCount) {
				block = b
				return true
			}
		}
		return false
	})
	return block
}

// requireOwnerBlock requires block to be a track-0 block of one statement.
func (h *harness) requireOwnerBlock(t *testing.T, block uint64) {
	t.Helper()
	header, _, _, err := h.leaderFSM(t).L3BlockView(block)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("block %d: %v", block, err)
	}
	if header.Track == nil || header.Track.IndexerID != tracksOwnerIndexerID || header.StatementCount != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("block %d: track %+v with %d statements, want track %d with one statement", block, header.Track, header.StatementCount, tracksOwnerIndexerID)
	}
}

// latestManifest is the leader's latest published manifest, read by its
// snapshot id as a member reads it (never by block).
func (h *harness) latestManifest(t *testing.T) replay.SafeSnapshotManifest {
	t.Helper()
	wm, err := h.leaderWatermark()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("safe watermark: %v", err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(h.ctx, 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	var m *pb.SafeSnapshotManifest
	if err := h.cluster.withLeaderRetry(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, conn *grpc.ClientConn) error {
		var err error
		m, err = pb.NewSafeStateClient(conn).GetManifest(ctx, &pb.SnapshotRef{SnapshotId: wm.GetSnapshotId()})
		return err
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("manifest %s: %v", wm.GetSnapshotId(), err)
	}
	return wire.ManifestFromPB(m)
}

// ownerEntryOf is indexer 0's entry in m's track_frontiers.
func ownerEntryOf(t *testing.T, m replay.SafeSnapshotManifest) replay.TrackFrontier {
	t.Helper()
	for _, f := range m.TrackFrontiers {
		if f.IndexerID == tracksOwnerIndexerID {
			return f
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("manifest %s carries no track_frontiers entry for indexer %d: %+v", m.SnapshotID, tracksOwnerIndexerID, m.TrackFrontiers)
	return replay.TrackFrontier{}
}

// releaseOwnerTrack waits until indexer 0's track is quarantined with exactly
// block rejected (the automatic quarantine of a Rejected block, spec
// 2026-10-10 §7.5), releases it with an authority-signed ReleaseIndexer that
// acknowledges that block, and waits until the release applied and the
// registry no longer lists indexer 0 as quarantined (its SNode acknowledged
// the cleanup of the block's rejected parts).
func (h *harness) releaseOwnerTrack(t *testing.T, block uint64) {
	t.Helper()
	tr := h.waitOwnerTrack(t, fmt.Sprintf("track %d quarantined with block %d rejected", tracksOwnerIndexerID, block), 60*time.Second,
		func(tr fsm.IndexerTrackView) bool {
			return tr.Quarantined && slices.Equal(tr.RejectedBlocks, []uint64{block})
		})
	signer, err := authority.NewSignerFromHex(h.authorityKeyHex)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("authority signer: %v", err)
	}
	cmd := wire.ReleaseIndexer{IndexerID: tracksOwnerIndexerID, ExpectedGeneration: tr.QuarantineGeneration, AcknowledgedRejectedBlocks: []uint64{block}}.Canonical()
	token, err := signer.SignReleaseIndexerWithContext(cmd, h.authorityContext(t))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("sign the release: %v", err)
	}
	req := &pb.ReleaseIndexerCmd{IndexerId: tracksOwnerIndexerID, ExpectedGeneration: tr.QuarantineGeneration,
		AcknowledgedRejectedBlocks: cmd.AcknowledgedRejectedBlocks, AuthorityJws: token}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(h.ctx, 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	for {
		admin, err := h.leaderAdmin(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("leader: %v", err)
		}
		_, err = admin.ReleaseIndexer(ctx, req)
		if err == nil {
			break
		}
		if !isNotLeader(err) {
			t.Fatalf("release track %d: %v", tracksOwnerIndexerID, err)
		}
		if err := waitTick(ctx, 50*time.Millisecond); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("release track %d: %v", tracksOwnerIndexerID, err)
		}
	}
	h.waitOwnerTrack(t, fmt.Sprintf("track %d released with block %d acknowledged", tracksOwnerIndexerID, block), 60*time.Second,
		func(tr fsm.IndexerTrackView) bool {
			return !tr.Quarantined && len(tr.RejectedBlocks) == 0 && slices.Contains(tr.AcknowledgedRejectedBlocks, block)
		})
	waitFor(t, fmt.Sprintf("indexer %d's rejected parts cleaned", tracksOwnerIndexerID), 60*time.Second, func() bool {
		h.failOnBackground(t)
		view, ok := h.leaderFSM(t).TableRegistryView()
		return ok && len(view.QuarantinedIndexers) == 0
	})
}
```

```go
package chpipeline

import (
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/install"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// The stage-3 P2 member integration (plan S3-C2 contract §24.9; spec §11's
// entry criterion of P3, §16 row P2, §17). Every test starts the tracks
// harness, writes and publishes one statement first (a member refuses a
// watermark manifest without track_frontiers, K37, and the genesis manifest
// has none), then starts the member on the fenced server. Run them with
// scripts/test-clickhouse-member.sh.

const (
	// memberPublishTimeout bounds one statement's way from submission to a
	// published manifest.
	memberPublishTimeout = 3 * time.Minute
	// memberSoakWindow is how many soak blocks may be written ahead of the
	// last published one.
	memberSoakWindow = 4
)

// writeAndPublish writes one statement through the owner's SNode and waits
// until a published manifest covers its block.
func writeAndPublish(t *testing.T, h *harness, seq uint64, partition string, value uint64) ownerWrite {
	t.Helper()
	w := h.writeOwnerStatement(t, seq, partition, value)
	h.requireOwnerBlock(t, w.block)
	h.waitTrackPublished(t, w.block, memberPublishTimeout)
	return w
}

// TestPipeline_MemberCopyFollowsTheOwnerAcrossPromotions: the member
// bootstraps its copy of db.t from the owner's hg_safe and then follows every
// publication, across three partitions, with exactly the parts each manifest
// lists and the owner's rows, installing each through the owner pull.
func TestPipeline_MemberCopyFollowsTheOwnerAcrossPromotions(t *testing.T) {
	requireMemberCH(t)
	h := startTracksHarness(t, requireCH(t))
	writeAndPublish(t, h, 1, "p0", 11)
	m := startMember(t, h, memberOptions{})
	m.waitReady(t)
	m.requireCopyEqualsLatestManifest(t)
	for i, w := range []struct {
		partition string
		value     uint64
	}{{"p0", 12}, {"p1", 21}, {"p0", 13}, {"p2", 31}, {"p1", 22}} {
		writeAndPublish(t, h, uint64(i+2), w.partition, w.value)
		m.requireCopyEqualsLatestManifest(t)
	}
	if got := m.copyValues(t); !slices.Equal(got, []uint64{11, 12, 13, 21, 22, 31}) {
		t.Fatalf("the copy holds %v, want [11 12 13 21 22 31]", got)
	}
	st := m.Stats()
	requireHealthyMember(t, st)
	if kept, pulled := st.InstallOutcomes[install.Outcome("kept")], st.Installs["owner_pull"]; kept < 6 || pulled < 6 {
		t.Fatalf("installs: %d kept, %d through the owner pull; want at least one of each per part (6)", kept, pulled)
	}
	if owner := st.Owners[tracksOwnerIndexerID]; owner.Entry != owner.PublishedEntry || !owner.BehindSince.IsZero() {
		t.Fatalf("owner %d: entry %+v, published %+v, behind since %v; want the copy at the published entry", tracksOwnerIndexerID, owner.Entry, owner.PublishedEntry, owner.BehindSince)
	}
}

// TestPipeline_MemberCopiesNeverHoldRowsOfARejectedStatement is spec §11's
// entry criterion of P3 for the two fraud classes of fraud_test.go (a lying
// candidate part hash, a lying partition sum). Each fraud statement's rows
// reach the owner's hg_unsafe, its signed claim lies, the verifiers reject
// its block and the track is quarantined. The shadow verifier replays and
// scans that block while its candidate parts still exist, with zero
// mismatches (a Rejected block reproduces the honest verifiers' receipts and
// scans, K34); the copy never holds the statement's rows, before the release
// and after the next honest publication alike.
func TestPipeline_MemberCopiesNeverHoldRowsOfARejectedStatement(t *testing.T) {
	requireMemberCH(t)
	h := startTracksHarness(t, requireCH(t))
	writeAndPublish(t, h, 1, "p0", 101)
	m := startMember(t, h, memberOptions{})
	m.waitReady(t)
	m.requireCopyEqualsLatestManifest(t)
	seq := uint64(2)
	for _, fraud := range []struct {
		name   string
		value  uint64
		honest uint64
		tamper rcTamper
	}{
		{"a lying candidate part hash", 901, 102, func(rc *arbiter.RCRecord) { rc.CandidateParts[0].PartRowLtHash = evilLtHashHex("evil-part") }},
		{"a lying partition sum", 902, 103, func(rc *arbiter.RCRecord) {
			rc.PartitionNewPartSums[0].NewPartsLtHashSum = evilLtHashHex("evil-sum")
		}},
	} {
		env, payload := h.statement(t, seq, "p0", fraud.value)
		seq++
		h.submitToArbiter(t, env)
		h.submitManualSource(t, env, payload, fraud.tamper)
		h.waitStatementStatus(t, env, fsm.StatusRejected, memberPublishTimeout)
		block := h.blockOfStatement(t, env)
		h.requireOwnerBlock(t, block)
		m.waitShadowPast(t, block, 3*time.Minute)
		requireNoShadowMismatches(t, m.Stats())
		if got := m.copyValues(t); slices.Contains(got, fraud.value) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: the copy holds the Rejected statement's row %d: %v", fraud.name, fraud.value, got)
		}
		h.releaseOwnerTrack(t, block)
		writeAndPublish(t, h, seq, "p0", fraud.honest)
		seq++
		m.requireCopyEqualsLatestManifest(t)
		if got := m.copyValues(t); slices.Contains(got, fraud.value) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: after the release the copy holds the Rejected statement's row %d: %v", fraud.name, fraud.value, got)
		}
	}
	if got := m.copyValues(t); !slices.Equal(got, []uint64{101, 102, 103}) {
		t.Fatalf("the copy holds %v, want the honest rows [101 102 103]", got)
	}
	st := m.Stats()
	requireHealthyMember(t, st)
	t.Logf("member fraud: owner %d: %d shadow blocks, %d missed scans, %d unverdicted", tracksOwnerIndexerID,
		st.Owners[tracksOwnerIndexerID].ShadowBlocks, st.Owners[tracksOwnerIndexerID].ShadowMissedScans, st.Owners[tracksOwnerIndexerID].ShadowUnverdicted)
}

// TestPipeline_MemberKilledMidStreamResumesFromItsJournal (spec §17, K36):
// the member is stopped between its first ATTACH PARTITION FROM and the
// journal write, so its copy holds a part its journal does not; the owner
// promotes on while it is down; restarted on the same state directory, it
// adopts or repairs that part at its startup audit and converges to the
// latest manifest.
func TestPipeline_MemberKilledMidStreamResumesFromItsJournal(t *testing.T) {
	requireMemberCH(t)
	h := startTracksHarness(t, requireCH(t))
	writeAndPublish(t, h, 1, "p0", 1)
	m := startMember(t, h, memberOptions{killAfterAttach: true})
	m.waitKilled(t)
	copy := m.copyTable(t)
	attached, journaled := m.copyPartNames(t), m.journaledParts(t, copy)
	if len(attached) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("the killed member's copy holds no part: the hook ran before any ATTACH PARTITION FROM")
	}
	if unjournaled := slices.DeleteFunc(slices.Clone(attached), func(p string) bool { return slices.Contains(journaled, p) }); len(unjournaled) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("every attached part %v is journaled (%v): the member was not stopped before the journal write", attached, journaled)
	}
	writeAndPublish(t, h, 2, "p1", 2)
	writeAndPublish(t, h, 3, "p0", 3)
	m.Restart(t)
	m.waitReady(t)
	m.requireCopyEqualsLatestManifest(t)
	if got := m.copyValues(t); !slices.Equal(got, []uint64{1, 2, 3}) {
		t.Fatalf("the restarted member's copy holds %v, want [1 2 3]", got)
	}
	// The unjournaled part was adopted, or its partition repaired as
	// Diverged (K36): either way nothing is diverged or foreign now.
	st := m.Stats()
	owner := st.Owners[tracksOwnerIndexerID]
	if !st.Ready || !st.AuditClean || st.InstallsPaused || st.FeedRefused != 0 || st.AuditRuns["startup"] < 1 {
		t.Fatalf("the restarted member: ready %v, audit clean %v, installs paused %v, feed refused %d, %d startup audits",
			st.Ready, st.AuditClean, st.InstallsPaused, st.FeedRefused, st.AuditRuns["startup"])
	}
	if owner.Copies != 1 || owner.DivergedTables != 0 || owner.ForeignTables != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("owner %d: %d copies, %d diverged tables, %d foreign tables; want one copy and nothing diverged or foreign",
			tracksOwnerIndexerID, owner.Copies, owner.DivergedTables, owner.ForeignTables)
	}
	requireNoShadowMismatches(t, st)
	t.Logf("member restart: %d diverged partitions repaired, %d startup audits", owner.DivergedPartitions, st.AuditRuns["startup"])
}

// TestPipeline_MemberShadowSoak is the integration exit of spec §16 row P2
// (K38): at least ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_SOAK_BLOCKS blocks of owner 0, one
// statement each, shadow-verified with zero mismatches of every kind; missed
// scans (a candidate already cleaned from the owner's hg_unsafe) and
// unverdicted blocks are reported, not failed. ci.yml runs 50 blocks,
// member-soak.yml 500 (decision D38); the soak line below is the run record
// of P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK.
func TestPipeline_MemberShadowSoak(t *testing.T) {
	requireMemberCH(t)
	blocks := memberSoakBlocks(t)
	h := startTracksHarness(t, requireCH(t))
	writeAndPublish(t, h, 1, "p0", 1)
	m := startMember(t, h, memberOptions{soakBlocks: blocks})
	m.waitReady(t)
	start := m.Stats().ShadowNextBlockSeq
	started := time.Now()
	writes := make([]ownerWrite, 0, blocks)
	for i := 1; i <= blocks; i++ {
		// Keep at most memberSoakWindow blocks in flight: the track promotes
		// one block at a time, while the next ones are sealed and verified.
		if i > memberSoakWindow {
			h.waitTrackPublished(t, writes[i-1-memberSoakWindow].block, memberPublishTimeout)
		}
		seq := uint64(i + 1)
		w := h.writeOwnerStatement(t, seq, fmt.Sprintf("p%d", i%10), seq)
		h.requireOwnerBlock(t, w.block)
		writes = append(writes, w)
		if i%50 == 0 {
			st := m.Stats()
			t.Logf("member soak: %d of %d blocks written in %s; shadow cursor %d, owner %d shadow blocks %d", i, blocks,
				time.Since(started).Round(time.Second), st.ShadowNextBlockSeq, tracksOwnerIndexerID, st.Owners[tracksOwnerIndexerID].ShadowBlocks)
		}
	}
	last := writes[len(writes)-1]
	h.waitTrackPublished(t, last.block, memberPublishTimeout)
	if last.block < start+uint64(blocks)-1 {
		t.Fatalf("the soak's last block %d is below its shadow start %d + %d blocks", last.block, start, blocks)
	}
	m.waitShadowPast(t, last.block, m.patience())
	m.requireCopyEqualsLatestManifest(t)
	st := m.Stats()
	owner := st.Owners[tracksOwnerIndexerID]
	var mismatches uint64
	for _, n := range owner.ShadowMismatches {
		mismatches += n
	}
	t.Logf("member soak: owner %d: %d blocks, %d mismatches, %d missed scans, %d unverdicted",
		tracksOwnerIndexerID, owner.ShadowBlocks, mismatches, owner.ShadowMissedScans, owner.ShadowUnverdicted)
	requireHealthyMember(t, st)
	if owner.ShadowBlocks < uint64(blocks) {
		t.Fatalf("owner %d: %d shadow-verified blocks, want at least %d", tracksOwnerIndexerID, owner.ShadowBlocks, blocks)
	}
}
```

```go
package chpipeline

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"net"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/chexec"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/install"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/shadow"
)

// The stage-3 P2 member harness (plan S3-C2 contract §24.9). One
// member.Role, node member-test with host indexer 1 (not enrolled: the
// harness has one owner), copies owner 0, the harness's own SNode. It runs
// against a second ClickHouse, CH_MEMBER_ADDR, started with
// scripts/ci/clickhouse-member-access-control.xml (table_engines_require_grant
// on), where it logs in as si_member with SI_MEMBER_GRANTS and reads the
// owner's hg_safe_<suffix> and hg_unsafe_<suffix> through the NOT
// OVERRIDABLE collection si_owner_0, which logs in on the harness's own
// ClickHouse (CH_ADDR, reached from the member server as
// CH_OWNER_ADDR_FROM_MEMBER) as si_reader. The owner is a second server
// because ClickHouse runs remote() against its own address locally, as the
// calling user. Passwords come from crypto/rand inside the test and are never
// printed. scripts/test-clickhouse-member.sh starts both servers.
const (
	memberIntegrationEnv     = "ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_INTEGRATION"
	memberAddrEnv            = "CH_MEMBER_ADDR"
	memberOwnerFromMemberEnv = "CH_OWNER_ADDR_FROM_MEMBER"
	memberSoakBlocksEnv      = "ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_SOAK_BLOCKS"
	// memberDefaultSoakBlocks is the full soak of spec §16 row P2 (500
	// blocks per owner, K38); ci.yml runs 50 and member-soak.yml 500
	// (decision D38).
	memberDefaultSoakBlocks = 500

	memberNodeID                 = "member-test"
	memberHostIndexerID   uint64 = 1
	memberOwnerCollection        = "si_owner_0"
	memberUser                   = "si_member"
	memberReaderUser             = "si_reader"
	// memberDiskBudgetBytes is far above what the harness writes: no test
	// here exercises the disk budget (Task 32 does).
	memberDiskBudgetBytes uint64 = 8 << 30
)

// errMemberKilled is what the killAfterAttach hook returns to the installer
// after it stopped the role between ATTACH PARTITION FROM and the journal
// write.
var errMemberKilled = errors.New("chpipeline: the member was killed between ATTACH PARTITION FROM and its journal write")

// siMemberGrants is SI_MEMBER_GRANTS (plan S3-C2 contract §23.2, spec §8.2 as
// amended): one GRANT per entry, without TO; startMember adds GRANT NAMED
// COLLECTION ON si_owner_0. Plan S3-C3 renders the same list for devnet2.
var siMemberGrants = []string{
	"GRANT SELECT ON hg_member_unsafe.*",
	"GRANT SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA ON hg_member_unsafe.*",
	"GRANT SELECT, INSERT, ALTER DELETE, CREATE TABLE, DROP TABLE ON hg_replica.*",
	"GRANT SELECT, INSERT, ALTER, CREATE TABLE, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, OPTIMIZE ON hg_rstage.*",
	"GRANT CREATE DATABASE ON hg_replica.*",
	"GRANT CREATE DATABASE ON hg_rstage.*",
	"GRANT READ ON S3",
	"GRANT TABLE ENGINE ON MergeTree",
	"GRANT TABLE ENGINE ON Memory",
	"GRANT SELECT ON system.parts",
	"GRANT SELECT ON system.tables",
	"GRANT SELECT ON system.detached_tables",
	"GRANT SELECT ON system.replicas",
	"GRANT SELECT ON system.zookeeper",
	"GRANT READ ON REMOTE",
	"GRANT CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE ON *.*",
}

// siReaderGrants are si_reader's grants (plan S3-B contract §11) on the
// harness's own databases instead of hg_safe and hg_unsafe, plus SHOW
// COLUMNS ON system.parts, without which ClickHouse 26.3 refuses the owner
// pull's part resolution through remote(<collection>, database = 'system',
// table = 'parts') with 497 (measured on 26.3 while this task was drafted;
// Appendix B).
func siReaderGrants(safeDB, unsafeDB string) []string {
	return []string{
		"GRANT SELECT ON " + safeDB + ".*",
		"GRANT SELECT ON " + unsafeDB + ".*",
		"GRANT SELECT(database, table, name, active, rows, partition_id, hash_of_all_files) ON system.parts",
		"GRANT SHOW COLUMNS ON system.parts",
	}
}

// memberEnv is the member server's address and the owner's address as the
// member server reaches it.
type memberEnv struct {
	memberAddr string
	ownerHost  string
	ownerPort  uint16
}

// requireMemberCH skips unless ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_INTEGRATION=1 and fails when
// that is set without the rest of its environment.
func requireMemberCH(t *testing.T) memberEnv {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv(memberIntegrationEnv) != "1" {
		t.Skipf("set %s=1, ARBITER_CH_INTEGRATION=1, CH_ADDR, %s and %s to run (scripts/test-clickhouse-member.sh)", memberIntegrationEnv, memberAddrEnv, memberOwnerFromMemberEnv)
	}
	if os.Getenv("ARBITER_CH_INTEGRATION") != "1" {
		t.Fatalf("%s=1 needs ARBITER_CH_INTEGRATION=1", memberIntegrationEnv)
	}
	addr, from := os.Getenv(memberAddrEnv), os.Getenv(memberOwnerFromMemberEnv)
	if addr == "" || from == "" {
		t.Fatalf("%s=1 needs %s and %s", memberIntegrationEnv, memberAddrEnv, memberOwnerFromMemberEnv)
	}
	host, portText, err := net.SplitHostPort(from)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s=%q: %v", memberOwnerFromMemberEnv, from, err)
	}
	port, err := strconv.ParseUint(portText, 10, 16)
	if err != nil || host == "" {
		t.Fatalf("%s=%q must be <host>:<port>", memberOwnerFromMemberEnv, from)
	}
	return memberEnv{memberAddr: addr, ownerHost: host, ownerPort: uint16(port)}
}

// memberSoakBlocks is ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_SOAK_BLOCKS, a positive decimal, 500
// when unset.
func memberSoakBlocks(t *testing.T) int {
	t.Helper()
	raw := os.Getenv(memberSoakBlocksEnv)
	if raw == "" {
		return memberDefaultSoakBlocks
	}
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(raw)
	if err != nil || n <= 0 || strconv.Itoa(n) != raw {
		t.Fatalf("%s must be a positive decimal, got %q", memberSoakBlocksEnv, raw)
	}
	return n
}

func memberTestPassword(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	raw := make([]byte, 24)
	if _, err := rand.Read(raw); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("password: %v", err)
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(raw)
}

// mustExecMember runs one statement; a failure names what, never the
// statement, which may carry a password.
func mustExecMember(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, what, query string) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	if err := conn.Exec(ctx, query); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s: %v", what, err)
	}
}

func openMemberCH(t *testing.T, addr, user, password string) clickhouse.Conn {
	t.Helper()
	opts := &clickhouse.Options{Addr: []string{addr}}
	if user != "" {
		opts.Auth = clickhouse.Auth{Username: user, Password: password}
	}
	conn, err := clickhouse.Open(opts)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("clickhouse %s: %v", addr, err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = conn.Close() })
	if err := conn.Ping(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("clickhouse ping %s as %q: %v", addr, user, err)
	}
	return conn
}

// memberLogger writes the member's warnings and errors to stderr, where
// scripts/test-clickhouse-member.sh keeps them with the test output.
func memberLogger() *slog.Logger {
	return slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(os.Stderr, &slog.HandlerOptions{Level: slog.LevelWarn}))
}

type memberOptions struct {
	// soakBlocks sizes the waits for the shadow verifier and the copy to
	// catch up (0 for the short tests).
	soakBlocks int
	// killAfterAttach makes the first ATTACH PARTITION FROM of the first run
	// stop the role before the installer journals it (member.Deps.AfterAttach).
	killAfterAttach bool
}

// memberRun is one member.Role run: one process lifetime.
type memberRun struct {
	role   *member.Role
	cancel context.CancelFunc
	exited chan struct{}
	err    error
}

type memberHandle struct {
	h     *harness
	opts  memberOptions
	cfg   member.Config
	admin clickhouse.Conn // the member server as its admin
	conn  clickhouse.Conn // the member server as si_member

	armed    atomic.Bool
	killed   chan struct{}
	killOnce sync.Once

	mu  sync.Mutex
	run *memberRun
}

// startMember creates si_reader on the harness's ClickHouse, si_member and
// si_owner_0 on the member server (whose hg_replica and hg_rstage it drops
// first, so every test starts with a fresh member), and starts the role.
func startMember(t *testing.T, h *harness, opts memberOptions) *memberHandle {
	t.Helper()
	env := requireMemberCH(t)
	admin := openMemberCH(t, env.memberAddr, "", "")
	readerPassword, memberPassword := memberTestPassword(t), memberTestPassword(t)

	// The owner's source server: si_reader on the harness's databases.
	mustExecMember(t, h.conn, "drop an old "+memberReaderUser, "DROP USER IF EXISTS "+memberReaderUser)
	mustExecMember(t, h.conn, "create "+memberReaderUser, "CREATE USER "+memberReaderUser+" IDENTIFIED WITH sha256_password BY '"+readerPassword+"'")
	for _, grant := range siReaderGrants(h.safeDB, h.unsafeDB) {
		mustExecMember(t, h.conn, grant, grant+" TO "+memberReaderUser)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Minute)
		defer cancel()
		_ = h.conn.Exec(ctx, "DROP USER IF EXISTS "+memberReaderUser)
	})

	// The member server: a fresh member, the collection and si_member.
	for _, stmt := range []string{
		"DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS " + ddl.ReplicaDatabase + " SYNC",
		"DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS " + ddl.StageDatabase + " SYNC",
		"DROP USER IF EXISTS " + memberUser,
		"DROP NAMED COLLECTION IF EXISTS " + memberOwnerCollection,
	} {
		mustExecMember(t, admin, stmt, stmt)
	}
	mustExecMember(t, admin, "create "+memberOwnerCollection, fmt.Sprintf(
		"CREATE NAMED COLLECTION %s AS host = '%s' NOT OVERRIDABLE, port = %d NOT OVERRIDABLE, user = '%s' NOT OVERRIDABLE, password = '%s' NOT OVERRIDABLE",
		memberOwnerCollection, env.ownerHost, env.ownerPort, memberReaderUser, readerPassword))
	mustExecMember(t, admin, "create "+memberUser, "CREATE USER "+memberUser+" IDENTIFIED WITH sha256_password BY '"+memberPassword+"'")
	for _, grant := range append(slices.Clone(siMemberGrants), "GRANT NAMED COLLECTION ON "+memberOwnerCollection) {
		mustExecMember(t, admin, grant, grant+" TO "+memberUser)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Minute)
		defer cancel()
		for _, stmt := range []string{
			"DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS " + ddl.ReplicaDatabase + " SYNC",
			"DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS " + ddl.StageDatabase + " SYNC",
			"DROP USER IF EXISTS " + memberUser,
			"DROP NAMED COLLECTION IF EXISTS " + memberOwnerCollection,
		} {
			_ = admin.Exec(ctx, stmt)
		}
	})

	m := &memberHandle{
		h: h, opts: opts, admin: admin, conn: openMemberCH(t, env.memberAddr, memberUser, memberPassword),
		killed: make(chan struct{}),
		cfg: member.Config{
			NodeID: memberNodeID, HostIndexerID: memberHostIndexerID,
			NetworkID: testNetworkID, GenesisSnapshotID: h.genesisID,
			Genesis: []payloadexec.TableSchema{h.schema},
			Pinned:  ddl.DefaultMemberPinned(memberNodeID, 0, ""),
			// Protocol stays empty (hg_unsafe, hg_safe, hg_promote): the
			// member's host would run its SNode on those; the harness's
			// suffixed databases are on the owner's server only.
			StateDir: t.TempDir(),
			Peers: []member.Peer{{IndexerID: tracksOwnerIndexerID, Collection: memberOwnerCollection,
				SafeDatabase: h.safeDB, UnsafeDatabase: h.unsafeDB}},
			Shadow:          true,
			PollInterval:    member.MinPollInterval,
			DiskBudgetBytes: memberDiskBudgetBytes,
		},
	}
	m.armed.Store(opts.killAfterAttach)
	t.Cleanup(m.Stop)
	m.start(t)
	return m
}

// start runs the role as one process would: its own arbiter client and
// registry follower, its ClickHouse login and its state directory.
func (m *memberHandle) start(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	client := newDataPlaneClient(t, m.h.cluster)
	logger := memberLogger()
	registry := dataplane.NewRegistryFollower(client, logger)
	var payloads replay.PayloadStore = m.h.payloads
	if m.h.daAddr != "" {
		payloads = newDADataClient(t, m.h.daAddr)
	}
	deps := member.Deps{Client: client, Conn: m.conn, Registry: registry, Payloads: payloads, Logger: logger}
	if m.armed.Load() {
		deps.AfterAttach = m.afterAttach
	}
	role, err := member.New(m.cfg, deps)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("member.New: %v", err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(m.h.ctx)
	run := &memberRun{role: role, cancel: cancel, exited: make(chan struct{})}
	go func() { _ = registry.Run(ctx) }()
	go func() {
		defer close(run.exited)
		run.err = role.Run(ctx)
	}()
	m.mu.Lock()
	m.run = run
	m.mu.Unlock()
}

// afterAttach is the killAfterAttach hook: on the first attach it stops the
// role and returns errMemberKilled, so the installer never journals the part
// it just attached.
func (m *memberHandle) afterAttach(tableKey, partitionID string) error {
	if !m.armed.CompareAndSwap(true, false) {
		return nil
	}
	m.current().cancel()
	m.killOnce.Do(func() { close(m.killed) })
	return fmt.Errorf("%w (%s, partition %s)", errMemberKilled, tableKey, partitionID)
}

func (m *memberHandle) current() *memberRun {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	return m.run
}

// Stats is the running role's member.Stats.
func (m *memberHandle) Stats() member.Stats { return m.current().role.Stats() }

// Stop stops the role and waits until Run returned; it is idempotent.
func (m *memberHandle) Stop() {
	run := m.current()
	if run == nil {
		return
	}
	run.cancel()
	select {
	case <-run.exited:
	case <-time.After(time.Minute):
		m.h.recordBackground(errors.New("the member did not stop within a minute"))
	}
}

// Restart stops the role and starts a new one on the same state directory
// and login, as a restarted process would.
func (m *memberHandle) Restart(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	m.Stop()
	m.start(t)
}

// requireRunning fails the test if Run returned.
func (m *memberHandle) requireRunning(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	run := m.current()
	select {
	case <-run.exited:
		t.Fatalf("member.Run returned: %v", run.err)
	default:
	}
}

// waitMember polls cond, failing on a background error of the harness or of
// the role.
func (m *memberHandle) waitMember(t *testing.T, what string, timeout time.Duration, cond func() bool) {
	t.Helper()
	waitFor(t, what, timeout, func() bool {
		m.h.failOnBackground(t)
		m.requireRunning(t)
		return cond()
	})
}

// patience is how long the member may take to catch up with the owner: a
// minute, plus two seconds per soak block.
func (m *memberHandle) patience() time.Duration {
	return time.Minute + time.Duration(m.opts.soakBlocks)*2*time.Second
}

func (m *memberHandle) waitReady(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	m.waitMember(t, "the member ready", 2*time.Minute, func() bool { return m.current().role.Ready() })
}

// waitKilled waits until the killAfterAttach hook stopped the role and Run
// returned.
func (m *memberHandle) waitKilled(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	run := m.current()
	select {
	case <-m.killed:
	case <-run.exited:
		t.Fatalf("member.Run returned before any ATTACH PARTITION FROM: %v", run.err)
	case <-time.After(2 * time.Minute):
		t.Fatal("timeout waiting for the member's first ATTACH PARTITION FROM")
	}
	select {
	case <-run.exited:
	case <-time.After(time.Minute):
		t.Fatal("the killed member did not stop within a minute")
	}
}

// waitEntry waits until the member's journal entry of owner 0 is entry.
func (m *memberHandle) waitEntry(t *testing.T, entry replay.TrackFrontier, timeout time.Duration) {
	t.Helper()
	m.waitMember(t, fmt.Sprintf("the member's entry of owner %d at %+v", tracksOwnerIndexerID, entry), timeout, func() bool {
		return m.Stats().Owners[tracksOwnerIndexerID].Entry == entry
	})
}

// waitShadowPast waits until the shadow verifier's cursor is past block.
func (m *memberHandle) waitShadowPast(t *testing.T, block uint64, timeout time.Duration) {
	t.Helper()
	m.waitMember(t, fmt.Sprintf("the shadow verifier past block %d", block), timeout, func() bool {
		return m.Stats().ShadowNextBlockSeq > block
	})
}

// copyTable is the name of the member's copy of db.t's live incarnation.
func (m *memberHandle) copyTable(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	view, ok := m.h.leaderFSM(t).TableRegistryView()
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("the table registry is not enabled")
	}
	live := view.Live(testTableID)
	if live == nil {
		t.Fatalf("the registry has no incarnation of %s", testTableID)
	}
	return ddl.CopyTableName(testTableID, live.Seq)
}

// copyValues are the copy's v values, ascending, read as the member
// server's admin.
func (m *memberHandle) copyValues(t *testing.T) []uint64 {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(m.h.ctx, 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	rows, err := m.admin.Query(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("SELECT v FROM `%s`.`%s` ORDER BY v", ddl.ReplicaDatabase, m.copyTable(t)))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("query the copy: %v", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var out []uint64
	for rows.Next() {
		var v uint64
		if err := rows.Scan(&v); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("scan a copy row: %v", err)
		}
		out = append(out, v)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("copy rows: %v", err)
	}
	return out
}

// copyPartNames are the copy's active parts.
func (m *memberHandle) copyPartNames(t *testing.T) []string {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(m.h.ctx, 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	rows, err := m.admin.Query(ctx, "SELECT name FROM system.parts WHERE database = ? AND table = ? AND active ORDER BY name", ddl.ReplicaDatabase, m.copyTable(t))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("query the copy's parts: %v", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var out []string
	for rows.Next() {
		var name string
		if err := rows.Scan(&name); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("scan a copy part: %v", err)
		}
		out = append(out, name)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("copy parts: %v", err)
	}
	return out
}

// copyRowHashes are the row LtHashes of the copy's active parts, sorted, so
// the copy compares with a manifest as a multiset.
func (m *memberHandle) copyRowHashes(t *testing.T) []string {
	t.Helper()
	names := m.copyPartNames(t)
	if len(names) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(m.h.ctx, 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	scans, err := chexec.ScanParts(ctx, m.admin, ddl.ReplicaDatabase+"."+m.copyTable(t), m.h.schema, names)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("scan the copy: %v", err)
	}
	out := make([]string, 0, len(scans))
	for _, s := range scans {
		out = append(out, s.RowLtHash)
	}
	slices.Sort(out)
	return out
}

// journaledParts are the parts the member's install journal holds for copy;
// none while there is no journal.
func (m *memberHandle) journaledParts(t *testing.T, copy string) []string {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(m.cfg.StateDir, install.JournalFile))
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read the install journal: %v", err)
	}
	var journal install.Journal
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &journal); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode the install journal: %v", err)
	}
	var out []string
	for _, owner := range journal.Owners {
		for _, table := range owner.Tables {
			if table.Copy != copy {
				continue
			}
			for _, part := range table.Parts {
				out = append(out, part.Name)
			}
		}
	}
	return out
}

// requireCopyEqualsLatestManifest waits until the member's entry of owner 0
// is the latest published manifest's, then requires the copy to hold
// exactly that manifest's parts of db.t (row hashes, as a multiset) and
// exactly the owner's hg_safe rows.
func (m *memberHandle) requireCopyEqualsLatestManifest(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	manifest := m.h.latestManifest(t)
	m.waitEntry(t, ownerEntryOf(t, manifest), m.patience())
	want := make([]string, 0)
	for _, part := range tableManifest(t, manifest, testTableID).ActiveParts {
		want = append(want, part.PartRowLtHash)
	}
	slices.Sort(want)
	if got := m.copyRowHashes(t); !slices.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("the copy's %d part row hashes %v differ from manifest %s's %d: %v", len(got), shortHashes(got), manifest.SnapshotID, len(want), shortHashes(want))
	}
	if got, owner := m.copyValues(t), m.h.queryValues(t); !slices.Equal(got, owner) {
		t.Fatalf("the copy holds %v, the owner's hg_safe %v", got, owner)
	}
}

// requireNoShadowMismatches requires every mismatch kind of owner 0 to be
// exported and zero.
func requireNoShadowMismatches(t *testing.T, st member.Stats) {
	t.Helper()
	owner, ok := st.Owners[tracksOwnerIndexerID]
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("member stats have no owner %d: %+v", tracksOwnerIndexerID, st)
	}
	for _, kind := range []shadow.MismatchKind{shadow.MismatchReceipt, shadow.MismatchScan, shadow.MismatchClaim} {
		n, ok := owner.ShadowMismatches[kind]
		if !ok || n != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("owner %d shadow mismatches of kind %s = %d (exported %v), want 0", tracksOwnerIndexerID, kind, n, ok)
		}
	}
}

// requireHealthyMember requires the member ready with a clean audit, one
// copy of owner 0 and nothing diverged, foreign, refused or paused.
func requireHealthyMember(t *testing.T, st member.Stats) {
	t.Helper()
	owner := st.Owners[tracksOwnerIndexerID]
	if !st.Ready || !st.AuditClean || st.InstallsPaused || st.FeedRefused != 0 || len(st.UnconfiguredOwners) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("member stats: ready %v, audit clean %v, installs paused %v, feed refused %d, unconfigured owners %v",
			st.Ready, st.AuditClean, st.InstallsPaused, st.FeedRefused, st.UnconfiguredOwners)
	}
	if owner.Copies != 1 || owner.DivergedPartitions != 0 || owner.DivergedTables != 0 || owner.ForeignTables != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("owner %d: %d copies, %d diverged partitions, %d diverged tables, %d foreign tables; want one copy and nothing else",
			tracksOwnerIndexerID, owner.Copies, owner.DivergedPartitions, owner.DivergedTables, owner.ForeignTables)
	}
	requireNoShadowMismatches(t, st)
}

// shortHashes abbreviates row LtHashes (2048 bytes each) for a failure
// message.
func shortHashes(hashes []string) []string {
	out := make([]string, 0, len(hashes))
	for _, h := range hashes {
		if len(h) > 18 {
			h = h[:18] + "…"
		}
		out = append(out, h)
	}
	return out
}
```

Create `scripts/test-clickhouse-member.sh`:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# Run the stage-3 P2 member integration of integration/chpipeline (plan
# S3-C2 contract §24.9) against two fresh ClickHouse servers on their own
# docker network:
#   si-owner   the harness's server: the arbiter's SNode and verifiers, the
#              owner's hg_safe and hg_unsafe, and si_reader;
#   si-member  the member's server, fenced with table_engines_require_grant
#              (scripts/ci/clickhouse-member-access-control.xml), where the
#              member logs in as si_member and reads si-owner through the NOT
#              OVERRIDABLE collection si_owner_0.
# The test binary runs here and reaches both servers on loopback ports; the
# member server reaches the owner as si-owner:9000. The member refuses to
# start unless its server refuses an ungranted engine (its engine fence
# probe), so a server without the access-control file fails every test. <soak blocks> is the
# number of shadow-verified blocks TestPipeline_MemberShadowSoak requires:
# 50 in ci.yml, 500 in member-soak.yml (decision D38).
#
# Usage:
#   bash scripts/test-clickhouse-member.sh <chpipeline test binary> <soak blocks>
set -euo pipefail

usage() {
  echo "usage: $0 <chpipeline test binary> <soak blocks>" >&2
  exit 2
}

if [ "$#" -ne 2 ]; then
  usage
fi
binary="$1"
soak_blocks="$2"
if ! [[ "$soak_blocks" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
  echo "test-clickhouse-member: soak blocks must be a positive decimal, got '${soak_blocks}'" >&2
  exit 2
fi
if [ ! -x "$binary" ]; then
  echo "test-clickhouse-member: ${binary} is not an executable chpipeline test binary" >&2
  usage
fi

# CI never sets ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_IMAGE; it lets a local run use another
# 26.3 image that is already pulled.
image="${ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_IMAGE:-clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3.37.3}"
script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
access_control="${script_dir}/ci/clickhouse-member-access-control.xml"
tests=(
  TestPipeline_MemberCopyFollowsTheOwnerAcrossPromotions
  TestPipeline_MemberCopiesNeverHoldRowsOfARejectedStatement
  TestPipeline_MemberKilledMidStreamResumesFromItsJournal
  TestPipeline_MemberShadowSoak
)

run_id="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-0}-$$"
network="arbiter-member-${run_id}"
owner="arbiter-member-owner-${run_id}"
member="arbiter-member-member-${run_id}"
work="$(mktemp -d)"
output="${work}/test.log"
cleanup() {
  status=$?
  if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    for container in "$owner" "$member"; do
      echo "--- docker logs ${container} (last 100 lines)" >&2
      docker logs --tail 100 "$container" >&2 2>/dev/null || true
    done
  fi
  docker rm -fv "$owner" "$member" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  docker network rm "$network" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -rf "$work"
  exit "$status"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM

# The member server's admin creates the collection by SQL, which needs
# named collection control; the access-control file never gives it to any
# other user. Both files are copied into the container before it starts, so
# no host path is mounted.
cat >"${work}/zz-si-member-admin.xml" <<'XML'
<clickhouse>
    <users>
        <default>
            <named_collection_control>1</named_collection_control>
        </default>
    </users>
</clickhouse>
XML
chmod 0644 "${work}/zz-si-member-admin.xml"

docker network create "$network" >/dev/null
docker run -d --name "$owner" --network "$network" --network-alias si-owner \
  -e CLICKHOUSE_DEFAULT_ACCESS_MANAGEMENT=1 -p 127.0.0.1::9000 "$image" >/dev/null
docker create --name "$member" --network "$network" --network-alias si-member \
  -e CLICKHOUSE_DEFAULT_ACCESS_MANAGEMENT=1 -p 127.0.0.1::9000 "$image" >/dev/null
docker cp "$access_control" "${member}:/etc/clickhouse-server/config.d/zz-si-access-control.xml" >/dev/null
docker cp "${work}/zz-si-member-admin.xml" "${member}:/etc/clickhouse-server/users.d/zz-si-member-admin.xml" >/dev/null
docker start "$member" >/dev/null

for container in "$owner" "$member"; do
  ready=false
  for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
    if docker exec "$container" clickhouse-client --query 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      ready=true
      break
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  if [ "$ready" != true ]; then
    echo "test-clickhouse-member: ClickHouse in ${container} did not become ready" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
owner_addr="$(docker port "$owner" 9000/tcp | head -n 1)"
member_addr="$(docker port "$member" 9000/tcp | head -n 1)"
echo "test-clickhouse-member: ${image}; owner ${owner_addr}, member ${member_addr}, soak ${soak_blocks} blocks"

timeout_s=$((1800 + 15 * soak_blocks))
env -u DA_STORE_ADDR -u DA_STORE_BIN \
  ARBITER_CH_INTEGRATION=1 ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_INTEGRATION=1 \
  CH_ADDR="$owner_addr" CH_MEMBER_ADDR="$member_addr" CH_OWNER_ADDR_FROM_MEMBER=si-owner:9000 \
  ARBITER_CH_MEMBER_SOAK_BLOCKS="$soak_blocks" \
  "$binary" -test.run '^TestPipeline_Member' -test.v -test.timeout="${timeout_s}s" 2>&1 | tee "$output"

# A misspelled filter or a skipped test must not turn this gate green.
for test in "${tests[@]}"; do
  if ! grep -F -- "--- PASS: ${test} " "$output" >/dev/null; then
    echo "test-clickhouse-member: ${test} did not run and pass" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
soak_line="$(grep -oE 'member soak: owner 0: [0-9]+ blocks, 0 mismatches, [0-9]+ missed scans, [0-9]+ unverdicted' "$output" | tail -n 1 || true)"
if [ -z "$soak_line" ]; then
  echo "test-clickhouse-member: no soak line with 0 mismatches in the test output" >&2
  exit 1
fi
soak_count="${soak_line#member soak: owner 0: }"
soak_count="${soak_count%% blocks*}"
if [ "$soak_count" -lt "$soak_blocks" ]; then
  echo "test-clickhouse-member: the soak verified ${soak_count} blocks, fewer than ${soak_blocks}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "test-clickhouse-member: ${#tests[@]} member tests passed on ${image}"
echo "test-clickhouse-member: ${soak_line}"
```

Create `.github/workflows/member-soak.yml`:

```yaml
name: Member Soak

# The full stage-3 P2 member soak (plan S3-C2 Task 36, decision D38): at
# least 500 shadow-verified blocks of the chpipeline owner with zero
# mismatches, plus the other three member tests. ci.yml runs the same script
# with 50 blocks on every pull request and push; this workflow runs only when
# dispatched by hand on main, and the run on the commit recorded as
# ARBITER_PIN_P2 is the record of P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  member-soak:
    runs-on: [self-hosted]
    timeout-minutes: 180
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # Must precede checkout: checkout's clean is what dies with EACCES on
      # root-owned leftovers (see ci.yml).
      - name: reclaim root-owned workspace artifacts
        run: |
          if [ -d "${{ github.workspace }}/contracts/build" ]; then
            docker run --rm -v "${{ github.workspace }}:/workspace" alpine:3.22 \
              rm -rf /workspace/contracts/build
          fi
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: bazelbuild/setup-bazelisk@v3
      - name: build data-plane test binary
        run: bazel build //integration/chpipeline:chpipeline_test
      - name: member copies, fraud, kill and the 500-block shadow soak
        run: |
          bash scripts/test-clickhouse-member.sh \
            bazel-bin/integration/chpipeline/chpipeline_test_/chpipeline_test 500
```

```bash
Stage-3 P2 member integration of the multi-source storage-integrity network (housegate spec `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-multi-source-si-stage3-database-groups-design.md` §8.4, §11, §16 row P2, §17; plan S3-C2 Task 36, contract §24.7–§24.9).
```

### 20. What Plan S3-C2 changes, consumed names, ledger and commands (Tasks 29–36)

**20.1 Activation model and the member's reach (read first).**
- No consensus format change: no Raft command, Raft tag, field of a Raft-reachable message, snapshot version byte (it stays 20), header byte or feature string. `arbiter.LocalNodeFeatures()` returns exactly `[client_lanes_v1 signed_claims_v1 track_manifests_v1]` in `CORE_TAG_P2` (Task 34 `TestLocalNodeFeaturesAreUnchangedThroughP2`). No arbiter release: Task 36 merges a pin and tests to arbiter `main` (`ARBITER_PIN_P2`), and no arbiter image changes on devnet2.
- A P2 member has a node id and no keys: it never calls `Membership`, `VerifierGateway`, `PromotionGateway`, `SourceClaims`, `ArbiterIngress` or `ConsensusAdmin`. Its only RPCs are `/arbiter.SafeState/GetSafeWatermark`, `/arbiter.SafeState/GetManifest`, `/arbiter.SafeState/GetBlockVerification`, `/arbiter.TableRegistry/GetTableRegistry`, `/arbiter.TableRegistry/WatchTableRegistry`, `/arbiter.TableRegistry/GetPurgeNodeSet` (arbiter data-plane listener) and `/arbiter.PayloadStore/FetchPayloads` (the DA data address, through `dastore.Client.GetPayload`). Task 34 `TestRoleCallsOnlyReadRPCs` runs a `member.Role` against fake servers whose interceptors fail the test on any other method.
- Every SafeState read crosses one leader read barrier (`arbiter:server/safestate.go:27-48`); the feed and the shadow back off (contract §21.4, §22.4) so their steady state costs at most one watermark read per `poll_interval` and one block read per second.

### 21. arbiter-core: reads, wire, manifest feed, member DDL and copies (Tasks 29–30)

**21.1 Client reads (Task 29, new `dataplane/member_reads.go`).** All three go through `WithLeaderRetry` (a follower's `NotLeader` is followed) and return any other gRPC refusal unchanged.
- `var ErrManifestNotFound = errors.New("dataplane: the arbiter has no manifest with that snapshot id")`; `var ErrBlockNotSealed = errors.New("dataplane: no sealed block at that seq")`.
- `func (c *Client) GetSafeWatermark(ctx context.Context) (arbiter.SafeWatermark, error)`.
- `func (c *Client) GetManifest(ctx context.Context, snapshotID string) (replay.SafeSnapshotManifest, error)`: refuses an empty id before any call with `dataplane: GetManifest needs a snapshot id`; maps NotFound (`unknown snapshot id`) to an error wrapping `ErrManifestNotFound` and naming the id; returns `wire.ManifestFromPB` unvalidated (the feed validates, §21.4).
- `func (c *Client) GetBlockVerification(ctx context.Context, blockSeq uint64) (wire.BlockVerification, error)`: refuses 0 before any call with `dataplane: GetBlockVerification needs a block seq`; NotFound → wraps `ErrBlockNotSealed`; Unimplemented → wraps `ErrStage3ReadsUnavailable`; an answer whose header names another block is refused with `dataplane: GetBlockVerification(%d) answered block %d`.
- `dataplane.NewManifestStore` and `ManifestStore` (`arbiter-core:dataplane/manifests.go:15-57`) are unchanged and not used by the member.
- Tests: `TestGetSafeWatermarkFollowsTheLeader`, `TestGetManifestUnknownSnapshotIsErrManifestNotFound`, `TestGetManifestRefusesAnEmptyID`, `TestGetBlockVerificationUnsealedIsErrBlockNotSealed`, `TestGetBlockVerificationRefusesAnAnswerForAnotherBlock`, `TestGetBlockVerificationUnimplementedIsErrStage3ReadsUnavailable`.

**21.2 `wire.BlockVerification` (Task 29, new `wire/block_verification.go`).** The canonical read form S3-A left without one (contract §3):
```go
type BlockHeaderView struct {
	L3BlockSeq           uint64
	StatementSeqStart    uint64
	StatementCount       uint32
	PrevSafeSnapshotID   string
	PrevStateRoot        string
	IsTableSetTransition bool    // header.table_set_transition present
	TrackIndexerID       *uint64 // header.track; nil before the tracks activation (indexer 0 is a value)
}
type StatementCandidates struct {
	StatementSeq              uint64
	StatementID               string
	Status                    string
	SourceNode                string
	RCBound                   bool
	SourceClaimRoot           string
	CandidateParts            []arbiter.CandidatePart
	PartitionNewPartSums      []arbiter.PartitionLtHashSum
	UnpromotedPartRowLtHashes []string
}
type VerifierEvidence struct {
	ReplicaID            string
	Attestation          *replay.ReplayAttestation // nil when not recorded
	ByteSideScan         *arbiter.ByteSideScanMsg  // nil when not recorded
	Evaluated            bool
	Check1RootMatch      bool
	Check2PartitionMatch bool
	Check3ByteSideMatch  bool
	Pass                 bool
}
type BlockVerification struct {
	Header           BlockHeaderView
	ChainHash        string
	ReplayJob        replay.ReplayJob
	Statements       []StatementCandidates
	ScanParts        []arbiter.PartRef
	SourceNodes      []string
	VerifierSet      []string
	Evidence         []VerifierEvidence
	VerdictEvaluated bool
	Quorum           bool
	Anchor           *arbiter.AnchorRef
	Finality         bool
	LastMergeable    bool
}
func BlockVerificationFromPB(m *pb.BlockVerification) (BlockVerification, error)
func BlockVerificationToPB(v BlockVerification) *pb.BlockVerification // fakes and tests; header fields outside BlockHeaderView stay empty
```
`BlockVerificationFromPB` refuses a message without a header with `wire: block verification has no header`, and reuses `ReplayJobFromPB`, `AttestationFromPB`, `ScanFromPB`, `PartRefsFromPB`, `AnchorRefFromPB` and the existing candidate converters; repeated fields decode empty to nil. Tests: `TestBlockVerificationFromPBReadsEveryField` (every field of `pb.BlockVerification`, `pb.StatementCandidates` and `pb.VerifierEvidence` set through protoreflect, each read back; header fields read are exactly those of `BlockHeaderView`), `TestBlockVerificationRoundTrip`, `TestBlockVerificationWithoutAHeaderIsRefused`, `TestBlockVerificationTrackKeepsIndexerZeroDistinctFromAbsent`.

**21.3 `ManifestOwner` (Task 29, `wire/table_registry_snapshot.go`).** `func (s TableRegistrySnapshot) ManifestOwner(tableKey string) (uint64, bool)`: the port of `arbiter:fsm/reads_manifest.go:448-463` — scanning `s.Incarnations` from the end, the first incarnation whose `Key()` is `tableKey`, whose `Status` is not `refused` and whose `Origin` is `genesis` or whose `AddBlockSeq` is non-zero gives `s.Owner(inc)`; false when there is none. Callers pass a snapshot from an enabled registry (`RegistryView.View` true). Tests (arbiter-core): `TestManifestOwnerIsTheNewestNonRefusedIncarnationThatEnteredATableSet`, `TestManifestOwnerOfAPreSignedClaimsIncarnationIsTheFoundingIndexer`, `TestManifestOwnerIgnoresAPendingIncarnationNeverAdded`, `TestManifestOwnerSkipsARefusedRecreation`; the FSM equality proof is Task 36's (§24.8).

**21.4 `member/manifestfeed` (Task 29, new package).**
- `type Source interface { GetSafeWatermark(ctx context.Context) (arbiter.SafeWatermark, error); GetManifest(ctx context.Context, snapshotID string) (replay.SafeSnapshotManifest, error) }` — `*dataplane.Client` satisfies it; there is no by-block method, so the feed cannot call `GetManifestByBlock` (`TestFollowerNeverCallsGetManifestByBlock` runs it through a real `dataplane.Client` against a fake `SafeState` server that fails on that method).
- `const DefaultMaxWalk = 64`, `DefaultCacheEntries = 16`, `DefaultPollInterval = 5 * time.Second`, `MinPollInterval = time.Second`.
- `var ErrManifestRefused = errors.New("manifestfeed: manifest refused")` — every refusal below wraps it (`errors.Is`).
- `func Verify(requested string, m replay.SafeSnapshotManifest) error` — the acceptance rule of spec §8.4, in this order, refusals verbatim: `manifestfeed: GetManifest(%s) answered manifest %s` (SnapshotID ≠ requested); `manifestfeed: manifest %s: %v` (`m.Validate()` fails, which recomputes every root); `manifestfeed: manifest %s has snapshot_id %s but manifest_root %s` (SnapshotID ≠ ManifestRoot); `manifestfeed: manifest %s fails the partition ledger: %v` (`payloadexec.VerifyLedger`). `Verify` does not require `track_frontiers`: a block's `PrevSafeSnapshotID` and the genesis manifest may predate the tracks activation.
- `type Store struct`; `func NewStore(src Source, entries int) *Store` (0 → `DefaultCacheEntries`); `func (s *Store) GetSafeSnapshot(ctx context.Context, snapshotID string) (replay.SafeSnapshotManifest, error)` — implements `replay.SnapshotStore` (the shadow's replays and the startup genesis check use it); a miss fetches through `src.GetManifest` and keeps the manifest only after `Verify`; least recently used eviction; `func (s *Store) Len() int`.
- `type Config struct { MaxWalk int; CacheEntries int; PollInterval time.Duration }` (0 → defaults; `PollInterval` below `MinPollInterval` refused with `manifestfeed: poll interval %s is below 1s`).
- `type Update struct { SnapshotID, ParentSnapshotID string; SafeBlockSeq uint64; Manifest replay.SafeSnapshotManifest; Entries map[uint64]replay.TrackFrontier; Changed []uint64; FullFetch bool; Walked int }` — `Entries` holds `replay.OwnerEntry` of every indexer of `Manifest.TrackFrontiers`; `Changed` lists, ascending, the indexers whose entry differs from the previous accepted manifest's (all of them for the first).
- `type Follower struct`; `func NewFollower(cfg Config, src Source, store *Store, last string, lastEntries map[uint64]replay.TrackFrontier) (*Follower, error)` (`last` "" = nothing accepted yet); `func (f *Follower) Poll(ctx context.Context) (Update, bool, error)` (false: the watermark did not move); `func (f *Follower) Run(ctx context.Context, onUpdate func(context.Context, Update) error) error` (polls every `PollInterval`; an `onUpdate` error leaves `last` where it was, is logged and counted, and the same update is offered again at the next poll, so the installer's journal stays the source of truth; `Run` returns only when `ctx` ends).
- The follower accepts only manifests that carry `track_frontiers` (K37): `manifestfeed: manifest %s carries no track_frontiers`. With `last` "" it accepts the verified watermark manifest alone (`FullFetch` true).
- Walk rule: from the watermark's `SnapshotID`, fetch and `Verify` each manifest and follow `ParentSnapshotID` until reaching `last`; the watermark's `ManifestRoot` must equal the fetched manifest's (`manifestfeed: watermark names manifest_root %s, manifest %s has %s`); a manifest with an empty parent reached before `last` is refused with `manifestfeed: watermark %s does not descend from the last accepted manifest %s`; beyond `MaxWalk` hops the follower accepts the verified watermark manifest alone with `FullFetch` true. In both cases no owner entry may go back: `manifestfeed: owner %d entry went back from (%d, %d) to (%d, %d) in manifest %s` (safe block seq, applied promotion seq).
- Tests: `TestVerifyAcceptsOnlyTheRequestedIDThatIsItsOwnRoot`, `TestVerifyRefusesPartitionRootsThatDoNotSumToTheirParts`, `TestFollowerRefusesAManifestWithoutTrackFrontiers`, `TestStoreServesAPreTracksManifest`, `TestFollowerWalksTheParentChainBackToItsLastAcceptedManifest`, `TestFollowerRefusesAWatermarkThatDoesNotDescend`, `TestFollowerFallsBackToAFullFetchBeyondMaxWalk`, `TestFollowerRefusesAnOwnerEntryThatGoesBack`, `TestFollowerDemultiplexesOneWatermarkPerOwner`, `TestFollowerNeverCallsGetManifestByBlock`, `TestStoreEvictsTheLeastRecentlyUsedManifest`, `TestStoreKeepsOnlyVerifiedManifests`.
